title: Gripple India People & Culture Manager
description:
**Unleash your potential. Change the game with Gripple.**


Gripple is a UK\-headquartered, employee\-owned manufacturer of innovative engineered solutions for the construction, agriculture, solar, and infrastructure markets. As a rapidly growing, employee\-centric company that takes pride in its unique culture, we are now looking to recruit a dedicated **People \& Culture Manager** to join the Gripple India team in New Delhi, a wholly owned subsidiary of Gripple Ltd.


If you're **positive**, **energetic** and **people\-oriented** with a real desire to develop our employees and our culture, wed love to hear from you.


**Why Gripple?**


Were not just innovatorswere game\-changers. Established in the UK in 1989, Gripple has led the charge in wire joining and suspension systems for many years. As a **100% employee\-owned business**, we dont just hire talentwe invest in it.


**Whats in it for you:**


* Competitive salary
* Employee Provident Fund (EPF)
* Medical insurance for you, plus spouse and up to two children

**The role:**


Reporting to the Gripple India Managing Director, this exciting and varied role is crucial in supporting people agenda and driving the regional strategy. Supporting and working closely with the wider leadership team, the role will focus on recruitment and talent acquisition, and employee training and development,


**What you'll be doing:**

* Managing the complete recruitment process including drafting of job adverts, resume shortlisting, coordinating and booking of interviews, preparing offer letters, onboarding and offboarding of employees
* Regular assessment of current and future openings and maintaining a sufficient pool/database of resumes in line with data protection
* Organising and managing training programmes for employee development
* Drafting, circulating and managing general employee policies, POSH policies, leave policies, attendance sheets etc.
* Liaising closely with the UK People \& Culture team on various employee development initiatives, MIS reports, drafting and circulating of company policies, data protection etc.
* Co\-ordinating with our company secretary and advocate to ensure all HR statutory compliances, such as POSH
* Updating and maintaining the HR system as required and producing reports
* Administration of all HR documents, including employee records and performance management records
* Managing general people tasks including birthday celebrations and annual appraisals

**Who you are****:**


The successful applicant will be organised, efficient and energetic, with the ability to motivate and influence people and a genuine interest and passion for people development.


Although not essential, the chosen candidate will ideally have an MBA in HR. They should also be able to demonstrate the following qualities:

* A desire to undertake training and learn new skills
* Attention to detail
* Positivity and an ability to energise others
* An ability to work with integrity and in a highly confidential environment
* Interpersonal skills and ability to act as an ambassador for the business while advocating the Gripple Spirit
* Several years experience in handling the complete recruitment process from cradle to grave
* A hands\-on approach to responsibilities and a good level of emotional intelligence
* Good IT skills Excel, PowerPoint, Word
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with a good level of both verbal and written English
* Good presentation skills

**The Gripple Spirit**


Our values fun, integrity, passion, entrepreneurship, teamwork, innovation arent just words on a wall. They shape everything we do.


**Take a closer look:**


* Learn more about who we are and how were changing the game: https://www.gripple.com/en\-in/about\-gripple/


**Closing date 7****th** **September 2026\.** Bring your ambition. Well bring the opportunity.


**Join a team where everyone belongs**


We encourage applications from people from all backgrounds and aim to have a workforce that represents the wider society that we serve. We champion diversity, inclusion and wellbeing and aim to create a workplace where everyone feels valued with a sense of belonging. If there are any adjustments that would help your experience with Gripple, please let us know when you apply.

description:

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Description: Area Head – Gold Loan**
==========================================

**Location:** Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh  

**Department:** Gold Loan Business  

**Reporting To:** Regional Head / State Head – Gold Loan

**Job Summary**
---------------


The Area Head \- Gold Loan will be responsible for driving business growth, profitability, portfolio quality, and operational excellence across the assigned territory. The role involves managing multiple Gold Loan branches, leading Branch Managers and field teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and delivering customer\-centric solutions to achieve business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Business Growth \& Revenue Management**

* Drive Gold Loan business across assigned branches in Tirupati and surrounding markets.
* Achieve branch\-wise disbursement, revenue, portfolio, and profitability targets.
* Develop and execute local market strategies to increase customer acquisition and market penetration.
* Identify new business opportunities and expansion potential within the territory.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and customer preferences to enhance market share.

### **Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Branch Managers and branch staff across the region.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability and productivity across branches.
* Conduct regular branch reviews and performance discussions.
* Drive employee engagement, training, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Foster a high\-performance and customer\-focused culture within the team.

### **Portfolio \& Risk Management**

* Ensure healthy portfolio growth while maintaining asset quality.
* Monitor overdue accounts, auction cases, and portfolio delinquency.
* Implement collection and recovery strategies to control NPA levels.
* Ensure proper appraisal, valuation, storage, and release of pledged gold as per policy.
* Minimize fraud risks through regular monitoring and process adherence.

### **Operations \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations, internal policies, audit requirements, and operational guidelines.
* Conduct regular branch visits to review operational controls and compliance standards.
* Drive resolution of audit observations and ensure timely closure.
* Monitor customer service standards and grievance resolution mechanisms.
* Maintain process discipline and operational efficiency across branches.

### **Relationship Management**

* Build strong relationships with customers, local influencers, and business associates.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Credit, Operations, Risk, HR, and Finance.
* Strengthen the company's brand presence within the assigned geography.
* Support marketing and promotional initiatives to drive business growth.

### **MIS \& Reporting**

* Track business performance through regular MIS reviews.
* Prepare business forecasts and action plans to achieve targets.
* Present branch performance reviews and market insights to senior management.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of business metrics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
-----------------------------

### **Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA or Post\-Graduation preferred.

### **Experience**

* 7 to 12 years of experience in Gold Loan, NBFC, Banking, or Financial Services.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in managing multiple branches/territories.
* Strong exposure to Gold Loan operations and business development.

### **Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Expertise in Gold Loan products and operations.
* Business development and market expansion capability.
* Portfolio and risk management experience.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in MIS reporting and performance management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Gold Loan portfolio growth.
* Revenue and profitability achievement.
* Customer acquisition and retention.
* Branch productivity and business performance.
* Portfolio quality and NPA control.
* Audit and compliance score.
* Employee productivity and attrition management.
* Customer satisfaction and service standards.

### **Span of Control**

* Branch Managers, Assistant Branch Managers, Relationship Officers, and Branch Operations Teams across the assigned territory.

**Preferred Location:** Candidates with strong market knowledge of Tirupati and Andhra Pradesh Gold Loan business ecosystem will be preferred.

CureAble is a child development and therapy ecosystem focused on helping neurodivergent children, children with developmental challenges, and slow learners access structured, measurable, and parent\-centric support.

description:
### **About Us**


Phenom Cloud is a partner in enterprise digital transformation. ### **Position Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **Sr HR Executive** to manage US IT Recruitment initiatives, and handle core HR operations. The ideal candidate should have proven experience in hiring IT professionals across multiple technology stacks for India operations, exposure to US staffing processes, and expertise in employee lifecycle management and HR administration.


### **Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Manage the end\-to\-end US IT recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements through sourcing, screening, selection, offer management, and onboarding.
* Proven experience sourcing, screening, and recruiting W\-2 candidates across US IT roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand staffing requirements, define candidate profiles, establish hiring priorities, and drive recruitment timelines.
* Source and identify qualified candidates through job portals, professional networks, ATS platforms, referrals, and other talent acquisition channels.
* Screen candidates, conduct initial assessments, coordinate interviews, and manage communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future technology hiring requirements.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and interview panels to ensure timely feedback and efficient candidate movement through the recruitment process.
* Manage offer release, pre\-employment documentation, onboarding, and joining formalities.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate records, HR documentation, and recruitment reports.
* Support employee onboarding and ensure new hires complete required documentation, processes, and compliance formalities.
* Maintain employee records and support HR operations including attendance, leave, employee lifecycle transactions, and HR documentation.
* Support employee engagement initiatives and contribute to creating a positive employee experience.
* Respond to employee queries and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of HR\-related matters.
* Ensure recruitment and HR processes are aligned with company policies, procedures, and applicable compliance requirements.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to continuously improve recruitment processes, employee lifecycle processes, and HR operations.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including open positions, sourcing effectiveness, interview progress, offer acceptance, joining ratios, and time\-to\-fill.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure appropriate handling of candidate and employee information.
* Support HR reporting, audits, process documentation, and other HR initiatives as required.
* Stay current with recruitment practices, sourcing strategies, HR technology, ATS/HRMS platforms, and US IT talent market trends.
* Work in the US shift to support hiring managers, candidates, and business stakeholders across the US.
  

  

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience across **HR Operations, US IT Recruitment, Domestic IT Recruitment**.
* Proven experience managing the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for technology roles.
* Strong understanding of IT recruitment processes, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding.
* Experience working with job portals, ATS platforms, HRMS systems, recruitment trackers, and HR reporting tools.
* Strong communication, candidate engagement, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Experience partnering directly with hiring managers to understand requirements and deliver qualified talent within agreed timelines.
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, attendance, leave management, employee records, and HR documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple open positions and HR priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong organizational, analytical, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience supporting employee engagement initiatives and general HR operations.
* Strong understanding of HR policies, processes, confidentiality, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, employees, and leadership.
* Willingness to work in the US shift
### **Benefits**


* Career Growth Opportunities.
* Learning \& Development Programs.
* Employee Engagement Activities.
* Collaborative Work Environment.
* Exposure to Domestic \& US Recruitment.
* Health Insurance \& Company Benefits.

An SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) Manager plays a critical role in bridging the gap between an organization’s financial operations and its IT infrastructure. They are responsible for leading the design, implementation, configuration, and optimization of SAP FICO modules (often transitioning to or leveraging SAP S/4HANA) to align with business objectives and compliance requirements.


Your Role:


The SAP FICO Manager will lead a team of Functional Analyst and Architect to oversee the end\-to\-end delivery of SAP Finance and Controlling solutions. This position requires expert in people management, deep functional expertise in core accounting and managerial costing processes, strong project management capabilities, and a proven track record of handling full\-lifecycle SAP implementations (including SAP S/4HANA migrations). The manager ensures financial reporting accuracy, system integration, and compliance with local and global financial standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **People Management**: The People Manager is responsible for leading, mentoring, and developing a high\-performing team of FICO functional analyst. The ideal candidate will focus on career development, performance management, team culture, and resource allocation, ensuring that the team has the right skills and motivation to meet the company's evolving technological goals.
* **Stakeholder Management**: work with stakeholders (Business process Architect, Process owners, AMS partners) to ensure the team collaborate on all requirement scoping and deployment. Working closely with external partners on the contract management and licensing of applications
* **Bridging top down communication**: Work closely with Leaderhsip on all management communication, playing key role in Implementing the core principles of IT organization and HR policies across Globe
* **Planning and forecasting**: taking care of all the planning and forecasting including resource planning, contracts and License management to ensure the Org P\&Ls are met with leadership expectation
* **Solution Architecture \& Configuration**: Lead the SAP FICO workstream through all phases of implementation (e.g., scoping, blueprinting, realization, testing, cutover, and post\-go\-live support) utilizing methodologies like ASAP, Agile across FICO sub modules as below
* + Financial Accounting (FI): General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting.
* + Controlling (CO): Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis (CO\-PA).
* **Cross\-Module Integration**: Collaborate closely with other functional teams to ensure seamless system integration with modules such as Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Production Planning (PP), Project Systems (PS), and Human Resources (HR).
* **Quality Assurance \& Testing**: Oversee system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), managing defect resolution, data migration validation, and compliance audits.
* **Team \& Vendor Management**: Mentor junior consultants, manage resource allocation, evaluate performance, and serve as the main point of contact for external vendors and system integrators.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Identify process inefficiencies and propose technical innovations (such as Fiori financial apps, Central Finance, or SAP BTP tools) to optimize financial reporting and data analytics.
 **Who you are:**

* Experience: 5–8\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP configuration, with at least 2–3 full\-cycle end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA implementations. 2 to 3 years of experience in people management
* S/4HANA Innovations: Strong familiarity with modern innovations like the Universal Journal, Material Ledger, Group Reporting, and Central Finance.
* Integration Knowledge: Advanced understanding of how financial data flows through supply chain, sales, and manufacturing modules.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills to explain complex technical designs to non\-technical executive teams.
* Problem\-Solving: Proven capacity to manage risks, track project timelines, resolve architectural defects, and make strategic data\-driven decisions.
* Education: Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, BE, Information Technology, or a related field (MBA or CPA/CA equivalents are highly desired).
* Certifications: SAP S/4HANA Finance or SAP FICO Certification is the value addition
* Preferred Certifications: Project Management certifications (such as PMP, Scrum Master etc) is a value addition

We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

The Total Reward CoE is an integral part of our collective drive to bring customers to the centre of everything we do at BT Group.


As a CoE we design customer\-centric total reward solutions that underpin outstanding business performance and differentiated individual total reward.


As a senior specialist, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and leading our total reward priorities, and delivering total reward solutions which support both our colleagues and our strategic business aspirations.


While operating at a developed level of conceptual thinking, you will help guide the business through change and risk management, ensuring that total reward practices are future proofed, customer\-centric and underpin increased business performance.

title: People Business Partner
description:
**What we are looking for**
---------------------------



A strong, on the ground People Business Partner who can help stand up the India site from a people perspective while partnering closely with leaders through launch, ramp, and stabilization. Unlike the senior HR lead, this role should lean much more heavily into tactical execution, day to day leadership support, and onsite people management, while still bringing enough strategic judgment to identify future opportunities and help shape the next phase of the people model.This person should be fully embedded in the operation, highly visible to leaders and employees, and able to translate business needs into practical people solutions in real time.


**Profile**
-----------



Highly tactical and fully onsite operator who is comfortable working in a fast paced, build stage environment where processes are still being defined and the site is scaling quickly. This role should be willing to stay close to the floor, leaders, and teams, with a strong bias for execution and problem solving.



Strong leadership partner able to work directly with site and functional leaders on day to day people topics, team effectiveness, manager support, role clarity, performance concerns, and workforce needs. This role should be credible with leaders, but much more hands on than a purely strategic business partner.



Deep employee engagement and culture capability with the ability to help shape the employee experience from the ground up. This includes identifying early engagement risks, reinforcing cultural expectations, supporting manager consistency, and helping create a healthy and sustainable site environment as the organization ramps.



Solid org effectiveness and talent management judgment with the ability to support team design, manager capability, succession thinking, talent cycled, and role clarity as the site evolves. This person does not need to own long range org strategy, but should be strong enough to spot issues, recommend improvements, and help leaders make sound people decisions.



Strong employee relations and compliance foundation with the ability to handle sensitive employee matters, ensure consistent policy application, support investigations or escalations as needed, and maintain strong alignment with local labor requirements and company standards.



Experienced in change management and comfortable supporting leaders and employees through ambiguity, new processes, shifting structures, and operating model changes during the launch and ramp period.



Coordinator and people operations enabler who can direct and prioritize the work of the 2 HR Generalists, ensuring strong day to day execution across onboarding, employee support, documentation, policy administration, issue follow up, and site level people processes.



Data aware and opportunity oriented with the ability to identify trends in attrition, engagement, attendance, performance, employee concerns, and manager capability, then translate those insights into practical actions and future improvements.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Partner day to day with site leaders on people topics tied to launch, ramp, and team stabilization.
* Provide onsite support on employee engagement, culture, team health, and manager effectiveness.
* Drive tactical org effectiveness work, including role clarity, team design support, and workforce planning input.

* Support change management as the site moves from launch mode into a more stable operating rhythm.

* Identify gaps, patterns, and improvement opportunities that can inform the next phase of the India people model.

**We're excited about you because…**

Likely 6 to 10 years of progressive HRBP or PBP experience, ideally in high growth, operations heavy, site based, or multi shift environments. The strongest profile would bring a mix of business partnership, employee relations, manager coaching, engagement, and operational HR execution, with experience working very close to the business rather than from a distance.This should be someone who is comfortable balancing immediate tactical support with enough business judgment to help build stronger practices over time.

Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

 *For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud**.*


Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and 30,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

 **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

* Regular audits of processes \& policies in compliance with existing labor laws.


Here's What You Need::
* Proven 7\+ years of work experience as an Employee Relations Specialist or similar role.
* Demonstrated knowledge of employment laws and regulations.
* Proven record of Strong problem solving conflict resolution and mediation.
* Excellent decision\-making skills
* Strong understanding and ability of handling confidential information.
* Outstanding interpersonal skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to details.
* Professional certification as an Employee Relations Specialist.

title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager – People, Compliance \& Administration

**Company:** Nexrise India Infra Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Jaipur, Rajasthan  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site only  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Experience Required:** 5–8\+ Years

About the Role

Nexrise India Infra Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **HR Manager – People, Compliance \& Administration** to take end\-to\-end ownership of the organisation's human resource function.

The person will be responsible for building and managing strong HR systems covering **manpower planning, recruitment, employee lifecycle management, policies, statutory compliance, performance management, employee relations, discipline, documentation and HR reporting**.

The role requires a hands\-on HR professional who can work closely with management as well as employees across office, sales, warehouse, operations and manufacturing functions.

This position is based **100% on\-site at Jaipur**.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment

* Prepare department\-wise manpower plans in consultation with management and HODs.
* Manage recruitment across junior, middle and senior\-level positions.
* Source, screen, interview and coordinate selection of candidates.
* Maintain recruitment pipelines and vacancy trackers.
* Develop and maintain Job Descriptions for all key positions.
* Improve hiring quality, joining ratios and employee retention.

2\. Employee Lifecycle Management

Manage the complete employee lifecycle including:

* Offer and appointment documentation
* Joining and onboarding
* Employee induction
* Probation monitoring
* Confirmation
* Transfers
* Promotions
* Salary revisions
* Performance reviews
* Resignations
* Full \& Final settlement coordination
* Exit interviews and relieving documentation

3\. HR Policies \& Processes

* Draft and implement company HR policies.
* Prepare HR SOPs and internal guidelines.
* Establish attendance, leave, overtime and disciplinary processes.
* Maintain employee handbook and code of conduct.
* Review existing policies periodically and recommend improvements.
* Ensure HR policies are communicated and consistently implemented across departments.

4\. Statutory \& Labour Compliance

The candidate should have practical knowledge of applicable statutory requirements, including:

* Provident Fund – PF
* ESIC
* Labour law requirements
* Shops \& Establishment requirements
* Factory/workforce\-related HR compliance
* Employee registers and statutory records
* Contractor/manpower documentation where applicable
* Wage and attendance records
* Leave and overtime compliance
* Employment documentation

The HR Manager will coordinate with consultants, accounts and management wherever required while retaining internal ownership of compliance.

5\. Attendance, Leave \& Workforce Discipline

* Monitor attendance and punctuality across employees.
* Manage leave records and approvals.
* Monitor overtime and shift\-related records.
* Identify absenteeism and attendance irregularities.
* Implement disciplinary procedures.
* Prepare warning letters, show\-cause notices and other HR communications where required.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company rules.

6\. Performance Management

* Implement KRAs and KPIs across departments.
* Establish probation review systems.
* Coordinate monthly/quarterly employee performance reviews.
* Maintain performance records.
* Assist management with increment and promotion decisions.
* Develop Performance Improvement Plans where necessary.
* Build a performance\-driven culture across the organisation.

7\. Payroll \& Compensation Coordination

* Verify monthly attendance and payroll inputs.
* Coordinate employee additions, deductions, incentives, leave and overtime.
* Maintain salary confidentiality.
* Assist management with compensation benchmarking and salary structuring.
* Coordinate PF, ESIC and other employee deductions with Accounts/payroll personnel.

8\. Employee Relations

* Act as the central point for employee HR concerns.
* Handle grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Resolve interpersonal and departmental employee issues.
* Conduct employee counselling where necessary.
* Improve communication between employees, HODs and management.
* Support employee retention and engagement initiatives.

9\. HR Documentation \& MIS

Maintain accurate records relating to:

* Employee master database
* Attendance
* Leave
* Salary revisions
* Recruitment
* Manpower requirements
* Probation
* Performance
* Employee turnover
* Warning/disciplinary records
* Training
* Statutory documentation
* Employee exits

Prepare regular HR MIS and dashboards for management review.

10\. Organisation Development

* Maintain company organisation charts and reporting structures.
* Assist management with manpower budgeting.
* Identify organisational skill gaps.
* Coordinate employee training and development.
* Assist with succession planning for important roles.
* Support the company as it expands into new locations and departments.

Candidate ProfileMandatory

* Minimum **5 years of relevant HR experience**
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end HR operations
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC and Indian labour compliance
* Strong recruitment capabilities
* Experience handling employee grievances and disciplinary matters
* Excellent drafting and documentation skills
* Strong knowledge of MS Excel and HR reporting
* Good verbal and written communication in **English and Hindi**
* Ability to work independently and take ownership

Preferred

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Manufacturing
* Engineering
* Infrastructure
* Construction Equipment
* Industrial Products
* Warehousing
* Logistics
* Equipment Rental

Experience managing a combination of **corporate/office employees, field sales employees and factory/warehouse manpower** will be a significant advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Process\-oriented
* Firm but fair
* Highly organised
* Confidential
* Approachable
* Strong in documentation
* Comfortable enforcing company policies
* Able to communicate with employees at every organisational level
* Capable of working directly with senior management
* Proactive rather than dependent on instructions for every HR activity

Work Location

**Jaipur, Rajasthan – On\-site**

This is **not a remote or hybrid position**.

Candidates should either currently be based in Jaipur or be willing to relocate to Jaipur.

Compensation

Salary will be competitive and will be decided based on the candidate's experience, current compensation and suitability for the role.

Joining

Candidates who can join within a reasonable notice period will be preferred.

Pay: ₹15,645\.94 \- ₹40,628\.65 per month

Application Question(s):

* Experience in handling Blue collar staff and employees ?

Location:

* Jaipur, Rajasthan (Jaipur) (Preferred)

title: Specialist, Indirect Procurement
description:
Build a career with confidence

  

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world\-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

  

About the Role

* Support strategic sourcing and procurement activities across indirect spend categories to achieve cost savings, process efficiency, compliance, and supplier performance objectives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to manage sourcing, contracting, supplier engagement, spend analysis, and purchase requisition requirements.
* Drive procurement best practices, policy compliance, and data\-driven decision\-making to deliver business value and operational excellence.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Execute sourcing and procurement activities across indirect categories such as IT, Professional Services, Marketing, Facilities, HR, Travel, Fleet, MRO, and Corporate Services.
* Conduct spend analysis and identify cost\-saving, productivity, and supplier optimization opportunities.
* Manage RFx processes including RFI, RFP, RFQ, bid analysis, supplier evaluation, and negotiation support.
* Collaborate with Category Managers, business stakeholders, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams to support sourcing initiatives.
* Support contract review processes and ensure all sourcing activities adhere to procurement policies and compliance requirements.
* Monitor supplier performance and assist in developing supplier scorecards and governance processes.
* Create and maintain procurement dashboards, savings trackers, sourcing pipelines, and management reports.
* Support purchase requisition (PR) to purchase order (PO) processes and resolve procurement\-related operational issues.
* Ensure data accuracy in procurement systems such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or equivalent platforms.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and process standardization within procurement operations.

  

Minimum Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 6\-8 years of experience in Indirect Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, or Category Management support.
* Strong understanding of sourcing methodologies, supplier management, contract management, and procurement processes.
* Experience working with procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or similar tools.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis/reporting.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Experience supporting global procurement operations across multiple regions is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, CSCP, or equivalent are an added advantage.

  

Preferred Competencies

* Strategic Sourcing
* Spend Analytics
* Supplier Relationship Management
* Contract Management
* Cost Optimization
* Stakeholder Management
* Procurement Compliance
* Data Analysis \& Reporting
* SAP Ariba / Procurement Systems
* Continuous Improvement \& Automation

title: Compensation & Benefits Manager
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.

  

We are seeking a Compensation \& Benefits Manager for India who will be responsible for managing compensation programs, benefits governance, compensation benchmarking, annual rewards processes, job evaluation, pay equity reviews, and rewards analytics. The role will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, business leaders, and external vendors to ensure market competitiveness, internal equity, compliance, and strong employee experience across rewards programs.

  

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**
------------------------------------------

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain compensation frameworks, salary structures, pay ranges, and job grade alignment for India.
* Lead annual compensation review processes including merit increases, market corrections, promotion increases, bonus inputs, and related compensation cycle governance.
* Conduct market benchmarking using external salary survey data and internal compensation data to assess market competitiveness and recommend pay positioning actions.
* Partner with Talent Management to align reward decisions with performance outcomes, promotion cycles, succession planning inputs, leadership development priorities, and retention strategies.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to support compensation recommendations for offers, counteroffers, internal movements, and critical talent retention cases.
* Manage benefits programs including group medical insurance, life and accident coverage, retirement benefits, wellness offerings, and other employee benefit programs applicable in India.
* Lead benefits renewals, vendor coordination, employee communication, enrollment support, utilization review, and cost\-benefit analysis for benefit programs.
* Support job evaluation and role benchmarking exercises to ensure appropriate role alignment, grade placement, and internal parity across functions and service lines.
* Conduct pay equity, compensation outlier, promotion, and post\-cycle analyses to identify trends, exceptions, risks, and leadership actions.
* Prepare compensation dashboards, workforce cost analysis, benefits utilization reports, and executive\-ready insights for HR and business leadership.
* Coordinate with Finance and Payroll to ensure accurate implementation of compensation outcomes, payroll inputs, variable pay, benefits deductions, and statutory requirements.
* Ensure compensation and benefits processes are compliant with applicable India labor laws, tax requirements, social security obligations, data privacy expectations, and internal governance standards.
* Manage relationships with compensation survey providers, consultants, insurance brokers, benefit vendors, and HR technology partners.
* Drive process improvement, automation, documentation, and data integrity across compensation planning, benefits administration, and rewards reporting.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* 8 to 12 years of overall HR experience, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in Compensation \& Benefits, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, or Rewards Operations.
* Experience managing compensation cycles, salary benchmarking, benefits administration, job evaluation, and compensation governance for India.
* Working knowledge of India compensation practices, employee benefits, payroll interface processes, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong comfort with data validation, analysis, reporting, and presentation of insights.
* Experience working with HRIS, compensation planning tools, payroll inputs, and employee data with strong confidentiality and data discipline.

**Preferred / Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Experience with compensation surveys and benchmarking platforms such as Mercer, Aon, WTW, Radford, or similar market data providers.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, GCC, financial services, or a matrixed global organization.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, HR dashboards, compensation planning systems, or other analytics and reporting platforms.
* Experience supporting performance\-linked rewards, promotion cycles, talent calibration, retention analysis, and leadership compensation reviews.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate data into clear recommendations for HR and business leaders.

**Key Capabilities**
--------------------

**Rewards Expertise**


Compensation strategy, salary structures, benefits design, benchmarking, job evaluation, variable pay, and pay equity.

**Business Partnership**


Partnering with Business Leaders, HRBPs, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, and external partners.

**Governance \& Analytics**


Audit\-ready documentation, compliance controls, data integrity, dashboarding, post\-cycle analysis and process automation.

**About our Human Resources Team**
----------------------------------


Comprised of centers of excellence and a diverse team of backgrounds and experience, the EisnerAmper Human Resources department attracts top talent, creates impactful engagement opportunities, and promotes education and growth for employees across the firm. By bringing together unique HR specializations and a deep understanding of the accounting business, we enable our colleagues to thrive personally and professionally.

  

Our award\-winning culture is based on the tenets of respect, professionalism, and extreme hospitality. While people are at the heart of everything we do, we are constantly looking for ways to leverage advanced data and analytics, implement innovative technology, and roll out new processes that scale with the business.

  

EisnerAmper HR employees act as strategic partners with the service lines with which they work to create and deliver business solutions. When we have a genuine understanding of the unique teams and individuals we serve, we can make a tangible difference and deliver on our promise of being a great place to work.

**About EisnerAmper**
---------------------

  

EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax and business advisory firms in the U.S., with more than 5000 employees and over 450 partners across the country. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today, and position them for success tomorrow. Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries.

  

We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers and investors who serve these clients. Our reach extends globally, with offices in the United Kingdom, Israel, India, the Cayman Islands, Singapore, and Ireland.

**About EisnerAmper India**
---------------------------

  

EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.


EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 1000 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.  

Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: raxit.ajmera@eisneramper.com

**Preferred Location:**
-----------------------


Mumbai

title: Technical Manager, Data Products & Analytics Delivery
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Data Manager to lead the design, development, and scaling of enterprise\-grade data pipelines and analytics platforms in the cloud. This role is pivotal in driving our data strategy, ensuring robust, secure, and scalable solutions that power critical business decisions.


Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities


This role covers below responsibilities within Northern Trust :

* Strategize, Lead design, implementation, and operational management of secure, scalable cloud data products solutions on snowflake \& Azure.
* Architect and optimize data pipelines using Snowflake Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration.
* Develop and manage enterprise data platforms leveraging Snowflake for cloud data warehousing.
* Ensure best practices in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevOps for data engineering solutions.
* Drive ARB discussions end to end and responsible for the e2e life cycle of data products
* Implement advanced data engineering pipelines and machine learning workflows using Azure Databricks (including Delta Lake and medallion architecture).
* Drive integration of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for business intelligence and self\-service analytics.
* Mentor and Lead team members on Azure data engineering, Snowflake optimization, and Databricks performance tuning.
* Communicate progress, risks, and technical decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical designs and deliverables.
* Establish and enforce data governance, security, and compliance standards using Azure Purview and related tools.


Experience/ Skills

**Minimum qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related field.
* 18\+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
* Hands\-on expertise in Snowflake, Azure cloud services, including Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks.
* Proven experience with Snowflake for data warehousing and performance optimization.
* Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, and Spark/PySpark.
* Experience integrating Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for enterprise analytics.
* Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data governance.

**Required Skills**

* Expertise in Snowflake, Data architecture, Azure Data Factory (ADF) for orchestrating complex data workflows.
* Proficiency in Snowflake architecture, query optimization, and cost management.
* Advanced knowledge of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and Spark performance tuning.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for data solutions.
* Strong understanding of Power BI dashboards, DAX, and integration with Microsoft Fabric.
* Ability to manage data security, compliance, and governance using Azure Purview.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 **Nice to Have Skills**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Certified Azure Data Engineer).
* Experience with machine learning pipelines and advanced analytics.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and DevOps practices for data engineering.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team\-building skills.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

description:
Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Staffing

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities for assigned positions.
* Understand manpower requirements from respective departments.
* Prepare and post job descriptions on appropriate job portals and recruitment platforms.
* Source and screen candidates through job portals, references, databases, and other channels.
* Conduct preliminary HR interviews and coordinate further rounds with concerned departments.
* Schedule interviews and maintain candidate records.
* Coordinate salary discussions, selection, offer release, and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and track open positions.

2\. Employee Onboarding \& Induction

* Coordinate pre\-joining and joining documentation.
* Conduct employee onboarding and HR induction.
* Explain company policies, rules, benefits, attendance procedures, and code of conduct.
* Ensure timely completion of joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Coordinate with departments for smooth integration of new employees.
* Maintain and update employee personnel files and HR records.

3\. Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor daily attendance, late coming, absenteeism, and leave records.
* Maintain and update employee attendance and leave data.
* Coordinate with employees and department heads regarding attendance discrepancies.
* Prepare attendance reports for payroll processing.
* Ensure adherence to company leave and attendance policies.

4\. Employee Records \& HR Documentation

* Maintain accurate and updated employee master data.
* Maintain personnel files, appointment letters, confirmation letters, appraisal records, and other HR documents.
* Prepare HR letters and documentation as required.
* Ensure proper documentation of employee movements, transfers, promotions, and other changes.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.

5\. Probation \& Confirmation

* Track employee probation periods and ensure timely review.
* Coordinate probation feedback with reporting managers.
* Maintain probation review records.
* Prepare and issue confirmation or extension letters based on management decisions.

6\. Performance Management

* Support the implementation of monthly/periodic employee performance reviews.
* Coordinate with department heads for KRA/KPI and performance feedback.
* Track completion of performance evaluation processes.
* Maintain performance records and assist in annual appraisal activities.
* Identify recurring performance or behavioural concerns and escalate them appropriately.

7\. Employee Engagement \& Relations

* Support employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Act as a point of contact for routine employee queries and concerns.
* Promote positive employee relations and a healthy workplace environment.
* Assist in resolving employee grievances in coordination with the HR Head.
* Conduct employee feedback initiatives and assist in implementing corrective actions.

8\. Learning \& Development

* Identify training requirements in coordination with department heads.
* Assist in planning and coordinating employee training programs.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance, feedback, and training records.
* Follow up on training effectiveness where required.

9\. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Ensure employees are aware of and follow company HR policies.
* Support implementation of HR policies and processes.
* Maintain statutory and HR compliance\-related documentation as applicable.
* Coordinate with relevant internal/external stakeholders for HR compliance requirements.
* Keep HR records organised and audit\-ready.

10\. Payroll Coordination

* Coordinate with the accounts/payroll team for monthly payroll inputs.
* Provide accurate attendance, leave, new joining, exit, deduction, and other employee\-related information.
* Verify payroll\-related HR data before processing.
* Address employee queries related to attendance and payroll inputs.

* Coordinate employee resignation and exit formalities.
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews.
* Ensure clearance and handover processes are completed.
* Coordinate with Accounts and concerned departments for full \& final settlement.
* Issue relieving, experience, and other required documents as per company policy.

* Prepare and maintain regular HR reports and MIS.

description:
Overview:
**Job Description: Sales Planning \& Sales Compensation Domain Expert****Role Title:** Domain Expert – Sales Planning \& Sales Compensation (Telecom / Enterprise Segment)  

**Engagement Context:** Digital transformation of Sales Planning \& Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform for a US Tier\-1 Telecom Operator serving Enterprise/B2B segments**About the Role**
We are seeking a Sales Planning and Sales Compensation Domain Expert to support the transformation of a legacy sales planning and compensation platform for a leading US Tier\-1 telecommunications operator. The platform serves multiple enterprise customer segments (e.g., SMB, Mid\-Market, Large Enterprise, Global/Strategic Accounts) and this role will be central to defining business requirements, validating solution design, and ensuring the modernized platform aligns with complex, segment\-specific sales compensation and territory/quota planning models.
Responsibilities:
* **Key Responsibilities**
	+ Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on sales planning, territory \& quota management, and incentive compensation processes within a telecom enterprise sales context
	+ Analyze current\-state (as\-is) sales planning and compensation workflows, systems (e.g., ICM/SPM tools like Varicent, Xactly, SAP Callidus, Anaplan), and pain points across different enterprise segments
	+ Define future\-state (to\-be) business requirements and process flows for territory design, quota setting, plan administration, crediting, and payout calculation
	+ Partner with architects and engineering teams to translate compensation business rules into system logic, data models, and workflow configurations
	+ Validate that plan designs correctly handle segment\-specific nuances (e.g., differing quota structures, deal complexity, channel/overlay roles, named accounts vs. geo\-based territories)
	+ Support data mapping and migration efforts from legacy systems, ensuring compensation history, hierarchy, and crediting rules are preserved accurately
	+ Lead or contribute to UAT planning, test case design, and validation of calculated payouts against expected business outcomes
	+ Advise on compliance, audit, and SOX\-related controls typical of enterprise sales compensation platforms
	+ Collaborate with sales operations, finance, HR, and IT stakeholders on both client and delivery sides
	+ Support change management and training material development for end users (sales reps, managers, comp analysts)
	+ Document business rules, edge cases, and exception\-handling logic clearly for technical teams


Requirements:
**Required Experience \& Skills*** 8\+ years of experience in Sales Planning, Sales Compensation, or Incentive Compensation Management, ideally within telecom or a comparable B2B/enterprise sales environment
* Strong understanding of enterprise sales segmentation (SMB, Mid\-Market, Enterprise, Strategic/Global Accounts) and how compensation/territory models differ across them
* Hands\-on functional experience with one or more ICM/SPM platforms (e.g., Varicent, Xactly, SAP Callidus/CallidusCloud, Anaplan, Oracle Incentive Compensation, NICE Performance Management)
* Deep knowledge of compensation plan design elements: quota allocation, crediting rules, tiered/accelerator payouts, draws, clawbacks, SPIFs, and dispute management
* Experience with territory and quota planning methodologies, including account\-based and geo\-based models
* Familiarity with telecom sales processes — order\-to\-cash, CPQ, CRM (Salesforce preferred), billing/OSS\-BSS touchpoints — is a strong plus
* Ability to translate ambiguous business rules into clear, structured requirements for technical teams
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable working with both business and technical audiences
* Experience supporting system migrations or platform transformations (legacy to modern SaaS\-based ICM) is highly desirable

description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------


The Staff HR Technology Architect is the senior technical authority for OpenGov’s HR technology ecosystem, responsible for the architecture, integration design, and long\-term technical direction of the systems that manage employee data across the entire employee lifecycle. Based in Pune and reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering, this individual\-contributor role sets the technical vision for the Workday platform and the broader HR application portfolio, ensuring the ecosystem is scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned to the needs of a global workforce across the US and India.


We are looking for a seasoned architect with deep domain and technical expertise across the Workday platform and the adjacent, integrated systems that make up the HR technology ecosystem — spanning payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and HR operations. This is a hands\-on, staff\-level individual contributor with a dotted\-line leadership mandate: no direct reports, but expected to guide and mentor HR application administrators, lead virtual teams on major initiatives, and influence the direction both technical and business teams take with HR technology. While the role is primarily architecture and design, it also carries hands\-on technical delivery — the architect personally builds and delivers the most complex or high\-risk integrations, configurations, and reports. The architect owns integration architecture and the HR data model end to end across best\-of\-breed systems, partners with the Manager, HR Technology on delivery, and serves as the design authority on data governance, security, and emerging AI and automation across the stack.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Technical Architecture \& Systems Design**

* Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the HR technology ecosystem — Workday (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting, and Security) and the surrounding application portfolio — establishing design standards, patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Own the architecture across a best\-of\-breed, multi\-platform landscape — the core HRIS (Workday) plus payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby), employee engagement (CultureAmp), ERP (e.g., NetSuite), SSO/identity, compliance/training platforms, data\-warehousing and BI tooling (e.g., Snowflake), and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) — ensuring the systems interoperate as a coherent whole.
* Define target\-state architecture and multi\-year technical roadmaps that scale with a growing, globally distributed workforce, balancing configuration, extensibility, and total cost of ownership.
* Evaluate new Workday releases, features, and third\-party solutions; make build\-vs\-configure\-vs\-buy recommendations and lead architecture and design reviews.
* Provide deep, hands\-on technical expertise across the ecosystem — anchored in the Workday stack (advanced configuration, the business process framework, calculated fields, security design, and complex reporting) and extending to adjacent platforms such as ADP, Ashby, CultureAmp, and NetSuite/ERP.

**Integration Architecture \& Data Flows**

* Design and govern the integration architecture across the HR ecosystem (e.g., ADP, Ashby, engagement survey, SSO/identity, ERP, and downstream data\-warehouse/BI platforms such as Snowflake), leveraging iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) where appropriate and establishing patterns, standards, and error handling and monitoring.
* Own the HR data model and the flow of employee data from hire to retire, ensuring integrity, lineage, and consistency across integrated systems.
* Serve as design authority for Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web service APIs), iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato), and downstream data platform feeds.
* Maintain a working understanding of how HRIS data ties into ERP (e.g., NetSuite) and other enterprise systems, and lead the design of those interfaces.

**Technical Strategy \& Influence**

* Set the technical direction for HR technology and influence the decisions both technical and business teams make when adopting or changing technology.
* Partner with HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, IT, and Workplace leaders to translate business strategy into a coherent systems strategy.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership, framing trade\-offs, risks, and options for major HR technology investments and platform decisions.
* Provide dotted\-line technical leadership and mentorship to HR application administrators; lead virtual and matrixed teams on large initiatives and build technical depth and backup coverage across critical domains.

**Data Governance, Security \& AI**

* Serve as the design authority for HR data governance, privacy, and security — defining data structures, access models, and controls across the US and India.
* Establish standards for HR data quality, master data, and reporting and analytics that feed data\-warehouse and BI platforms (e.g., Snowflake).
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply automation and AI within the HR technology stack, establishing responsible\-use and data\-handling guardrails.
* Ensure the architecture supports compliance requirements across geographies (audits, policy acknowledgements, and mandatory training) and evolving data\-privacy regulations.

**Delivery, Vendors \& Best Practices**

* Lead complex, cross\-functional HR technology projects end to end from an architecture and design standpoint — shaping solutions, reviewing designs, and guiding delivery teams.
* Stay hands\-on with technical delivery — personally building and delivering the most complex or high\-risk configurations, integrations, and reports rather than limiting the role to design and oversight.
* Partner with the Manager, HR Technology and the administration team to translate architecture into configuration, and maintain documentation of architecture, standards, and system specifications.
* Manage strategic third\-party vendor and implementation\-partner relationships from a technical and architecture perspective.
* Stay current on Workday releases, HR technology trends, and best practices; exhibit sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive employee data.

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* 10\+ years of progressive HR technology / HRIS functional and technical experience, including significant time in an architecture, principal, or senior technical individual\-contributor capacity.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical authority who sets direction and influences both technical and business stakeholders — this is a senior individual\-contributor role, not an entry\-level or first architecture role.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in a core HRIS — Workday strongly preferred — across the full module stack (Absence, Benefits, Compensation, Core HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Reporting, Security, Talent, Time Tracking), including advanced configuration and the business process framework.
* Hands\-on experience across a multi\-platform HR technology ecosystem — not limited to a single HRIS — including payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby preferred), employee engagement (CultureAmp preferred), SSO/identity, and compliance/training platforms.
* Strong Workday integration expertise (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web services/APIs) and proven experience designing enterprise integration architectures, including iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Expertise in HR data modeling, data governance, and how HRIS data flows into downstream data\-warehouse and BI systems (e.g., Snowflake).
* Experience with data\-warehousing tools (e.g., Snowflake) and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Willingness and ability to perform hands\-on technical delivery — configuration, integration development, and reporting — in addition to architecture, design, and oversight; this is not a design\-only role.
* Broad domain expertise across payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, employee engagement, and general HR operations.
* Experience supporting HR systems across multiple geographies, ideally including both the US and India.
* Proficiency with Workday report writing and complex calculated fields.
* Experience with an applicant tracking system (Ashby preferred) and an employee engagement survey platform (CultureAmp preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to mentor administrators and provide dotted\-line technical leadership without formal reporting authority.
* Strong understanding of HR compliance, data privacy, and security considerations across regions.
* Exposure to automation and AI applications within HR technology a plus.
* Familiarity with NetSuite or a comparable ERP, and how HRIS data integrates with it, a plus (nice to have).
* Excellent communication skills, able to influence and align technical and business stakeholders at all levels of a globally distributed organization.
* Workday certifications (e.g., Integrations, HCM, or Pro) preferred.
* Experience using Google Workspace a plus.
* Exhibits sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

This role will lead transformation programs, implement best practices, and ensure operational excellence through process optimization, automation, and stakeholder engagement.

Lead large\-scale change management initiatives to modernize processes and systems. Partner with technology teams to implement automation, AI, and digital solutions for payroll.


Operational Excellence\-Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and quality standards for payroll and HR service delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies. Ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.


Stakeholder Management\-Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and regional teams to ensure seamless integration of processes. Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on payroll and HR operational strategies. Risk \& Compliance\-Oversee risk management frameworks for payroll and HR services.


Your Future at Kyndryl
  

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required Skills and Experience:**

* MBA with 15 years of experience
* Agile \& Continuous Improvement Mindset: Six Sigma Black Belt Certification, Change Management Professional (CCMP), Project management (PMP) or RPA Certification
* A change agent: Adopting and implementing strategies to improve adherence to global processes including having knowledge of industry best practices. Adapt AI skills and technologies to drive automation and efficiency.
* Communication \& Training: Excellent written and verbal communication to effectively interact with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Hands On ability to design and write policies, procedures and job aid documentation. Educate teams on new payroll processes and technologies to ensure adoption.
* Payroll Compliance \& Risk Management: Stay updated on global, regional, and local payroll laws to ensure compliance. Implement internal controls and audits to mitigate compliance risks. Implement forensic payroll audits to identify fraud risks.
* Data Security \& Privacy: Ensure payroll data adheres to GDPR, SOC 1, ISO 27001, and other security roles/standards and organizational guidelines.
* Technology and Automation: Lead the adoption of cloud\-based HR solutions.
* SLAs \& KPIs and Data Analytics: Track accuracy, efficiency, cycle times, employee experience and compliance.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Excellent Communication skills

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
