title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Job Purpose

To manage and support the day\-to\-day HR operations of the hospital, including recruitment, manpower planning, employee records, attendance, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, employee relations, training, performance management, and NABH\-related HR documentation. The role requires coordination with clinical and non\-clinical departments to ensure effective workforce management and compliance with hospital policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for clinical, nursing, paramedical, administrative, and support staff.
* Coordinate with HODs regarding approved manpower requirements and vacancies.
* Source, screen, shortlist, and schedule candidates for interviews.
* Coordinate offer release, salary approvals, joining, and induction.
* Conduct document verification and background verification as applicable.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and manpower status reports.

2\. HR Operations \& Employee Records

* Maintain accurate employee personal files and HRMS records.
* Ensure completion of joining documentation and statutory forms.
* Issue and maintain HR\-related letters, including appointment, confirmation, transfer, promotion, warning, and relieving letters.
* Coordinate probation reviews and employee confirmations.
* Maintain confidentiality and proper custody of employee records.
* Handle employee separation and exit documentation.

3\. Attendance, Leave \& Payroll Coordination

* Monitor biometric attendance, duty rosters, late coming, absenteeism, permissions, overtime, and leave records.
* Coordinate with HODs to resolve attendance and roster discrepancies.
* Verify attendance and leave data before submission for monthly payroll processing.
* Coordinate payroll inputs relating to new joiners, resignations, LOP, overtime, incentives, allowances, and deductions.
* Support Full and Final Settlement processes.

4\. Statutory Compliance

* Coordinate and maintain compliance related to PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, Gratuity, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, challans, returns, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with consultants and external agencies for statutory compliance activities.
* Support labour inspections, internal audits, and compliance reviews.

5\. Employee Relations \& Discipline

* Address employee queries, grievances, and workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
* Coordinate grievance handling and employee welfare activities.
* Support disciplinary actions and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Ensure employees follow hospital rules, policies, and code of conduct.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify key employee\-relations concerns.

6\. Training \& Development

* Coordinate employee induction and orientation programs.
* Assist in conducting Training Need Analysis (TNA).
* Coordinate departmental and mandatory training programs.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance, feedback, and training records.
* Support evaluation of training effectiveness.

7\. NABH \& Hospital Compliance

* Maintain HR\-related documents and records required for NABH and other hospital audits.
* Support documentation related to recruitment, induction, training, competency assessment, employee records, and performance evaluation.
* Coordinate with departments for closure of HR\-related audit observations.
* Ensure required employee documentation is readily available during internal and external assessments.

8\. Performance Management

* Coordinate probation and confirmation evaluations.
* Support the performance appraisal process.
* Maintain appraisal and performance\-related records.
* Coordinate with HODs regarding performance improvement and training requirements.

9\. HRMS \& MIS Reporting

* Ensure accurate and timely updation of employee data in HRMS.
* Prepare and maintain HR MIS and management reports.
* Track manpower, recruitment, absenteeism, attrition, attendance, overtime, and employee movement.
* Maintain HR dashboards and trackers as required by management.

10\. Employee Engagement \& Welfare

* Coordinate employee engagement and recognition activities.
* Support employee welfare initiatives.
* Assist in improving employee communication and workplace culture.
* Coordinate with concerned departments for employee\-related facilities and welfare requirements.

Qualifications

* **MBA – Human Resources / MSW (HR) / PGDM in HR or equivalent**
* Additional qualification in Labour Laws or Hospital Administration will be an advantage.

title: ERP Sales & Business Analyst
description:
**Experience:** Freshers and experienced candidates can apply  
**Work Type:** Field Sales / Client Visits

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and business\-oriented **ERP Sales \& Business Analyst** who can identify potential customers, understand their business requirements, and present ERP solutions that address their operational needs.

This is a **field\-based role**, where the candidate will be required to visit businesses and meet clients/customers in person to understand their requirements and **conduct live ERP product demonstrations**.

Key ResponsibilitiesERP Sales \& Lead Generation

* Identify businesses that can benefit from ERP solutions for **Accounting, Trading, Payroll, Sales \& Distribution, and Inventory**.
* Generate leads through calls, meetings, online channels, and direct client visits.
* Visit prospective clients and conduct **face\-to\-face product demonstrations**.
* Explain ERP features, modules, benefits, and suitability according to the client's business.
* Follow up with prospects and convert leads into customers.
* Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.

Client Onboarding \& Support

* Guide new customers through account creation and ERP implementation/onboarding.
* Explain modules such as accounting, payroll, inventory, and sales management.
* Ensure customers understand the basic functionality and usage of the ERP.
* Maintain regular communication with clients during the onboarding process.

Business Requirement Analysis

* Understand the client's business processes, workflows, and operational challenges.
* Identify gaps and recommend suitable ERP solutions.
* Map customer requirements with the relevant ERP modules and features.
* Collect client feedback and improvement requirements.

Business \& Market Analysis

* Identify market opportunities and industries with demand for ERP solutions.
* Research competitor ERP products, features, and pricing.
* Track customer requirements and market trends.
* Suggest potential features or modules based on market demand.

Coordination with Product Team

* Communicate customer requirements and feedback to the internal product/development team.
* Share suggestions for improving ERP usability and functionality.
* Coordinate internally to ensure customer requirements are properly understood.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Accounting, Inventory, and Business Operations**.
* Understanding of ERP systems or business software.
* Strong **sales, negotiation, and convincing skills**.
* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to confidently present and demonstrate software **in front of clients/customers**.
* Ability to understand business processes and identify customer requirements.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and reporting**.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and demonstrations.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working in a target\-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualification

* BCA / MCA
* MBA
* Finance / Business Management or related qualification

Candidates with experience in **ERP sales, accounting software, software sales, business consulting, or B2B sales** will be preferred.

**Freshers with strong communication, presentation, and sales skills are also encouraged to apply.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new ERP clients acquired.
* Product demo\-to\-conversion ratio.
* Client onboarding success rate.
* Monthly ERP subscription revenue.
* Number and quality of client feedback/product improvement suggestions.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **confident, presentable, persuasive, and comfortable meeting clients face\-to\-face**. If you enjoy interacting with businesses, understanding their requirements, presenting software solutions, and converting prospects into customers, this role is a good fit for you.

**Apply now with your updated resume.**

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Solutions Analyst based in India.**
 This is a data\-driven opportunity for an analytical professional who enjoys turning complex information into practical business solutions. You will analyze operational and customer data to uncover trends, identify risks, and generate actionable insights for key accounts. The role combines business analysis, problem\-solving, project coordination, and process improvement in a fast\-paced e\-commerce environment. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to improve operational efficiency and enhance the customer experience. Your ability to anticipate issues and translate data into clear recommendations will directly influence business outcomes. This remote position is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams.
   

  

**Accountabilities**

* Develop new reporting and analytical solutions that provide ongoing insights and strengthen client engagement with the services offered.

* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work accurately across multiple priorities and large datasets.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines and deliverables in a remote environment.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, and consistently follow through on commitments.

title: Computer Vision Engineer II (Microscopy Imaging)
description:
#### **Join us and contribute to the discovery of medicines that will impact lives!**


### **Location: Hyderabad, India**

### **Experience: Freshers to 5 Years**

### **About Aganitha**


**Accelerate drug discovery and development for Biopharma and Biotech R\&D with** ***in silico*** **solutions leveraging Computational Biology \& Chemistry, High throughput Sciences, AI, ML, HPC, Cloud, Data, and DevOps.**

*In silico* solutions are transforming the biopharma and biotech industries. Our cross\-domain science and technology team of experts embark upon and industrialize this transformation. We continually expand our world\-class multi\-disciplinary team in Genomics, AI, and Cloud computing, accelerating drug discovery and development. What drives us is the joy of working in an innovation\-rich, research\-powered startup bridging multiple disciplines to bring medicines faster for human use. We are working with several innovative Biopharma companies and expanding our client base globally. Read about how and what solutions we build.

*Aganitha (अगणित): “countless” or “limitless” in Sanskrit serves as a reminder and inspiration about the limitless potential in each one of us. Come join us to bring out your best and be limitless!*

  


### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to design and develop custom algorithms for microscopy and biomedical image analysis. You will build end\-to\-end image analysis pipelines, work with cutting\-edge deep learning and vision foundation models, and collaborate closely with biologists, scientists, and AI researchers to solve real\-world imaging challenges.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design and develop custom computer vision algorithms using Python, OpenCV, and deep learning frameworks for microscopy image analysis.
* Build end\-to\-end image analysis pipelines tailored to microscopy workflows, from raw acquisition to quantitative output.
* Work with diverse microscopy modalities, including Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Fluorescence, Confocal, and other light/electron microscopy datasets.
* Develop solutions for cell and tissue segmentation (including instance and semantic segmentation), cell/organelle detection, tracking, and morphological feature extraction.
* Design algorithms for image enhancement, denoising, deconvolution, and artifact correction specific to microscopy data (e.g., uneven illumination, photobleaching, low\-light noise).
* Build quantitative image analysis tools for measuring cell counts, morphology, intensity, colocalization, and other biologically relevant metrics.
* Design and implement custom algorithms rather than relying solely on off\-the\-shelf microscopy software tools (e.g., ImageJ/Fiji, CellProfiler), where custom solutions offer greater accuracy or flexibility.
* Leverage, adapt, and fine\-tune modern deep learning and vision foundation models (e.g., segmentation foundation models, self\-supervised models) for microscopy\-specific applications.
* Handle large\-scale, high\-dimensional microscopy data (multi\-channel, z\-stacks, time\-lapse) efficiently, including preprocessing and pipeline optimization.
* Collaborate with biologists, microscopists, and AI researchers to translate experimental imaging needs into robust computational solutions.
* Evaluate, validate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for accuracy, robustness, and computational performance on microscopy datasets.


### **Qualifications, Skills \& Candidate Profile**

* B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* **Experienced candidates (2\-5 years) are welcome to apply.**
* Strong programming skills in Python and hands\-on experience with OpenCV.
* Good understanding of Computer Vision, Image Processing, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning, with a focus on microscopy image analysis.
* Experience implementing, training, and evaluating deep learning models using PyTorch or similar frameworks, ideally applied to cell/tissue imaging tasks.
* Familiarity with modern vision architectures such as CNNs, Vision Transformers (ViTs), segmentation models (e.g., U\-Net, Mask R\-CNN, Cellpose, StarDist), and vision foundation models (e.g., SAM) as applied to microscopy.
* Knowledge of cell/tissue/organelle segmentation, feature extraction, image enhancement, denoising, and custom image processing pipeline development for microscopy data.
* Hands\-on exposure to microscopy imaging modalities such as Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Fluorescence, or Confocal microscopy is preferred.
* Familiarity with tissue staining image data coming from sectioning
* Experience through industry projects, academic research, internships, thesis work, or personal projects involving microscopy or cell imaging data.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and research skills, particularly in interpreting biological/imaging data.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
We are looking for a
 **Software Test Engineer with 1–2 years of experience**

* Perform functional, regression, and integration testing of applications.

* Log, track, prioritize, and follow up on defects using tools such as JIRA or Azure DevOps.

* Perform integration validation across applications, services, APIs, or connected components.
* Prepare and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test data, and test execution reports.

* Collaborate with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve defects.
* Participate in defect triage, release discussions, and Agile ceremonies.
* Ensure testing activities are completed within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.

title: Intermediate Software Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As an Intermediate Software Engineer in GitLab's Security section, you'll contribute to the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities. You'll design and develop well\-scoped features within the systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third\-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.
   

  

 You'll work with clear context and strong support from the Senior Software Engineers and Staff Software Engineers around you. You'll stay hands\-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services while building depth in PostgreSQL and a specialized security domain. Over time, you'll grow toward owning larger and more ambiguous pieces of work.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop, and ship well\-scoped features within the systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, improving data\-ingestion reliability and query performance as measured by defined reliability and query\-performance metrics.
* Work on the PostgreSQL data layer that supports vulnerability and dependency management, developing your database skills alongside engineers with deep expertise.
* Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust as the team expands beyond the monolith.
* Contribute to integrations with key third\-party security systems.
* Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, asking questions early and raising constraints as you find them.
* Collaborate with product and engineering partners on the details of your deliverables.
* Deliver iteratively within GitLab's monthly release cycle and communicate progress clearly.
* Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Professional backend engineering experience shipping features to production as part of a collaborative team.
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including indexes, query plans, and schema design, and an interest in developing this into a specialization.
* Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, or Python, plus comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day and an interest in working across languages and services.
* Experience taking a feature from description through production and asking clear questions early when requirements are ambiguous.
* Clear written communication and comfort working remotely and asynchronously across time zones.
* An interest in the security domain. Experience with vulnerability management, dependency management, or security tooling is helpful, and we welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.
* Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery and accelerate your learning while applying sound engineering judgment.


**About The Team**
 The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab. We work with clear goals and shared priorities: you'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.

5\. Team Coordination

* Follow up with recruiters and Team Leads regarding assigned tasks.
* Maintain basic task/status trackers.
* Help ensure important internal deadlines are met.
* Coordinate meetings and internal discussions.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding employee and business information.

6\. Events \& External Meetings

* Accompany founders to selected client meetings, networking events and business events.
* Assist with registrations and event coordination.
* Help collect business cards/contact information and potential leads.
* Maintain event follow\-up information.
* Represent Hiringlabs professionally when accompanying founders.

7\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Prepare basic Excel/Google Sheets trackers.
* Prepare meeting summaries and follow\-up lists.
* Assist with presentations, reports and business documents.
* Maintain organized digital records.
* Prepare daily/weekly status updates when required.

Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written English.
* Confidence in making professional calls.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good organizational ability.
* Proactive and energetic personality.
* Ability to multitask.
* Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, Word/Google Docs and email.
* Professional appearance and behaviour.
* Willingness to attend business events and external meetings.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

Freshers

Freshers are welcome to apply.

For freshers, we will focus more on:

* Communication
* Confidence
* Energy
* Ownership
* Learning ability
* Common sense
* Professionalism
* Follow\-up ability

Prior EA experience is not mandatory.

What You Will Learn

The role provides direct exposure to:

* Entrepreneurship
* Business development
* Client management
* Sales
* Operations
* Corporate meetings
* Networking
* Business events
* Founder\-level decision\-making

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate should gradually become someone the founders can depend on to say:

**“I’ll take care of it.”**

The objective is to reduce the founders’ time spent on coordination, reminders, scheduling and routine follow\-ups so they can focus more on business growth, clients, strategy and revenue.

Important Requirements

* Comfortable with Work From Office.
* Comfortable making frequent calls.
* Comfortable attending events and meetings with founders.

* Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
* Should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.

title: Marketing and Social Media Intern
description:
**Marketing \& Social Media Intern \- Nufyt**  
**Kolhapur \| On\-site \|** 

**About Nufyt**

Nufyt is a clean\-label, plant\-based protein brand. Our products are live on Amazon, Blinkit, and our own site, shipping to customers across India.

We're built out of Kolhapur \- not Mumbai, not Bengaluru. That's unusual, and it's the point. You get to work on a national consumer brand without leaving home, and you get to see how one actually gets built, from formulation to packaging to the ad someone sees at 11pm.

**The role**

We're hiring **Marketing \& Social Media Interns** to join the core team. This is not a fetch\-coffee internship and it's not a "post on Instagram twice a week" internship. You'll work directly with the founder on what Nufyt says, shows, and sounds like every single day.

**What you'll do**

* Plan and produce content for Instagram \- reels, carousels, stories
* Spot trends and turn them into Nufyt content fast, without it feeling forced
* Write captions, hooks, and copy that sound like a person, not a brand deck
* Build simple content systems \- a calendar, a shot list, a reusable format \- so output stays consistent
* Track what worked: saves, shares, watch time, and feed that back into what we make next
* Help with community \- replying to DMs and comments, talking to customers
* Support product launches, campaigns, and offline events
* Take real 0→1 creative decisions alongside the founder

**Who we're looking for**

* You have taste. You notice when something is well\-made and can say why.
* You execute fast. A rough reel out today beats a perfect one next week.
* You understand content beyond aesthetics \- storytelling, recall, community, brand.

title: Agent Engineer
description:
The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do.
   

  

 The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest\-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive.
   

  

 The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation.
   

  

 We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.
   

  

 And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable.
   

  

**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is India's leading full\-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose\-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice\-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top\-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
   

  

****What this role promises you****
**Production, at real scale**
 Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days.
   

  

**You work at the source**
 Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. When a deployment needs something that does not exist yet, whether that is model behaviour, an infrastructure capability or a product change, you are not filing a ticket with a vendor and waiting on a roadmap. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes.
   

  

**A genuinely broad surface**
 Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship.
   

  

****What you'll do****
* Build production agents on the Sarvam stack: prompts, system design, workflows, tool integrations, and evals.
* Map the space the agent has to cover. Work out the scenarios that matter, how each should be handled, and where the edges are, so coverage is designed rather than discovered later.
* Build the proof of concept when a customer wants to see it work before committing at scale, and get to a convincing result fast.
* Integrate into systems that were never designed for this: core banking, CRM, ticketing, telephony, and whatever else the customer runs.
* Own quality end to end. Define what good means for the use case, build the evals that measure it, and close the gap until the numbers hold.
* Engineer agents like software. Version them, review them, and hold them to a regression suite, so quality does not depend on who last edited a prompt.
* Tune for the constraints that decide whether a system survives production: accuracy, cost, reliability, and performance under real load.
* Design for scale and consistency from the outset. Systems that behave the same on the hundred\-thousandth interaction as the first, and that are instrumented well enough for anyone to see when they are not.
* Take a proven pattern into a new customer and make it fit their environment, at pace and at quality.
* At senior levels, own the technical build playbooks and the technical quality bar for a motion, and bring partner engineers up to it.


****Who you are****
 We are hiring across levels, from 3\+ years of experience. What matters more than years is whether you have built something real users depended on and kept it working.
   

  

* You have shipped to production and owned it afterwards. Not just built it. Kept it running, fixed it at 11pm, and let real usage change your assumptions.
* You have worked with LLMs and agents seriously. Context engineering, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and the failure modes that only show up at scale. You have used agentic frameworks and both open and closed source models.
* You bring engineering discipline to AI. You think in versions, tests, regressions and reproducibility. You are uncomfortable when a system's behaviour depends on a prompt nobody can account for.
* You take evals seriously. You can define metrics that matter for a use case, build the pipeline, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise.
* Strong Python and range across the stack. Backend services, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure. When you meet an unfamiliar stack you pick it up in hours.
* You design for the long run. You build systems that hold their behaviour over months, not just on launch day: predictable under real load, instrumented so problems are visible, and structured so someone else can reason about them.
* You can sit with a customer's engineering team. Understand their constraints, explain yours, and get to a workable answer without either side losing patience.


*Sarvam is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics. We believe the best AI for India can only be built by a team that reflects India.*

**Company:** Hyperreality Technologies **Location:** Bengaluru (On\-site) **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM **Experience:** 1–2 Years B2B Sales (Mandatory) **Joining:** Immediate

**About Hyperreality Technologies**

Hyperreality Technologies builds an AI\-powered mixed\-reality platform for industrial worker training — combining VR simulation with AI\-guided real\-world practice through smart glasses and computer vision, plus a no\-code authoring layer for factory trainers.

We hold a granted Indian patent for our platform, have reached TRL\-9 (fully deployed, production\-ready) status, and have been recognized by NASSCOM Emerge 50, the Meta Accelerator, and the UK Government's Global Entrepreneur Programme.

We work with leading names across automotive, heavy industries, aerospace \& defence, and manufacturing. *\[Note: confirm which client names you're comfortable listing publicly before this goes live — e.g. "trusted by leading automotive and industrial manufacturers" vs. naming specific accounts.]*

This is a company with real IP, real deployments, and real enterprise traction — not an early\-stage concept pitch.

**Role Overview**

We're hiring a Business Development Manager to own new enterprise business generation for our industrial VR/AR platform. This is a client\-facing, quota\-carrying role — you'll be identifying and closing deals with manufacturing, industrial, and enterprise accounts, not managing social media.

You should be confident engaging with plant heads, L\&D leaders, and procurement decision\-makers, comfortable running a consultative B2B sales cycle, and motivated by a role with real commission upside as you build a book of business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, qualify, and generate new B2B business opportunities through outreach, referrals, LinkedIn, industry events, and field visits
* Run client meetings, product demonstrations, and presentations for manufacturing/industrial decision\-makers
* Understand client training and operational challenges and position our platform against measurable ROI
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders through a multi\-month enterprise sales cycle
* Prepare proposals and commercial offers; negotiate pricing and close deals
* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and customer records in CRM
* Identify upsell, renewal, and referral opportunities within existing accounts

*(Nice to have, not core to the role: occasional support on LinkedIn content or trade show presence — this is a sales role first.)*

**Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 1–2 years of B2B sales experience — freshers will not be considered
* Experience selling into Manufacturing, Industrial, Engineering, Technology, SaaS, or Automation sectors strongly preferred
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Demonstrated ability to generate leads, run client meetings, and close deals independently
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, demos, and industry events

**Preferred**

* Existing network within the Bengaluru/Karnataka manufacturing or industrial ecosystem
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar)
* Own vehicle

**Compensation \& Growth**

· **Compensation**: ₹6–8 LPA (fixed \+ variable), based on experience and performance

· **Deal\-based bonus:** Uncapped commission on every deal you close, on top of the above

**Why Join Us**

* Own enterprise deals with marquee industrial and automotive clients from day one
* Work directly with the founding team at a patented, TRL\-9, award\-recognized deep\-tech company
* Uncapped earning potential tied directly to what you close
* Real ownership in a fast\-moving startup environment

Job Description – Agriculture Officer (Trainer)

**Job Title:** Agriculture Officer (Trainer)  
**Location:** Raipur, Chhattisgarh  
**Department:** Training \& Field Development  
**Company:** Dhanwantari  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Training Head

Job Purpose

The Agriculture Officer (Trainer) will be responsible for conducting agricultural training programs, providing technical guidance to farmers and field teams, and supporting the promotion and effective use of the company's agricultural products and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct training programs, seminars, workshops, and demonstrations for farmers, distributors, and field staff.
* Provide technical knowledge and guidance on:
* Crop management
* Soil health and fertility
* Organic and sustainable farming
* Pest and disease management
* Fertilizers, nutrients, and agricultural inputs
* Modern agricultural practices
* Demonstrate the proper application and benefits of company products at the field level.
* Plan and conduct farmer meetings, village\-level awareness programs, and agricultural camps.
* Develop training materials, presentations, technical notes, and product information in simple and understandable language.
* Visit farms regularly to understand crop conditions, farmer requirements, and agricultural challenges.
* Provide practical solutions and recommendations based on field observations.
* Train the sales and network team on product knowledge and agricultural concepts.
* Coordinate with distributors, sales leaders, and local agricultural stakeholders for training activities.
* Collect feedback from farmers and field teams regarding product performance.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly activity reports.
* Maintain records of training programs, farmer participation, field visits, and demonstrations.
* Support the company's business development activities through technical expertise and farmer engagement.

Educational Qualification

* B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture / Diploma in Agriculture or equivalent qualification.
* Additional specialization in Agronomy, Horticulture, Soil Science, Plant Protection, or Organic Farming will be preferred.

Experience

* Minimum **1–3 years of experience** in agriculture training, field extension, agri\-input sales, farmer advisory, or related activities.
* Freshers with strong agricultural knowledge and excellent training skills may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of agriculture and crop management practices.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to train and interact effectively with farmers and field teams.
* Knowledge of local crops and agricultural practices in Chhattisgarh.
* Ability to conduct field demonstrations and practical training.
* Good command of Hindi; knowledge of English is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, PowerPoint, and reporting.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Raipur and nearby districts.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of training programs conducted.
* Number of farmers and field personnel trained.
* Number of field visits and product demonstrations completed.
* Training participant feedback and engagement.
* Improvement in product knowledge among the sales/network team.
* Timely submission of activity and field reports.
* Contribution to farmer engagement and business growth.

Employment Type

**Full\-Time**

Preferred Candidate

A passionate agriculture professional who enjoys working directly with farmers, conducting training programs, travelling to rural areas, and providing practical agricultural solutions.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**Position:** Inside Sales Representative (ISR)  
**Department:** Business Development / Student Success  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Hyderabad – Work from Office

About Corizo

Corizo is an EdTech company focused on helping students bridge the gap between academics and industry through practical training, internships, and career development programs.

We work with students to understand their career interests, introduce them to relevant opportunities, and support them in making informed decisions about their professional journey.

About the Role

We are looking for a **friendly, confident, and enthusiastic Inside Sales Representative** who enjoys talking to people and helping students explore career opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **communication, interacting with students, understanding their needs, and guiding them toward the right learning opportunities**.

You don't need to be an expert salesperson when you join us. We provide the necessary training, product knowledge, and support to help you become confident in your role.

What You Will Do

* Connect with students and young professionals through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and online meetings.
* Have meaningful conversations with students about their education, interests, and career goals.
* Understand their requirements and suggest relevant Corizo programs.
* Explain our training, internship, and career development programs in a simple and clear way.
* Answer student questions and help them understand the benefits of different programs.
* Follow up with students who are interested and continue the conversation.
* Build a good relationship with prospective students and provide a positive experience.
* Maintain basic information about conversations and follow\-ups in our CRM.
* Work closely with the team to ensure students receive the right information and support.
* Learn about new programs, industry trends, and career opportunities.
* Participate in regular training and team activities to improve your communication and professional skills.

Who Can Apply?

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Candidates with **0–2 years of experience** in sales, customer support, counselling, business development, or similar roles can apply.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to speak with people.
* Comfortable communicating in English.
* Knowledge of Telugu/Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage.
* Basic knowledge of computers and Google Workspace/MS Office.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work from our **Hyderabad office**.

What We Look For

You will be a good fit if you are:

* Comfortable talking to new people.
* A good listener who understands what others need.
* Confident and positive in your communication.
* Curious to learn about careers, technology, and education.
* Good at building relationships.
* Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Someone who enjoys working with a supportive team.
* Interested in developing a career in **Business Development, Inside Sales, Student Counselling, or Customer Success**.

What You Get at Corizo

* **Structured training** to help you understand the role and products.
* **Sales and communication training** to build your professional confidence.
* Support from experienced team members.
* Opportunity to interact with students and young professionals.
* Learning environment with regular feedback and guidance.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Recognition for good work and contributions.
* Career growth opportunities based on your skills and performance.
* Opportunity to develop strong communication, negotiation, counselling, and relationship\-management skills.
* A collaborative and energetic work environment.

Career Growth

**Inside Sales Representative → Senior ISR → Coordinator → Associate Team Lead (ATL) → Team Lead (TL) → Senior Team Lead (STL) → Manager → Senior Manager → Vertical Head**

Why Join Us?

At Corizo, this is more than just a calling role.

You will get the opportunity to **talk to students, understand their aspirations, help them explore career opportunities, and develop professional skills that can support your long\-term career growth.**

If you are someone who enjoys **talking to people, learning new things, and growing with a team**, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Corizo – Learn. Connect. Grow.**

description:
Job Title: PM Surya Ghar Installation Site Engineer / Site Executive (Solar)

**Location:** As Per Project Sites  
**Industry:** Solar EPC / Rooftop Solar  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a dedicated **PM Surya Ghar Installation Site Engineer/Site Executive** to oversee rooftop solar installation projects under the **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana**. The candidate will be responsible for site inspections, installation supervision, quality control, client coordination, safety compliance, and project completion within the assigned timeline.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct pre\-installation site surveys and assess project feasibility.
* Supervise rooftop solar panel installation and commissioning activities.
* Coordinate with installation teams, electricians, vendors, and project managers.
* Ensure installations comply with PM Surya Ghar guidelines and company quality standards.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion.
* Verify mounting structures, inverter installation, wiring, earthing, and safety measures.
* Coordinate net metering documentation and support DISCOM inspections.
* Maintain daily site reports, installation records, and progress updates.
* Resolve on\-site technical issues efficiently.
* Ensure compliance with electrical and workplace safety standards.

 Our cloud\-native, AI\-driven platform is built for speed, efficiency, and uncompromised security. In our fast\-paced environment, we value Extreme Ownership, high technical craftsmanship, and an unwavering commitment to shipping reliable software at startup velocity.
   

  

**About The Delivery Engineering Team**
 At our core, the Delivery Engineering team sits at the high\-velocity intersection of core product expansion, client go\-lives, and production resilience. We don't believe in traditional silos where backend engineers, frontend developers, and post\-production support live on isolated islands. Instead, we operate as an agile, high\-leverage SWAT team. We own features end\-to\-endfrom drafting initial code across the stack to deploying in staging/UAT and solving production issues at their root.
   

  

**What "AI as a First Principle" Means at the SDE 2 Level :**
 For an SDE 2, AI\-first engineering goes beyond individual speedit is about architectural leverage and team amplification. You use AI assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, custom LLM workflows) not just to write features faster, but to audit system architectures, refactor complex legacy codebases, automate testing strategies, and review AI\-generated pull requests across your pod.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural \& Design Leadership : Design scalable, robust full\-stack solutions and custom integrations built on top of core product architecture without introducing technical debt.
* Full\-Stack Execution : Own complex client go\-live features end\-to\-end across frontend and backend systems, driving code seamlessly from design to staging/UAT and production.
* System Guardrails \& Quality : Establish low\-level and high\-level design standards for the delivery pod, ensuring systems are built for high availability, security, and low latency.
* Mentorship : Guide and mentor 12 junior software engineers within your delivery pod, elevating their technical craftsmanship, problem\-solving, and AI\-prompting techniques.
* Code Review \& Auditing : Serve as the technical gatekeeper for code submitted by the pod. Critically review AI\-generated outputs for edge\-case vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, and structural cleanliness.
* Deep\-Dive Troubleshooting : Lead post\-production incident triage and bug resolution. Use AI tools to quickly navigate complex codebases, trace root causes, and deploy permanent architectural fixes.


**Technical Qualifications**
* Experience : 1\-6 years of hands\-on software development experience.
* System Design Expertise : Proficiency in High\-Level (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD), microservices architecture, API design (REST/gRPC), relational/non\-relational database design, and caching strategies.
* Full\-Stack Versatility : Hands\-on experience with Java \& Spring Boot (backend) and React / TypeScript (frontend) is preferred.
* Advanced AI Tooling Mastery : Proven capability in leveraging modern AI assistants (Cursor IDE, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT APIs) for complex code refactoring and system\-level audits.
* DevOps \& Infrastructure Awareness : Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP services, CI/CD deployment pipelines, and observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Sentry).


**Leadership \& Behavioral Traits**
* Mentorship Mindset : Passion for coaching junior engineers and conducting growth\-oriented code reviews.
* Extreme Ownership \& First\-Principles Thinking : Ability to step into ambiguous production scenarios and deliver clean, long\-term solutions.
* Bias for Action \& Speed : Focuses on shipping reliable, high\-quality features quickly while maintaining strict engineering guardrails.

There is no existing creative team to inherit work from and no legacy style guide to follow. You will help build both.
   

  

 We are looking for a creative generalist who is genuinely AI\-native — someone who uses Runway, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Flux and Nano Banana as a daily production stack, not as a novelty.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Video \& motion —**
* 4–8 short\-form videos per week for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Meta ads, 8 to 30 seconds
* AI\-generated product films: strap in motion, water, light play, texture close\-ups, wrist\-shot sequences
* Paid ad creative: hook variations, static\-to\-motion, UGC\-style edits, comparison formats
* Voiceover and sound design using ElevenLabs and licensed audio


**Image \& rendering —**
* Product photography retouching and AI enhancement — colour, texture, edge and reflection cleanup
* AI\-generated lifestyle imagery where physical shoots are not economical
* Watch\-and\-strap composites across dozens of watch references
* Product page imagery, size and fitment diagrams, packaging mockups


**UX/UI \& web —**
* Design and iterate the Shopify storefront: home, collection, product and per\-watch\-reference landing pages
* Landing pages for paid campaigns, built to convert
* Mobile\-first every time
* Email and lifecycle design (Klaviyo templates)


**Brand \& graphic design —**
* Apply and extend the brand identity: typography, colour, layout systems, iconography
* Packaging, inserts, warranty cards, care instructions
* Marketplace and trade assets, occasional print


**Required Skills**
* AI video: demonstrable command of at least two of Runway, Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Sora, Luma. You must be able to explain your prompting approach and show iterations, not just finished clips.
* AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana / Gemini image or equivalent, plus the retouching skill to fix what AI gets wrong
* AI audio: ElevenLabs for voiceover and sound; basic music selection and sync
* Adobe: Photoshop and Premiere Pro at a production standard
* Design: Figma — component\-based UI design, prototypes, developer handoff
* Editing craft: pacing, cuts on beat, hook construction in the first 1\.5 seconds, caption and text animation, correct export specs per platform
* Formats: confident switching between 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 without redoing the work each time


**Strongly Preferred**
 After Effects
   

  

* Canva, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve
* Shopify design experience
* basic 3D (Blender, Spline)
* colour grading and LUT work
* having shot and lit product yourself, even on a phone


**What Matters More Than Software**
 An eye for luxury — you can tell why one watch image reads as ₹8,000 and another reads as ₹80,000\. Volume without decay — you can ship six pieces a week that all hold the standard. You take direction on brand, and argue back on craft.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 1–3 years in a D2C brand, agency, content studio, or as a serious freelancer
* A portfolio is mandatory. No portfolio, no interview. Behance, personal site, Drive folder or Instagram are all acceptable.
* Formal design education welcome but not required — self\-taught candidates with a strong portfolio are treated identically

description:
Job Title: Office Admin  
Company: Zik Digital LLP  
Location: Mumbai (On\-site)  
Experience: 0–1 years  
Employment Type: Full\-time / Internship

About Us Zik Digital LLP is a 360° digital marketing agency managing paid media, content, and creative production for clients across jewellery, fashion, furniture, FMCG, and textile B2B. We're looking for a reliable Office Admin cum HR Executive to keep our day\-to\-day operations and people processes running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle day\-to\-day office administration — printouts, courier, stationery/supplies stock, vendor coordination, and general office upkeep
* Manage incoming and outgoing calls, and route them to the right team members
* Maintain office files, records, and documentation (physical and digital)
* Coordinate with vendors for office maintenance, IT/equipment repairs, and housekeeping
* Support meeting/event logistics as needed
* Manage the full onboarding process for new joiners: offer letter, joining formalities, ID/access setup, induction schedule, and welcome kit
* Collect and maintain employee documentation — ID proof, address proof, bank details, emergency contact numbers, and other personal records
* Maintain the employee master data sheet and keep HR records up to date
* Track attendance, leave records, and coordinate with payroll for monthly inputs
* Assist with exit formalities — full \& final settlement documentation, exit checklist, access revocation
* Be the first point of contact for employee queries related to HR and office processes
* Act as the communication link between the team and the Head/Reporting Manager — promptly pass on updates, requests, and important information from the team to the manager
* Come prepared with relevant information/updates before check\-ins with the manager, flagging anything urgent without being asked

Requirements

* Prior experience in office administration and/or HR support role preferred (freshers welcome to apply for the internship track)
* Comfortable with MS Office / Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets)
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to relay information quickly and clearly
* Well\-organized, detail\-oriented, and able to multitask
* Discretion in handling confidential employee information

What We Offer

* Fast\-paced agency environment across diverse client industries
* Direct exposure to HR and operations processes end\-to\-end
* Growth opportunity within the admin/HR function — internship track has potential for full\-time conversion

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

title: Regional HR Service Delivery Manager (APAC)
description:
The Regional HR Service Delivery Manager will play a pivotal role in building and overseeing HR service delivery operations for their assigned region, ensuring client and employee HR tickets and inquiries are resolved accurately and on time as Globalli scales. This role builds the team, infrastructure, and knowledge base needed to support HR service delivery, while navigating global HR rules and client\-specific cases to maintain compliance and adherence to regulatory standards across the region.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


### **Regional HR Service Delivery and Scalability**


* Serve as the regional subject matter expert for HR processes, country\-specific requirements, and client\-specific case handling.
* Establish and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and a knowledge base that enable the team to operate accurately and consistently as headcount and client volume scale.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Payroll Operations, Account Management, Product, Legal, and Risk \& Compliance to enhance HR service delivery and educate internal teams.
* Manage client and employee HR tickets and inquiries, ensuring timely resolution and high client and employee satisfaction.
* Troubleshoot HR service delivery issues and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to reach timely resolutions across multiple employment models.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including case\-handling guides and compliant standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Build out and lead a regional team of HR Delivery Specialists and Employee Relationship Coordinators to support Globalli's growth.

### **HR Service Delivery Compliance, Escalations and Regional Readiness**


* Regional HR service ownership: Oversee Globalli's ability to deliver HR services within the assigned region, aligning operational capacity with business demand.
* Compliance navigation: Apply global and regional HR rules and regulations to client\-specific and cross\-border cases to maintain compliance and adherence to regulatory standards.
* Issue resolution: Investigate and resolve HR service escalations and complex client or employee cases.
* Documentation and reporting: Maintain accurate, audit\-ready documentation of HR service processes, controls, and compliance.
* Regulatory monitoring: Track and interpret HR legislation and regulatory changes, document impacts, and communicate updates to internal teams.

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
**What This Role Is**



By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.



Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.



This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.



You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.


**What Makes This Role Different**



Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.



The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.


**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**



Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.


**What You Own**


**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**


* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations and the Employee Experience**


* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**


* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**


* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**


* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**


* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**



The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.



In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.



By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.



In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.



The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.


**What You Bring**



You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.



You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.



You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.



You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.



Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.


**Why Manifest**



Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.



For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, in the teams it builds and the workforce plan it runs, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.



Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

Daily learning operations support: Coordinate and support routine L\&D activities including training schedules, onboarding learning logistics, LMS tracking, learner communications, training completion follow\-up, and new\-hire learning progress reporting.


### **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Skill\-Based Workshops: Deliver training sessions on customer service, professional communication, and quality standards.

* Refresher Training: Run quarterly skill reinforcement sessions to fix knowledge gaps and maintain high process adherence among existing staff.

**2\. Content Development \& Stakeholder Management**

Experience: 2–4 years of relevant experience in training facilitation and content development, (classroom, virtual, or blended). Up to 10 years of overall working experience (ideally in customer service or a GCC).
