In this role, you will provide hands\-on support for Bradken’s ERP system and associated business applications, helping users resolve issues, maintain system performance and ensure business processes operate smoothly.
 



 Working across support, administration and continuous improvement activities, you’ll contribute to the reliability, security and ongoing enhancement of enterprise applications. Your work will directly support users across the business while helping improve system effectiveness and user experience.
 



  





**In This Role, You Will** 



* Provide first and second\-level support for ERP applications, investigating and resolving incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
* Administer ERP user access, security settings and approved configuration changes to maintain secure and reliable system performance.
* Support business users through troubleshooting, guidance and training to improve system adoption and effective use of ERP applications.
* Assist with ERP testing, upgrades, patching and business change activities while minimising disruption to business operations.
* Monitor ERP jobs, interfaces and scheduled processes, escalating issues appropriately and coordinating with stakeholders and vendors to support resolution.
* Develop support documentation and knowledge articles while identifying opportunities to improve ERP processes, usability and support practices.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* Tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 2\-4 years' experience supporting enterprise business applications, preferably an ERP platform such as Epicor.
* Demonstrated experience investigating, troubleshooting and resolving application incidents and service requests in a production support environment.
* Experience administering ERP user access, security settings and system configuration changes.
* Experience supporting business processes through enterprise applications and assisting end users with issue resolution and system usage.
* Knowledge of IT service management practices, including incident, problem and change management.
* Experience supporting ERP testing, upgrades, patching activities or system enhancements.
* Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, support procedures or knowledge articles.



**Please note:** 
 This role is based in Coimbatore. We are seeking applicants who are currently based in Coimbatore or are willing to relocate to Coimbatore at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
 



  





**Why join Bradken?** 




 At Bradken, you’ll do work that matters. Whatever your role, your contribution helps solve real challenges for our customers and supports safer, more efficient and more sustainable resource operations.
 



 You’ll join a team that values different perspectives, shares expertise and has the courage to challenge how things are done. We support your growth through hands\-on experience, learning and development, and opportunities to work across functions and locations. Safety, respect and wellbeing come first, so you can do your best work and enjoy life beyond it.
 



**We Offer** 



* A safety\-first culture
* Competitive pay and benefits
* Flexible work options, where the role allows
* Learning and development opportunities
* An Employee Assistance Program for you and your family



  





**Our hiring process** 




 As part of our selection process, we may invite you to complete a one\-way video screening at a time that works for you. This helps us provide a fair and consistent experience when working across locations and time zones. If you need an adjustment or an alternative format at any stage, please let us know.
 



  





 Before commencing employment, you will be required to complete a psychometric assessment and a pre\-employment medical, including drug and alcohol testing.
 



 We respectfully request no recruitment agency approaches.
 



  





 Bradken is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing a diverse, inclusive, engaging and flexible environment for our people. All employment decisions are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Job Summary

Responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, breakdown servicing, troubleshooting, and repair of industrial air compressors and related equipment such as air dryers, filters, air receivers, and compressed air systems. The role requires regular customer\-site visits and effective coordination with customers and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend customer breakdown calls and restore equipment with minimum downtime.
* Diagnose mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control\-related faults.
* Troubleshoot issues related to high temperature, low pressure, oil leakage, vibration, overload, and compressor alarms.
* Service and maintain air dryers, filters, air receivers, and other compressed\-air equipment.
* Perform compressor overhauling, component replacement, and repair activities.
* Check compressor performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Read and understand electrical wiring diagrams, P\&ID, technical drawings, and service manuals.
* Identify required spare parts and coordinate with the service/spares team.
* Provide technical guidance and operating instructions to customers.
* Maintain good customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Prepare service reports, job cards, maintenance reports, and breakdown reports.
* Update machine history, service records, and spare\-parts consumption.
* Coordinate with Sales, Spares, Accounts, and Service teams for smooth execution.
* Follow company safety procedures, OEM guidelines, and use appropriate PPE at customer sites.
* Participate in technical training and continuously improve product/service knowledge.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations as required.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of industrial air compressors and compressed\-air systems.
* Good mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
* Knowledge of motors, starters, control panels, sensors, PLCs, and VFDs.
* Ability to read electrical diagrams and technical drawings.
* Good problem\-solving and fault\-diagnosis skills.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Basic computer knowledge for service reporting and documentation.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

Qualification

**Diploma / BE / B.Tech / ITI** in Mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering discipline.

Experience

**2–5 years** of experience in servicing industrial air compressors, air dryers, pumps, or similar industrial equipment. Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may also be considered.

Experience with **Kaeser, Atlas Copco, ELGi, Ingersoll Rand, Kirloskar** or other industrial compressor brands will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Breakdown response time
* First\-time fix rate
* Preventive maintenance completion
* Customer satisfaction
* Service revenue achievement
* Service report submission on time
* Spare\-parts identification and consumption accuracy
* Reduction in repeat breakdowns

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be technically strong, customer\-focused, disciplined, willing to travel, and capable of independently handling compressor service and troubleshooting activities at customer sites.

About the Opportunity

Simplified Management Solutions is expanding its software business and is looking for **Business Development \& Growth Professionals** who can help us take our software products to businesses across India.

We are looking for people who are comfortable speaking with business owners, HR professionals, Accounts teams, retailers, institutions and other decision\-makers, understanding their requirements and introducing them to suitable software solutions.

We are looking for people who can **generate business and drive customer acquisition**.

You may work with us as a:

* Full\-Time Business Development Professional.
* Part\-Time Business Development Professional.
* Freelance Sales Professional.
* Independent Business Associate.
* Customer Acquisition Specialist.
* Software Sales Consultant.
* Business Growth Partner.

Professionals who are already employed may also explore this opportunity as a **side\-income opportunity**, subject to their existing employer's policies and ensuring there is no conflict of interest.

What Will You Be Selling?

You will represent and promote our range of business software solutions, which may include:

* HRMS \& Payroll Software.
* CRM \& Customer Management Software.
* Retail Billing / POS Software.
* Business Management Software.
* ERP / Factory Management Solutions.
* Fleet / Car Rental Management Software.
* Educational / Assessment Software.
* Other customised software solutions developed by our team.

You do not need to be a programmer.

Your primary responsibility is to **understand the customer's business problem and connect that problem with the right software solution**.

Our technical team will support you wherever detailed product or technical discussion is required.

Key Responsibilities1\. Business Development

* Identify potential business customers through personal networking, references, local business contacts, online research, business groups, exhibitions, events and other suitable channels.
* Build and maintain a prospect database.
* Approach business owners, decision\-makers and relevant professionals.
* Understand their current business processes and problems.
* Identify opportunities where our software can provide a practical solution.
* Generate qualified leads and convert them into paying customers.

2\. Customer Acquisition

* Arrange product demonstrations where required.

* Identify opportunities for additional products, modules or services.
* Maintain professional communication after the sale.
* Develop a strong network within the local business community.

4\. Market Development

You will also be expected to think beyond individual sales.

We want people who can help us identify:

* New customer segments.
* New industries.
* New geographical markets.
* New partnership opportunities.
* Business associations and networking groups.
* Consultants, C.A.s, C.S.s, advocates, H.R. consultants and other professionals who can refer customers.

* Software Sales.

* Business Development.
* H.R.M.S. / Payroll Software.

Freelancer / Part\-Time Opportunity

* A strong business network.
* Existing relationships with business owners.
* H.R. / Accounts / Finance contacts.
* Retailer contacts.

* Local business associations.
* Professional networking connections.

you can work with us on a **performance\-based basis** without taking up a conventional full\-time job.

**Find → Approach → Understand → Demonstrate → Follow Up → Convert → Build Relationship → Generate Referrals**

A person who says:

may not be the right fit for this role.

A person who says:

title: Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) – Project Management & Operations
description:
Graduate Management Trainee – Project Management
 
**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 Fresher / 0–1 year
 



**Company:** 
 Aereka Airtech Pvt. Ltd.
   




 About AEREKA
 
 AEREKA is building a next\-generation environmental technology platform focused on outdoor and semi\-outdoor air purification. We are developing a multidisciplinary deep\-tech product that brings together mechanical engineering, airflow and filtration, electronics, sensing, firmware, industrial design, data, AI, manufacturing, and real\-world deployment.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) – Project Management** 
 who wants to build a career at the intersection of
 **technology, engineering execution, product development, and business operations** 
 .
 



  





 This is not a conventional coordination\-only project management role. You will work closely with engineers, product teams, vendors, and leadership to help convert ambitious product goals into structured plans, measurable milestones, and executed outcomes.
   




 What You Will DoProject Planning \& Execution
 * Support end\-to\-end planning and execution of AEREKA's product development programs.
* Convert product and engineering goals into clear milestones, deliverables, timelines, owners, and review checkpoints.
* Track multiple engineering workstreams and ensure activities remain aligned with overall product milestones.
* Identify schedule risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and execution gaps before they become delays.
* Drive follow\-ups and closure of critical action items across teams.


 Cross\-Functional Engineering Coordination
 * Work closely with mechanical, electronics, firmware, testing, product design, AI/software, procurement, manufacturing, and other functions.
* Understand dependencies between different engineering workstreams and ensure teams receive the inputs they need at the right time.
* Act as an execution bridge between engineering teams, project leadership, vendors, and management.
* Support integration planning as individual subsystems move toward complete prototypes.



**You are not expected to be the technical expert in every discipline—but you are expected to understand the problem well enough to ask intelligent questions, identify dependencies, and drive execution.** 



 Project Monitoring \& Management Reporting
 * Maintain project plans, milestone trackers, action trackers, risk registers, and execution dashboards.
* Track planned versus actual progress and identify schedule deviations.
* Prepare concise daily, weekly, and milestone\-level management updates.
* Distinguish between activity and actual deliverable completion.
* Ensure project reviews are supported by evidence, clear ownership, and measurable next actions.
* Escalate critical blockers and decision requirements with clarity.


 Meetings, Decisions \& Action Closure
 * Participate in engineering, product, and management review meetings.
* Capture decisions, unresolved issues, dependencies, risks, and owner\-wise action items.
* Ensure important discussions are converted into executable next steps.
* Track actions through closure rather than allowing them to disappear after meetings.
* Help maintain visibility on pending decisions that could affect engineering timelines.


 Risk \& Dependency Management
 * Proactively identify technical, procurement, resource, integration, and schedule risks.
* Track cross\-functional dependencies and understand their downstream impact.
* Support teams in resolving blockers quickly.
* Maintain visibility on critical\-path activities and highlight potential timeline slips early.


 Product Development \& Operations
 * Gain exposure to the complete journey of building a deep\-tech hardware product—from concept and engineering validation to prototypes, testing, manufacturing, and deployment.
* Support prototype planning, procurement coordination, testing activities, vendor interactions, and build readiness.
* Help improve engineering execution systems, workflows, documentation practices, and review processes.
* Support the creation of scalable operating processes as AEREKA grows.


 Vendor \& External Partner Coordination
 * Coordinate with suppliers, fabricators, manufacturers, testing partners, consultants, and service providers.
* Track quotations, procurement dependencies, fabrication timelines, deliveries, and external commitments.
* Highlight vendor\-related risks that could affect project schedules.


 AI\-First Project Management
 
 We expect this role to use AI as an everyday productivity and execution tool.
 



 You will use tools such as
 **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and automation platforms** 
 to:
 


* accelerate project planning and documentation;
* convert meetings into structured decisions and action items;
* analyze project updates and identify execution risks;
* automate repetitive reporting and tracking activities;
* improve research and information synthesis;
* create management dashboards and decision\-support systems;
* improve personal and team productivity.



 We value people who can use AI to
 **improve the quality and speed of thinking and execution** 
 , not simply generate documents.
   




 Who Should ApplyEducational Background
 
**Preferred profile:** 



* MBA / PGDM in
 **Operations, Project Management, Strategy, General Management, Technology Management, or a related field** 
 ; and
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline such as:
* Mechanical Engineering
* Mechatronics
* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Instrumentation
* Robotics \& Automation
* Industrial / Manufacturing Engineering
* or another relevant engineering discipline.



**Experience:** 
 Fresh graduates or candidates with up to
 **1 year of relevant experience** 
 are welcome to apply.
 



 Exceptional candidates with a strong engineering background, excellent execution ability, and demonstrated interest in project/product management may also be considered.
   




 What We Look ForStructured Thinking
 
 You can take an ambiguous problem and convert it into clear tasks, priorities, owners, dependencies, and outcomes.
 


 Ownership
 
 You do not stop at "I followed up." You care about whether the required outcome was actually achieved.
 


 Technical Curiosity
 
 You enjoy understanding how products work and are comfortable interacting with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 


 Analytical Ability
 
 You are comfortable working with project data, schedules, metrics, spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured analysis.
 


 Communication
 
 You can communicate clearly with engineers, managers, vendors, and leadership—and can summarize complex situations without unnecessary noise.
 


 Attention to Detail
 
 You can manage multiple moving parts without losing critical commitments, dependencies, or decisions.
 


 Bias for Action
 
 You identify what needs to happen next and actively drive it rather than waiting for repeated instructions.
 


 Learning Agility
 
 You can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, engineering terminology, tools, and workflows.
 


 AI\-First Mindset
 
 You actively experiment with AI and automation tools to improve your own productivity and the productivity of the teams around you.
   




 What You Will Learn
 
 At AEREKA, you will get direct exposure to:
 


* Deep\-tech product development
* Hardware and multidisciplinary engineering programs
* Prototype development and validation
* Project and program management
* Product strategy and execution
* Manufacturing and vendor ecosystems
* Testing and engineering validation
* Cross\-functional leadership
* AI\-enabled project management
* Founder and leadership\-level decision making
* Taking a technology product from concept toward real\-world deployment



 This role is designed for someone who wants to develop into a
 **high\-ownership Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Operations leader, or technology business leader** 
 rather than remain limited to administrative project coordination.
   




 The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here
 
 You will enjoy this role if you:
 


* are deeply curious about technology and physical products;
* like bringing structure to complex situations;
* enjoy working with engineers but also understand business priorities;
* naturally follow problems through until they are closed;
* are comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where not everything is predefined;
* can challenge unclear updates and ask good questions;
* learn quickly and take responsibility early;
* want a steep learning curve rather than a narrowly defined graduate role.



 AEREKA is building a product from the ground up. That means you will encounter ambiguity, changing priorities, engineering failures, difficult trade\-offs, and demanding execution timelines.
 



 For the right person, that is exactly what makes the opportunity valuable.
   




 Apply
 
 Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to
 **sushil@aereka.com** 
 with the subject line:
 



**Application – Graduate Management Trainee (Project Management) – AEREKA**

You will work closely with the **content, social media, design, web development, and digital marketing teams** to improve search rankings, website performance, organic traffic, and overall online visibility.

* Verify dimensions, scales, specifications, and calculations.
* Identify errors or discrepancies before final submission.
* Ensure drawings comply with project requirements and applicable standards.

5\. Documentation \& Record Management

* Maintain proper records of all drawings and revisions.
* Organize approved, revised, and pending drawings.
* Maintain drawing registers and revision history.
* Prepare and submit drawings within the required timelines.
* Ensure the latest approved drawings are shared with the concerned departments.

6\. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with engineers, architects, project managers, and site teams.
* Understand project requirements before preparing drawings.
* Attend meetings related to design and drawing requirements when necessary.
* Communicate drawing changes and revisions to the concerned teams.
* Support the project team with technical drawing\-related information.

* Support the team in calculating dimensions and quantities.
* Prepare basic quantity take\-offs when required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Knowledge of 2D and preferably 3D drafting.

* Knowledge of dimensions, scales, layouts, and measurements.
* Ability to read and understand engineering and construction drawings.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple drawings and projects simultaneously.

* Responsible for completing drawings within deadlines.

title: HR Fresher
description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Core Job Responsibilities
   

  

* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools.
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics.
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work.
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes.


 Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech degree is mandatory
* MBA degree is mandatory
* Freshers are eligible to apply.
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred.

 The selected candidate will gain hands\-on experience in recruitment, candidate sourcing, communication, hiring strategies, and other practical aspects of Talent Acquisition while working in a completely remote environment.

title: Global Finance Planning & Analysis Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


Join the Global Services Finance team – a core part of BCG’s worldwide Finance function. As the Finance
  

Manager, you will work with the teams across Global Services to provide FP\&A and finance business
  

partnering support to the stakeholders.

  

This role is ideal for a finance professional with a curious analytical mindset, strong communication skills,
  

and the ability to drive impact through financial insights and operational improvements.

  

In this role, you will:

* Run financial planning with the respective teams supported, as a part of broader BCG planning

process
  

* Lead monthly reporting, planning, and forecasting processes with accuracy, speed, and insight
* Work with HR counterparts on capacity and compensation planning matters for the areas

supported
  

* Deliver forward\-looking analysis and insights to identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities in the

areas supported
  

* Support the stakeholders with preparation of business cases for any change programs / initiatives

in the areas supported
  

* Connect business requirements and considerations with financial agenda, processes and systems,

navigate the trade\-offs coming out from the dialogues
  

The role reports into the Global Services Finance Senior Director.  

What You'll Bring

* Master’s degree in finance/accounting/economics and/or an MBA is a plus
* A minimum of \~7 years related finance experience
* Good understanding \& experience of working with finance systems (Oracle/SAP, BIR data universe, etc.)
* Strong analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Excel
* Exceptional communication skills – both written and verbal – with the ability to tailor messaging across audiences

and influence senior stakeholders
  

* Demonstrated critical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex issues through

thoughtful analysis
  

* Self\-motivated and proactive, with a strong drive to add value and take ownership in a leadership\-facing role
* Highly organized and adaptable, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Collaborative mindset with a passion for team\-oriented work
* Proven ability to build and manage relationships in a global, matrixed organization

  

Who You'll Work With


The Functional Finance Team is an integral part of the worldwide Finance organization providing insight
  

supported by meaningful and accurate financial information to help guide the decision\-making process and
  

provide strategic business partnering to the Functions. The team partners with BCG’s Global CFO and the
  

Finance Leadership team, the Financial Planning \& Analysis team, the Operations Leadership Team (OLT)
  

including leadership of our Global Functions, and local, regional \& global finance colleagues across the
  

organization.

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Translating data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations
* Managing financial planning cycles end\-to\-end, including variance analysis and scenario modeling
* Communicating clearly, concisely, and credibly with stakeholders across all levels
* Balancing detail orientation with big\-picture thinking
* Building relationships and influencing in a matrixed, global environment
* Thriving in dynamic, fast\-paced, service\-oriented environment
* Building deep expertise in the financials, proactively linking investments to business impact and value delivered
* Partnering with stakeholders to define problems, deliver meaningful analysis, and propose actionable solutions
* Working as part of a team, building consensus
* Applying technical skills to navigate complex financial systems, extract and analyze data across platforms, and

resolve inconsistencies or ambiguity independently  

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.


For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.


We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: HR Manager
description:
**About JLG, An Oshkosh Company**
**JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.**
**HR Manager – India**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 HR Director – International Region
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Human Resources Manager will provide HR support to the company’s small but growing employee population in India. Based in Pune and reporting to the HR Director – International Region, this role will serve as the primary local HR contact for employees and managers in India.
   

  

 The HR Manager will support the implementation of HR strategies and initiatives while establishing and administering locally appropriate HR policies, procedures and practices. With the organization expected to grow significantly in India, the role will have an important focus on talent acquisition, taking a hands\-on role in recruiting and onboarding employees while developing an effective and sustainable local recruitment approach.
   

  

 This is a standalone, hands\-on HR role requiring broad generalist capability, strong knowledge of Indian employment practices and the ability to operate effectively in an environment where local HR processes and procedures are still developing.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
 These duties are not meant to be all\-inclusive and other duties may be assigned.
   

  

* Support the India business by promoting, communicating and implementing HR strategies, programs and initiatives in partnership with the HR Director – International Region.
* Serve as the primary local HR contact for employees and managers in India, building effective relationships and providing practical HR guidance and support across the employee lifecycle.
* Develop, implement and maintain appropriate HR policies, procedures and employment practices for India, ensuring alignment with applicable local requirements and broader company standards.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of Indian employment and labor laws, statutory requirements and employment practices; monitor relevant developments and provide appropriate guidance to management.
* Provide guidance and support on employee relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary matters, grievances, attendance, workplace concerns and employee exits.
* Coach and support managers on effective people management, including performance, development and other employee\-related matters.
* Take a hands\-on role in talent acquisition for the India business, managing recruitment activities for assigned vacancies from role intake and sourcing through candidate selection, offer and onboarding.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements, develop appropriate recruitment strategies, proactively source and assess candidates, and facilitate timely hiring decisions.
* Develop appropriate direct\-sourcing approaches to support current and future hiring requirements, reducing reliance on external staffing agencies where effective internal recruitment can be undertaken.
* Manage relationships with local staffing agencies and recruitment partners, using external resources selectively based on business needs, role complexity and talent availability.
* Establish and maintain effective onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring appropriate employment documentation and a consistent employee experience.
* Support and administer HR programs and processes including compensation, benefits, payroll coordination, performance management, employee development, talent planning and employee engagement.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external service providers as necessary to support payroll, benefits, statutory requirements and other HR\-related services.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and employment documentation in accordance with local requirements and company standards.
* Identify opportunities to establish, develop and continuously improve scalable HR processes and practices as the India employee population grows.
* Partner effectively with regional and global HR colleagues, maintain appropriate confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive employee and business matters.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* Relevant progressive Human Resources experience in a generalist, HR Business Partner, HR Manager or similar capacity.
* Demonstrated experience across multiple HR disciplines, including employee relations, performance management, recruitment and general HR operations.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian employment and labour laws, statutory requirements and employment practices.
* Demonstrated hands\-on recruitment experience, including candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing and managing recruitment processes in partnership with hiring managers.
* Experience advising managers on employee relations and employment\-related matters.
* Experience implementing and/or administering HR policies, procedures and processes.
* Ability to operate independently and manage multiple priorities in a growing and evolving business environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with employees and managers at all levels.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience within a multinational or international organization.
* Experience operating as a standalone HR professional or primary HR contact for a smaller employee population.
* Experience establishing or improving HR policies, processes and procedures within a growing organization.
* Experience supporting an organization through growth, organizational change or the establishment of new operations.
* Experience managing recruitment directly and developing effective direct\-sourcing approaches to reduce reliance on external staffing agencies.
* Experience recruiting professional, technical, engineering and/or other specialist roles within the Indian market.
* Experience within a manufacturing, engineering, technology or related environment.
* Experience coordinating with external payroll, benefits, legal, recruitment or other HR service providers.


**Core Competencies**
* Decision Quality: Makes sound and timely decisions using available information, professional judgment and an understanding of business and employee considerations; recognizes when issues require escalation or specialist input.
* Manages Complexity: Effectively works through multifaceted HR, employment and business issues, identifying key considerations and developing practical solutions in an environment where established local processes may not always exist.
* Action Oriented: Takes initiative and moves work forward with appropriate urgency; comfortable taking personal ownership of both day\-to\-day HR activities and longer\-term priorities in a standalone role.
* Plans and Aligns: Establishes priorities and organizes work effectively to balance immediate operational requirements, recruitment activity and the development of scalable HR processes that support business growth.
* Attracts Top Talent: Partners effectively with hiring managers to identify talent needs and uses appropriate sourcing, assessment and selection approaches to attract and hire high\-quality candidates for the growing India organization.
* Interpersonal Savvy: Relates effectively to people at different levels and from different backgrounds, adapting approach appropriately to build trust, address sensitive employee matters and influence positive outcomes.
* Adaptability \& Collaboration: Comfortable operating in a growing organization with changing priorities and works effectively with colleagues across geographic and functional boundaries.


**Working Conditions**
* Physical Demands: Frequent sitting, hearing, talking, visual activity, typing and manual dexterity. Occasional standing, walking and other general office\-related physical activity.
* Non\-Physical Demands: Frequent analysis and reasoning, communication and interpretation, reading, problem solving, sustained mental activity and preparation of written communications and documentation.
* Environmental Demands: Primarily office\-based working environment. The role may periodically be required to work independently as the primary local HR resource.
* Work Schedule: Regular business hours with occasional flexibility required to participate in meetings with regional and global colleagues across different time zones.
* Travel: Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required based on business needs.
* Demands/Deadlines: Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond to changing business requirements. Periods of increased workload may occur in connection with recruitment activity, employee matters, organizational growth and cyclical HR activities.

description:
HR Manager – Healthcare \& Luxury Services
 
**Company:** 
  Angel Health Centre
 



**Location:** 
  Nariman Point, Mumbai
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
  Longevity \| Aesthetics \| Hospitality
 



**Experience:** 
  5–8 years
 



**Joining:** 
  Immediate / Early Joiners Preferred
 


 About Angel Health Centre
 
 Angel Health Centre is a private, doctor\-led longevity and aesthetics practice located at Nariman Point, Mumbai.
 



 We are building a premium healthcare organisation focused on personalised care, longevity, aesthetics, diagnostics and an exceptional client experience.
 



 As the organisation grows, we are looking for an experienced and highly hands\-on 
 **HR Manager** 
  who can build a strong team, create effective people processes and develop a culture of accountability, professionalism and service excellence.
 


 The Role
 
 The HR Manager will take ownership of the complete employee lifecycle at Angel Health Centre — from identifying and recruiting the right talent to onboarding, performance management, training, engagement, retention and exit management.
 



 This is a hands\-on role suited to someone who enjoys building an organisation rather than simply administering an established HR function.
 



 The individual will work closely with the management and doctors to ensure that Angel attracts, develops and retains high\-quality people who reflect the standards of a premium healthcare organisation.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 * Own end\-to\-end recruitment across clinical, operations, front office, sales, marketing and management roles.
* Understand manpower requirements with management and create hiring plans.
* Source candidates through Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, recruitment consultants, referrals and direct sourcing.
* Screen CVs and conduct first\-level interviews.
* Coordinate management and technical interview rounds.
* Conduct reference and background checks.
* Manage salary negotiations and offer rollouts.
* Build and maintain an active talent pipeline for critical positions.
* Reduce recruitment turnaround time and improve quality of hires.


 2\. Onboarding \& Induction
 * Design and manage a structured onboarding process for every new employee.
* Ensure documentation, policies, systems access and joining formalities are completed.
* Conduct orientation around Angel's culture, standards and expectations.
* Coordinate department\-specific training.
* Establish 30\-, 60\- and 90\-day review processes for new employees.
* Ensure new employees are integrated effectively into the organisation.


 3\. Performance Management
 * Help management establish clear KRAs and KPIs for every role.
* Implement monthly and quarterly performance reviews.
* Track employee performance against defined expectations.
* Work with department heads to identify performance gaps.
* Create Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Develop a transparent appraisal and increment framework.
* Build a performance\-oriented culture with clear accountability.


 4\. Training \& Development
 * Identify training requirements across departments.
* Organise training in areas including:
* Client experience
* Communication
* Grooming and professional conduct
* Sales and consultation conversion
* Service knowledge
* SOP adherence
* Leadership development
* Coordinate external trainers where appropriate.
* Maintain training calendars and employee development records.


 5\. Employee Engagement \& Culture
 * Build a professional, positive and high\-performance work culture.
* Conduct regular employee feedback and engagement initiatives.
* Identify employee concerns before they become retention issues.
* Improve communication between management and employees.
* Recognise and reward high\-performing employees.
* Develop initiatives to improve employee motivation and retention.


 6\. Attendance, Leave \& Payroll Coordination
 * Maintain accurate attendance and leave records.
* Ensure adherence to working hours, weekly offs and leave policies.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with accounts/payroll partners.
* Maintain salary, incentive and employee documentation.
* Resolve employee payroll and attendance queries.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR MIS.


 7\. HR Policies \& SOPs
 * Develop and implement practical HR policies appropriate for a growing healthcare organisation.
* Create employee handbooks, workplace policies and HR SOPs.
* Ensure employees understand and acknowledge organisational policies.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and management information.
* Support management in disciplinary matters and grievance handling.
* Coordinate applicable statutory and employment\-related HR compliance with relevant professional advisers.


 8\. Employee Retention \& Exit Management
 * Monitor employee turnover and identify reasons for attrition.
* Conduct structured stay interviews and exit interviews.
* Recommend retention initiatives for key employees.
* Manage resignation, notice period and handover processes.
* Ensure proper clearance and exit documentation.


 9\. Management Reporting

* Total headcount
* Open positions
* Time taken to hire
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* Employee turnover
* Attendance and absenteeism
* Probation status
* Employee performance
* Training completed
* Employee grievances
* Upcoming manpower requirements

* 5–8 years of progressive HR experience.
* Strong hands\-on recruitment experience.
* Experience independently managing multiple HR functions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong interviewing and candidate assessment capabilities.
* Experience implementing KRAs, KPIs and performance management systems.
* Good understanding of HR operations, attendance and payroll coordination.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee matters with maturity.
* Strong organisational and documentation skills.
* Ability to work directly with founders, doctors and senior management.
* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Comfort working in a fast\-growing organisation where systems and processes are still being built.


 Preferred Industry Background

* Premium healthcare
* Hospitals
* Dermatology / aesthetic clinics
* Cosmetic surgery
* IVF / fertility centres
* Premium dental practices
* Longevity / preventive healthcare
* Luxury hospitality
* Premium wellness organisations
* Other high\-touch luxury service businesses



 Experience in healthcare is preferred but 
 **not mandatory** 
  for an exceptional candidate from luxury hospitality or another premium service environment.
 


 Qualifications
 * Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM / postgraduate qualification in Human Resources preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with HRMS, ATS and recruitment platforms will be advantageous.


 What Success Looks Like
 
 Within the first six months, the HR Manager should be able to:
 


* Establish a structured recruitment system.
* Significantly reduce hiring turnaround time.
* Ensure all employees have defined roles, KRAs and KPIs.
* Implement structured onboarding and probation reviews.
* Establish regular performance reviews.
* Improve attendance and employee accountability.
* Build a training calendar.
* Improve employee retention.
* Establish a reliable HR MIS and monthly management dashboard.
* Help create a culture appropriate for a premium, client\-focused healthcare organisation.


 What Angel Offers
 * Opportunity to build the HR function of a growing premium healthcare organisation.
* Direct exposure to senior management and doctors.
* Significant ownership and decision\-making responsibility.
* Opportunity to recruit and develop a high\-performance team.
* Exposure to the emerging longevity and regenerative aesthetics sector.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and capability.


 Application

**Immediate and early joiners will be given preference.**

description:
**HR Manager – Hiring Requirement** 




  





**Job Title: HR Manager** 




**Location: Shahpur Jat, New Delhi** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time \| Work from Office** 




**Working Days: Monday to Saturday** 




 (1st \& 3rd Saturdays Off)
 



**Working Hours: 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM** 




**Experience: 4\+ Years** 




**Salary: ₹10 – ₹11 LPA** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on
 **HR Manager** 
 to take ownership of the complete employee lifecycle, with a strong focus on talent acquisition, employee experience, culture and people development.
 



 The ideal candidate will work closely with the leadership team to build high\-quality human capital, strengthen HR processes and create a workplace where ambitious talent can thrive.
 



 Recruitment will be a key priority. You will lead hiring initiatives across departments, build strong talent pipelines and take direct ownership of key and senior\-level hires.
 



 You will be supported by a junior HR team member, while overall ownership of HR outcomes, quality and execution will rest with you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment** 



* Lead and drive recruitment initiatives across departments and levels.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines.
* Work closely with leadership and department heads to understand hiring requirements.
* Develop effective hiring strategies aligned with business growth.
* Take direct ownership of critical and senior\-level hiring.
* Guide and supervise the junior HR team member handling day\-to\-day recruitment.
* Improve interview processes, candidate evaluation and overall candidate experience.
* Strengthen the company’s employer brand and attract high\-quality talent.



**2\. Culture \& Employee Experience** 



* Play an active role in shaping and strengthening the organisation’s culture.
* Act as a trusted bridge between employees and leadership.
* Create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and motivated.
* Identify workplace concerns and recommend practical solutions.
* Drive employee engagement and team\-building initiatives.
* Conduct feedback sessions and pulse checks.
* Implement initiatives focused on employee satisfaction and retention.



**3\. Strategic HR Leadership** 



* Lead the overall HR function with a focus on quality, accountability and people development.
* Partner with leadership to understand business growth plans and workforce requirements.
* Develop and improve HR processes, documentation and systems.
* Recommend and implement employee\-centric policies and people management frameworks.
* Draft and manage HR policies, employee communications and official documentation.



**4\. Performance \& People Development** 



* Work with department heads to manage structured performance reviews and feedback processes.
* Support managers in identifying high performers and development opportunities.
* Identify capability gaps and recommend appropriate development initiatives.
* Address underperformance constructively and systematically, including PIPs where required.
* Promote continuous learning and professional development.
* Coordinate internal workshops, learning initiatives and external training programmes.



**5\. Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle** 



* Create a structured and engaging onboarding experience for new employees.
* Oversee induction, documentation, workspace readiness and cross\-team coordination.
* Personally support the onboarding of senior and key hires.
* Ensure smooth and professional employee offboarding.
* Manage employee lifecycle processes effectively from joining to exit.



**6\. HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Oversee employee documentation, attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Ensure HR policies and internal processes are implemented consistently.
* Coordinate employee insurance and relevant HR vendors.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records.
* Support the implementation and improvement of HRMS and other HR systems.



  





**Requirements** 



* **4\+ years of relevant HR experience.**
* Prior experience in an
 **advertising, marketing, creative or communications agency** 
 is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the agency ecosystem, its pace and talent requirements.
* Proven experience in recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Ability to identify quality talent beyond CV and JD matching.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Excellent people management and relationship\-building abilities.
* High ownership, maturity and discretion when handling sensitive matters.
* Hands\-on and solution\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work directly with leadership and build trust across teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in
 **Google Workspace, MS Office, HRMS and other workplace tools.**



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who wants to
 **build, not just manage** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable participating in leadership discussions about organisational growth and stepping in to solve an urgent hiring, employee or people\-related challenge.
 



 If you understand the energy of agency life, enjoy building strong teams and want to take real ownership of an organisation’s people journey, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to take ownership of the complete HR function.
* Direct exposure to leadership and strategic decision\-making.
* Opportunity to shape culture and people processes in a growing agency.
* Significant ownership of talent acquisition and team building.
* Fast\-paced, creative and growth\-oriented work environment.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll build and run our whole People \& Culture function — starting from almost nothing — and turn People into one of the company's real strengths. This is a hands\-on leadership job: senior enough to design the system, close enough to still hire a key person yourself. You'll report to the CEO and own the result, not a task list.
 



  





**What you'll own, end to end:** 



* **Hiring** 
 — build the pipeline, the process, and our name as an employer, so the founders don't have to find people themselves.
* **HR Operations \& Compliance** 
 — keep our HR system clean and current, handle payroll inputs and legal compliance (PF, ESI, POSH), and give every new hire a smooth start.
* **Performance** 
 — set clear goals, run the review cycle, and work with the founders to help every person do their best.
* **Culture \& Engagement** 
 — bring our values to life, keep a pulse on how people feel, and keep attrition low.
* **Learning \& AI** 
 — set up onboarding, run regular training, and get the team using AI in daily work.
* **People \& Team** 
 — plan ahead for hiring, advise the CEO, and build and lead a small People team of 3–5 that grows with the company.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* 20\+ roles closed this year, all top\-quality hires
* HR system clean and current, every offer letter out within 48 hours
* Every employee working to clear quarterly goals, with the first full review cycle done on time
* First engagement survey run with 80%\+ taking part, and attrition held at 15% or below
* Proper onboarding for every hire, AI used across the company, and a quarterly training calendar delivered



  





**Must Have** 



* **You've led and scaled** 
**8–12 years in HR** 
 , with at least 2\-3 years leading a team and helped grow a company's headcount.
* **A hiring track record you can prove** 
 — specific people you've hired, with titles and dates, including a senior role you closed yourself.
* **You've built, not maintained** 
 — set up an HR function from scratch.
* **All\-round HR judgment** 
 — operations, compliance, performance, and culture, not just one part.
* **You know your numbers** 
 — time\-to\-fill, offer acceptance, and attrition, off the top of your head.
* **You're in Kolkata** 
 , or can move here within 30 days.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Structured hiring methods — scorecards and proper reference checks
* Experience running a company on a system like Scaling Up, EOS, or OKRs
* Business sense — you read the commercial side, not just the people side
* AI in your work today — you can show a real way you use it, not just talk about it



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
* **You build it** 
 — the engine you create becomes the backbone of a much bigger team



  





 We hire on values, not just skill — Disciplined Execution · Us Before I · Result Oriented · Inclusive Collaboration · Always Innovating · Numbers that Matter.
 



  





 How We Hire
 



 Simple, fair, and fast — a first call, a detailed interview with the CEO, a values conversation, and reference checks. Every candidate hears back at every stage.
 



**Apply — let's talk.**

Leverage your high\-level expertise to lead and forge partnerships that advance the biotechnical and biopharmaceutical science that can turn the tide of serious, life\-interrupting illnesses.
   

  

**Department Name:** 
 Amgen India – Human Resources
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 The India Payroll Lead is responsible for the strategic leadership and end\-to\-end governance of payroll and HR compliance for Amgen India, supporting a growing workforce across multiple legal entities, including regular employees, international workers and expatriates, as applicable. The role is accountable for the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of payroll and HR compliance services and serves as the country\-level subject\-matter expert for these areas.
   

  

 The India Payroll Lead defines and evolves country payroll and HR compliance standards, policies, controls and operating practices; manages payroll and compliance vendors; and leads major transformation and risk\-mitigation initiatives. The role partners closely with Human Resources, Finance, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Global Mobility, Information Systems and external service providers, and provides guidance and recommendations to senior stakeholders to support business growth and meet statutory and internal requirements across Amgen India legal entities.
   

  

 The role manages and develops two Senior Associates responsible for payroll administration, compliance and standard end\-to\-end payroll activities. As the workforce and legal\-entity footprint grow and Workday integration with the payroll vendor platform reduces manual processing, the role will place increased emphasis on strategic governance, policy and control design, complex issue resolution, data integrity, vendor performance, automation, scalable service delivery and cross\-functional program leadership.
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**
* Lead the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of end\-to\-end payroll and associated HR compliance services for a growing workforce across multiple Amgen India legal entities, covering regular employees, international workers and expatriates, as applicable.
* Oversee payroll cycles, payments, deductions, statutory obligations, tax withholding, payroll reporting, entity\-specific requirements and applicable expatriate\-related payroll inputs.
* Develop, define and maintain country payroll and HR compliance policies, procedures, calendars, controls, service standards and governance processes in alignment with Amgen policies, business objectives and India statutory requirements.
* Oversee payroll inputs and outputs across legal entities, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, incentives, allowances, deductions, statutory contributions, off\-cycle payments and adjustments, ensuring appropriate entity\-level controls and approvals.
* Coordinate payroll activities for international workers and expatriates, including applicable compensation elements, allowances, deductions, tax\-related inputs, shadow payroll requirements and cross\-border stakeholder coordination.
* Provide functional governance over payroll results, reconciliations, control reports and exception items, and direct the resolution of material risks, inaccuracies and processing issues before payroll completion.
* Serve as the India subject\-matter expert and principal escalation point for complex payroll and HR compliance matters, providing guidance and recommendations to senior stakeholders on payroll practices, taxation, statutory requirements, deductions, employee\-related compliance and operational risk.
* Interpret relevant Indian payroll, tax, labor and social\-security requirements, including requirements affecting international workers and expatriates, and translate regulatory changes into practical policies, controls and operating requirements across legal entities.
* Establish and govern the end\-to\-end HR compliance operating framework, including compliance calendars, statutory filings, payments, registrations, documentation, certifications, record retention, ownership and evidence requirements.
* Lead payroll\- and HR\-related internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, compliance reviews and control assessments; coordinate responses with relevant stakeholders and ensure sustainable remediation of identified gaps.

* You handle confidential information with discretion and understand that trust is earned through consistency.
* You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities and know how to stay calm when things get busy.
* You have strong communication skills and enjoy working with people across different teams and levels.
* You're someone who takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs fixing.

 Bangalore

 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team

 It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.
 



  





**Our Purpose**




  





 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
 



  





**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-** 




  




* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together



  





**Our Values**




  





 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
 



  





**We have 5 core values:\-** 



* Go Above And Beyond
* Making Things Happen
* Say It Like It Is
* Progress Over Perfection
* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously



  





**Perks \& Benefits**




  





 Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning \& keep things fun:\-

 Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.

 All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.

 We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* **Salary In Advance \-** 
 Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

 **Senior HR Coordinator** 
 at JumpCloud, you will go beyond traditional administration. You will be a key driver in our HR Shared Services model, owning critical workstreams and leveraging a modern tech stack to create a seamless, scalable employee experience. We are looking for someone who doesn't just follow a process but looks for ways to automate, optimize, and elevate it.
 




  




**What you'll be doing:** 
  

  
* Independently manage and own the end\-to\-end execution of employee lifecycle events, including global onboarding, offboarding, performance management and benefits administration.
  
* Act as the Tier 2 support lead for complex HR operational queries, ensuring high\-quality service delivery across the organization.
  
* Proactively apply and reinforce company and regional policies, ensuring all HR initiatives enable company strategy at a functional level.
  
* Navigate and maintain data integrity across our core platforms: ADP (Workforce Now), Deel, Jira and our HRIS ecosystem.
  
* Own the digital filing architecture, ensuring compliance and ease of access for the global HR team.
  
* Utilize SRM to manage HR service requests, track workflows, and ensure SLA compliance.
  
* Identify manual inefficiencies within established HR processes and recommend/implement automated solutions to enhance speed and accuracy.
  
* Demonstrate negotiation and influence skills to build alignment with external stakeholders and internal partners.
  
* Conducting periodic HR compliance audits, leverage deep knowledge of local labor laws to support standardized and legally sound operational processes.
  
* Utilize HR dashboards and reports to monitor trends, validate data integrity, and identify potential risks.
  
* Use key HR metrics to propose thoughtful, scalable improvements to workflows that directly impact business outcomes.
  
* At JumpCloud, we value "Progress over Perfection." You will have the autonomy to identify a "broken" process and the support to fix it using the latest HR tools and automation techniques.
  

  


  


  




**We’re looking for:** 
  
* 4\+ years in HR Operations or Shared Services, preferably in a high\-growth tech environment.
  
* Ability to manage moderately complex tasks with minimal supervision.
  
* A natural curiosity for how HR processes connect to the broader organization.
  
* A proven track record of troubleshooting issues and initiating small\-scale projects to streamline workflows.
  
* Ability to exercise discretion, sound judgment, and diplomacy when communicating with everyone from new hires to Senior Management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing at all levels in the organization including Senior Management.
  
* Experience maintaining confidentiality of assignments due to the exposure to sensitive information and contacts
  
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Excel  (vlookups, pivots), Word, PowerPoint, Gsuite, and a passion for learning new HR software.
  

  



  




**Bonus points:** 
  

  
* Experience with Jira (for ticketing/workflows), ADP, and Deel will be a plus.
  
* HRMS experience is a plus, or technically savvy and willingness to learn many systems.
  

  


  





  




  


  

 LI\-YM1
   





  





**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 

  


  
 


  


 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 


  


  
 


  


**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  


  
 


  


**Language:** 

  



 JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud®?** 

  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  


  
 


  



 One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  


  
 


  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  


  
 


  



 JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  


**Scam Notice:** 

  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"
 



  



  
 



  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

 Future Talent Program is a Trainee Program within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in July 2026\. During the program you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person.
   

  

 As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
   

  

 From day one you will be delivering results as a true team member following a development plan that is specifically designed for you and your position. The plan includes a combination of project\-rotations, international assignments, work within your own department as well as formal training and mentorship from a network of colleagues all over the world. The program will give you broad insight into our company, our culture and our values. After completing this program, you will have gained knowledge, built relationships, and had experiences to help you continue your exciting career within our company.

 To be successful in this role you need to be a team player and have the ability to build trust on all levels. Furthermore, you have a strong drive, are result oriented and have an interest for both business and tech. You have easy to see the big picture but also have attention to details and care about quality.

 on

 **27\-04\-2026\.**

 .

title: Data Engineer Junior
description:
**About The Role**
 As a Data Engineer in the Edge of Technology Center, you will play a critical role in designing and implementing scalable data infrastructure to power advanced analytics, AI/ML, and business intelligence. This position demands a hands\-on technologist who can architect reliable pipelines, manage real\-time event streams, and ensure smooth data operations across cloud\-native environments. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to enable data\-driven decisionmaking and innovation across the organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Design, implement, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines using tools like Argo Workflows or Apache Airflow.
   

  

 Manage and execute database schema changes with Alembic or Liquibase, ensuring data consistency.
   

  

 Configure and optimize distributed query engines like Trino and AWS Athena for analytics.
   

  

 Deploy and manage containerized workloads on AWS EKS or GCP GKE using Docker, Helmfile, and Argo CD.
   

  

 Build data lakes/warehouses on AWS S3 and implement performant storage using Apache Iceberg.
   

  

 Use Terraform and other IaC tools to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning securely.
   

  

 Develop CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions to support rapid and reliable deployments.
   

  

 Architect and maintain Kafka\-based real\-time event\-driven systems using Apicuro and AVRO.
   

  

 Collaborate with product, analytics, and engineering teams to define and deliver data solutions.
   

  

 Monitor and troubleshoot data systems for performance and reliability issues using observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
   

  

 Document data flows and maintain technical documentation to support scalability and knowledge sharing.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
 Fully operational ETL/ELT pipelines supporting high\-volume, low\-latency data processing.
   

  

 Zero\-downtime schema migrations with consistent performance across environments.
   

  

 Distributed query engines tuned for large\-scale analytics with minimal response time.
   

  

 Reliable containerized deployments in Kubernetes using GitOps methodologies.
   

  

 Kafka\-based real\-time data ingestion pipelines with consistent schema validation.
   

  

 Infrastructure deployed and maintained as code using Terraform and version control.
   

  

 Automated CI/CD processes ensuring fast, high\-quality code releases.
   

  

 Cross\-functional project delivery aligned with business requirements.
   

  

 Well\-maintained monitoring dashboards and alerting for proactive issue resolution.
   

  

 Internal documentation and runbooks for operational continuity and scalability.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field from a recognized institution.
   

  

**Technical Skills**
* Orchestration Tools: Argo Workflows, Apache Airflow
* Database Migration: Alembic, Liquibase
* SQL Engines: Trino, AWS Athena
* Containers \& Orchestration: Docker, AWS EKS, GCP GKE
* Data Storage: AWS S3, Apache Iceberg
* Relational Databases: Postgres, MySQL, Aurora
* Infrastructure Automation: Terraform (or equivalent IaC tools)
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions or similar
* GitOps Tools: Argo CD, Helmfile
* Event Streaming: Kafka, Apicurio, AVRO
* Languages: Python, Bash
* Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana (preferred)


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities in complex technical environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to interact with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and proactive in identifying improvement opportunities.
* Team player with a collaborative approach and eagerness to mentor junior team members.
* High adaptability to new technologies and dynamic business needs.
* Effective project management and time prioritization.
* Strong documentation skills for maintaining system clarity.
* Ability to translate business problems into data solutions efficiently.

description:
Job Title: Databricks Data Engineer
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Experience: 1–3 Years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Databricks Data Engineer with 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering and Databricks. The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake and ETL/ELT processes.
