 Develop and maintain data pipelines using Databricks.
   

  

 Build data transformation processes using PySpark and SQL.
   

  

 Work with Delta Lake to create and maintain reliable data tables.
   

  

 Implement data processing across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers.
   

  

 Extract and transform data from multiple data sources.
   

  

 Develop ETL/ELT pipelines according to project requirements.
   

  

 Perform data cleansing, transformation and validation.
   

  

 Write optimized SQL queries for data processing and analysis.
   

  

 Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and jobs.
   

  

 Identify and resolve data quality and pipeline\-related issues.
   

  

 Work with senior Data Engineers and Data Modellers to implement data models.
   

  

 Assist in designing and maintaining scalable Lakehouse solutions.
   

  

 Participate in testing, debugging and performance optimization.
   

  

 Maintain technical documentation for data pipelines and processes.
   

  

 Follow development, version control and deployment standards.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 1–3 years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL / Data Processing.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Databricks.
   

  

 Good knowledge of PySpark.
   

  

 Strong SQL fundamentals.
   

  

 Understanding of Delta Lake.
   

  

 Understanding of Lakehouse architecture.
   

  

 Good understanding of ETL/ELT concepts.
   

  

 Experience working with data transformation and data cleansing.
   

  

 Basic understanding of data warehousing concepts.
   

  

 Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Ability to work collaboratively with senior technical teams.

description:
**Working with Us**
 Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high\-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.
   

  

 Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Major Duties**
* Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data\-products to enable data\- informed decision\-making.
* As a member of the team, develop a centralized data\-layer to deliver data\-products at scale to the business.
* Use ELT framework to help transform raw or semi\-structured data into a contextualized data model (preferably using DBT), supporting architectural solutions (preferably AWS) to drive efficiency.
* Partner with AI and ML teams to deliver the data skeleton for AI\-enabled internal tools.
* Work within DBT to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t\-repeat\-yourself”) code.
* Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on\-time.
* Focus on innovative solutions to increase speed\-to\-delivery and accelerate business decision\- making.
* Support gathering of business requirements, help track measurable outcomes, and assist in developing analytical product plans, learning to translate complexity for various stakeholders.


**Qualifications/Degree/Certification/Licensur.**
* Computer Science, Physics, Math, Data Science, Pharmaceutical Science, or Engineering area of study preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience in analytical engineering, data modeling, or a similar role.
* Some hands\-on experience with or exposure to dbt(Not mandatory).
* Proficiency with SQL, SPARK and Python.
* Knowledge of data engineering tools (AWS, Airflow) and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI,Looker).
* Experience with version control (e.g. Git, SVN) and Agile development.
* Proven analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Developing ability to gather requirements to understand business needs and support technical solutions.
* Good communication and presentation skills, with a willingness to develop the ability to explain analyses and outcomes to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with AI, ML, predictive modeling a plus.
* Familiarity with our toolkit desired work information process tools (JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow,MS suites); data\-related tools (Oracle, Redshift, PostgreSQL, CDP Impala, Athena).

 With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

 BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role
   

  

 Site\-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site\-by\-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field\-based and remote\-by\-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

Under guidance from senior team members, you will participate in the analytics delivery lifecycle, including requirements support, data analysis, data preparation, report development, testing, documentation, deployment support, and production issue remediation.
   

  

 You will help build and maintain data pipelines, datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and reports that enable data\-driven decision\-making across Huron. * Support QA and testing activities, including unit testing, report validation, data comparison, UAT support, defect documentation, and issue remediation.
* Help troubleshoot basic data refresh, visualization, access, data quality, and report performance issues, escalating more complex problems to senior team members.
* Maintain clear documentation, including technical notes, data mappings, report logic, test evidence, user guides, and operational support instructions.
* Follow Huron procedures for handling confidential, proprietary, company, and client data.
* Collaborate with offshore and onshore team members across time zones, contributing to team meetings, status updates, sprint ceremonies, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Use approved productivity and AI\-enabled tools responsibly where applicable to support documentation, analysis, testing, and issue investigation, while validating outputs before use.
* Contribute to team processes and reusable assets that improve delivery quality, reporting consistency, and operational efficiency.
* Perform other projects and support tasks as assigned.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of experience in data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, reporting, software development, or related project work.
* Foundational understanding of relational databases, SQL querying, joins, data models, and reporting concepts.
* Exposure to ETL/ELT concepts, data mapping, data quality checks, data warehousing, data lakes, or Lakehouse platforms.
* Basic experience or coursework in Python, SQL, and Microsoft Power BI.
* Exposure to Power BI report development, dashboard design, data visualization, semantic modeling, and introductory DAX.
* Familiarity with cloud or analytics platforms such as Azure Data Factory, AWS S3, AWS Glue, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies is preferred.

* Ability to manage assigned tasks, ask clarifying questions, communicate blockers early, and follow through on action items.

title: Analyst-Data Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
 At American Express, delivering exceptional customer experiences is central to building lasting customer relationships and driving sustainable business growth. Understanding what customers experience, why those experiences occur, and how they influence customer behavior enables us to identify opportunities to improve satisfaction, strengthen loyalty and retention, and drive better business and operational outcomes.
   

  

 The Customer Listening – Insights \& Analytics team brings together customer feedback, interaction, servicing, and operational data to generate insights that shape customer experience (CX) strategy and business decisions.
   

  

 We are looking for an analytically strong and intellectually curious analyst who can combine deep data and statistical understanding, strong business judgment, and structured problem solving to solve complex CX problems.
   

  

 This is not a reporting\-focused role. The successful candidate will be expected to take ambiguous business questions, translate them into testable hypotheses, determine the right data and analytical approach, and turn evidence into clear business recommendations. The role also requires hands\-on application of text analytics, NLP, GenAI and other advanced analytical techniques to derive insights from structured and unstructured customer data.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Solve complex CX and business problems end\-to\-end – structure ambiguous questions, develop hypotheses, identify relevant data, select appropriate analytical methods, interpret results, and recommend actions.
* Own and deliver CX analytics across servicing channels
* Develop executive\-ready insight packages and narratives to support decision\-making
* Drive cross\-channel customer journey analysis to identify friction points and improvement opportunities
* Apply sample vs population\-based methodologies to ensure scalable and statistically sound insights
* Leverage NLP techniques to extract customer sentiment, themes, and unmet needs
* Integrate Gen AI / LLM\-based workflows to enhance analytics efficiency and innovation
* Partner with senior stakeholders to shape analytics roadmaps and align with business priorities
* Bring in external best practices in CX and analytics to continuously elevate team output
* Ensure timely, accurate, and impactful delivery across all analytics initiatives


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications and Skills
   

  

* Strong foundation in statistics and data reasoning, including practical understanding of population vs. sample, sampling and selection bias, distributions, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, correlation vs. causation and regression.
* Strong analytical\-method selection, with working knowledge of commonly used data\-mining and machine\-learning techniques such as segmentation, clustering, classification and regression, including when to use them, their underlying assumptions and how to evaluate results.
* Strong logical and structured problem\-solving ability, with demonstrated ability to break ambiguous business problems into hypotheses, determine the evidence required, evaluate alternative explanations and arrive at well\-supported conclusions.
* Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data manipulation, statistical analysis, automation and analytical model development.
* Strong written, verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex analytical findings and influence business stakeholders through evidence.
* Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, attention to detail and willingness to challenge assumptions rather than accepting results at face value.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with customer experience and behavior analytics to drive business strategies.
* Experience with Tableau, Power BI or other data\-visualization platforms.
* Experience translating analytical findings into recommendations that have influenced customer, operational or business outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience with text analytics, NLP, GenAI or related advanced analytical techniques, with an understanding of how these approaches can be applied to extract meaningful insights from large volumes of unstructured customer data.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or another quantitative discipline.
* Postgraduate degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline is preferred but not required.
* Relevant certifications in statistics, data science, machine learning, NLP or advanced analytics are a plus.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities


 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

title: Maritime Data Analyst
description:
**Role Profile**
 Lloyds List Intelligence are the trusted experts delivering transparent and actionable maritime data empowering 60,000 professionals around the globe to make confident decisions that drive the safe, efficient, and lawful movement of trade by sea. Our advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and industry expertise transform our unparalleled data into unique insight delivered through data and analytics services, news and commentary, and publications.
   

  

 We have teams working across the globe in data and analytics, product management, editorial and market analysis, technology, marketing, sales, and customer success.
   

  

 In the role of Maritime Data Analyst, reporting to the Customer Experience Lead, you will provide first response to customer queries related to vessel data, AIS data and methodology, complex ownership structures, as well as sanctions and compliance risks, working closely with other research teams to ensure the queries are answered within agreed SLAs. The Maritime Data Analyst will primarily investigate company and vessel ownership structures, vessel characteristics \& movement patterns, as well as maritime areas \& facilities. They are expected to gain a broad understanding of Lloyd’s List Intelligence data and products, and most importantly how these benefit our customers. Within the remit of this role there is a key focus on resolving multiple daily client queries and delivering on Data Quality programmes across several data areas in a timely manner, as well as exploring ways to improve efficiency and processes to increase the timeliness, coverage and accuracy of data delivered to customers.
   

  

  

  

 If you have bags of enthusiasm and a desire to solve complex problems, are keen to gain experience of large and complex datasets and due diligence research whilst delivering timely and actionable insights to our customers then this is the team for you! Maritime knowledge would be an advantage but much more important is a passion for data, investigations and research, and someone who can work well with continual change.
   

  

  

  

 This role is permanent and offers balanced working with 2\-3 days a week in our Chennai office.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor and respond to inbound customer queries, received through the Ask\-the\-Analyst service, as well as non\-customer and internal requests, ensuring these are handled in an efficient and timely manner, capturing \& escalating actionable client feedback.
* Develop a deep understanding of the different customer groups and how they rely on our insight and services.
* Acquire full knowledge of in\-house methodology across the Maritime Data Team and be able to articulate this in written responses to internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure customer service SLAs, Data Quality KPIs and daily tasks are consistently met.
* Research and investigate complex datasets, including commercial ownership structures and ultimate beneficial ownership, sanction links and vessel data, becoming a subject matter expert.
* Review and validate AIS tracking data, responding to customer queries on vessel movements.
* Monitor, proactively escalate and follow\-up on issues related to the performance of our proprietary AIS tracking network, maintaining our relationships with the AIS station hosts.
* Review and update entries within our Geospatial database, including but not limited to Ports, Terminals \& Berths, as well as High\-Risk Areas.
* Provide quality control of research teams’ output, offer feedback and expertise when needed.
* Foster collaboration and share information with other in\-house data teams, to optimise the quality of our data.
* Proactively suggest process efficiency and methodology improvements, supporting on their delivery within the scope of our COACT data quality framework.
* Keep abreast of emerging market trends and regulatory changes in the risk and compliance landscape, as well as competitor advances in the maritime data market.
* If required, attend client meetings as a subject matter expert alongside sales and product management.


  

  

**Essential**
**What we are looking for:**
* A customer\-first approach with a flexible, can\-do attitude, and strong time management skills with an ability to respond to multiple queries and requests within set deadlines.
* At least 1\-2 years’ experience in business intelligence, consultancy, or complex data research, relying both on primary and secondary sources.
* Proven track record of proactively seeking out and validating information, both within and outside of pre\-determined source lists.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Ability to compile training methodology and feedback documents to drive output enhancements is a pre\-requisite.
* Strong stakeholder management is required in this role, across all areas of the business.


  

  

**Desirable**
* Experience of resolving complex customer queries, including objection handling.
* Innovative and dynamic approach to problem\-solving, with proven success in implementing data, research, and content improvements.
* Software skills in packages that are synonymous with Big Data management, e.g. SQL, Python, and experience using datasets in natural language processing (NLP) would be an advantage
* Comprehensive understanding of complex company ownership structures and financial and legal transactions in the maritime industry would be advantageous.
* Experience mapping legal corporate structures and proficiency using corporate registries would be highly advantageous.
* Confident presentation skills for internal and external audiences.
* An established network of contacts in the maritime industry.
* Proficiency in another language is highly desirable.

If you're excited about working for us and have most, but not all of the skills or experience we're looking for, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need!
   

  

 We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed.  As such, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics under federal, state or local law.

 Leading seaborne trade through change with data transparency, innovative technology, and human ingenuity.

title: Trainee – International Markets
description:
**Position Summary**




 Futures First, a Hertshten Group Company, is an internationally recognized technology\-enabled business that provides market analysis and research services in international derivatives across multiple asset classes.
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity to work in global derivatives markets, providing
 


* **Structured onboarding and training:** 
 A comprehensive induction program designed to build strong foundations regardless of prior experience.
* **Merit\-based growth:** 
 Clear progression driven by performance and capability.
* **Performance\-linked compensation:** 
 Competitive base salary with strong upside potential.
* **Mentorship and coaching:** 
 One\-to\-one access to industry experts and experienced professionals for guidance and development.
* **Continuous learning environment:** 
 Ongoing training in markets, strategy, and technology.
* **Professional work environment:** 
 Modern office setup designed for focus, collaboration, and high performance.
* **Employee engagement and well\-being initiatives:** 
 A people\-centric approach built on a culture of trust, transparency and respect.



**Role Overview**




 This is an analytical role focused on understanding and interpreting derivatives, primarily in futures markets. Analysts are trained to evaluate market information, identify patterns, and apply fundamental and quantitative techniques to provide analytical and objective output in the form of market insights, ideas and strategies.
 



 The role blends structured learning with real\-time practical application. From early on, analysts engage with live market dynamics, developing both technical expertise and the psychological discipline required to operate in fast\-moving environments.
 



 Training and development areas include:
 


* Macroeconomics and global monetary systems
* Derivatives, futures, and exchange mechanics
* Fundamental, technical, and statistical analysis
* Risk management and capital preservation



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of financial futures across major global exchanges.
* Monitor, interpret, and analyze market data, news, and economic indicators to assess market sentiment.
* Evaluate market trends using statistical and analytical tools, and develop, test, and refine strategies.
* Contribute to research and development of new ideas, strategies and technological solutions.



**Eligibility \& Requirements**




**Education**



* Strong academic background with a completed graduate degree (mandatory)
* Preferred disciplines: Commerce, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering



**Experience**



* No prior experience needed; fresh graduates with strong analytical ability and interest in financial markets are encouraged to apply.
* Experienced candidates interested in joining must demonstrate relevant exposure to derivatives markets and a proven track record.



**Skill Set**



* Strong numerical and analytical thinking
* Genuine interest in financial markets
* Coding, data analysis, and quantitative skills would be advantageous
* Quick – thinking, ability to focus and act under uncertainty
* Self\-motivated, competitive and result oriented mindset
* High levels of integrity, discipline, patience and accountability
* Emotional resilience and ability to remain composed in dynamic environments



**Important Notes**



* This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role.
* Only candidates who have completed graduation are eligible to apply.
* Candidates who have participated in the recruitment process in the last 12 months are not eligible to reapply.

title: Knowledge Analyst - Risk Dynamics
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be based out of our Gurugram office and will work with our Risk Analytics team, part of our Global Risk \& Resilience practice and will help clients on topics at the intersection of risk and analytics more specifically, credit risk, market and trading risk, non\-financial risk and ERM and model risk management.
   

  

 You will help clients to create a sustainable impact and capabilities in the areas of risk and resilience. From core regulatory capital and risk models to business decision analytics and model risk management, we create value by improving performance across broad spectrum of topics.
   

  

 Your team consists of risk specialists, quantitative experts, and business professionals, empowering us to offer our clients a unique variety of skills in risk management, business and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 You will work closely with clients to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and build long\-term organizational resilience through data\-driven approaches and structured frameworks. Your work involves applying advanced modeling techniques and AI technologies to quantify risk exposures, evaluate strategic options, and support scenario planning and stress\-testing.
   

  

 You will develop and validate models and frameworks that integrate AI to deliver deeper insights and predictive capabilities, while leveraging AI code assistants, agentic workflows, and advanced analytics to enhance decision\-making, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation. In addition, you will embed AI into operational workflows and decision\-making processes to strengthen governance and enterprise risk management practices.
   

  

 You will guide clients through complex challenges, driving efficiency and innovation through modern analytics adoption, and equipping them with the capabilities to respond to disruptions, build contingencies into their strategies, and institutionalize resilient, enterprise\-wide risk management.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Master's degree in a quantitative field; advanced degree in computer science, mathematics/statistics, engineering or financial engineering
* Industry qualifications including CFA, FRM, PRM or similar
* 1\+ years of related experience in advanced quantitative modeling techniques
* Experience with AI agents, agentic technologies, or GenAI/LLM applications
* Experience in one or more machine learning / AI areas: natural language processing, deep learning, anomaly detection, graph\-based techniques
* Experience in Modeling: Advanced quantitative modeling, predictive modeling, stress\-testing, scenario planning
* Experience with Python, advanced SQL, PyTorch, Tensorflow, Spark, Kafka, Docker, FastAPI, Git and cloud (AWS/GCP)
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team and drive independent workstreams within broader team projects
* Willingness to travel

Our products include AutoPilot Interview, Emotions API, TrueFace, Emotion Quest, and Pediatric Developmental Screening. We're a small, fast\-moving team where engineers take end\-to\-end ownership and ship real products every week.
 



  





 The Role \-
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Python / ML Developer with 4–6 years of experience to build the ML core of our AI products: a live AI voice interviewer, a facial expression / emotion measurement API, communication\-delivery scoring for interviews, and integrity / proctoring signals. You will own real\-time ML pipelines end\-to\-end — from data preparation and model training to low\-latency inference services running in production on our own GPU infrastructure. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role; you will work closely with the Technical Lead, product, and the frontend and backend teams. Prior experience in a startup or fast\-moving product environment is strongly preferred
 



  





 What You'll Do \-
 



 • Build and maintain production ML services in Python using FastAPI — REST APIs, WebSockets, and async pipelines designed around real\-time latency budgets. • Develop real\-time audio/speech pipelines: ASR with Whisper / faster\-whisper, voice\-activity detection (Silero VAD), prosody and speech features (praat\-parselmouth, librosa), and TTS integration. • Train, fine\-tune, and evaluate computer\-vision models with PyTorch — facial expression / emotion recognition, face detection with YOLOv8 / OpenCV / MediaPipe. • Integrate LLMs into products: prompt engineering, structured outputs, and resilient provider handling across Groq, Mistral, and OpenAI\-compatible endpoints (fallbacks, rate limits, cost and latency optimization). • Build retrieval and memory layers: embeddings, vector search with Qdrant, semantic matching across sessions. • Serve and optimize models on in\-house GPU infrastructure — Triton Inference Server / vLLM, fp16, batching, and throughput/latency tuning. • Design honest, evidence\-based scoring: calibration, bias checks, and explainable signals; treat privacy and PII handling as first\-class requirements. • Write well\-tested production code (pytest), add logging and monitoring, and take part in code reviews. • Own features end\-to\-end: prototype → production → measurement → iteration.
 



  





 Must\-Have • 6 \+ years of strong hands\-on Python development for production systems (not just notebooks or scripts). • Solid FastAPI experience (or Flask / Django) — REST APIs, WebSockets, async programming, and concurrency. • Hands\-on ML with PyTorch (training and inference) and computer vision with OpenCV. • Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI\-compatible endpoints) and practical prompt engineering. • Audio/speech ML exposure — ASR (Whisper), VAD, audio feature extraction — or demonstrated ability to go deep quickly. • SQL databases (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and comfort working on Linux servers. • Docker, Git, and CI/CD experience. • Testing discipline with pytest. • Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills. • Startup or fast\-moving product experience preferred.
 



  





 Good to Have • Model serving: Triton Inference Server, vLLM, ONNX, or TensorRT; GPU inference optimization, CUDA. • Vector databases (Qdrant), embeddings, and RAG pipelines. • MediaPipe, YOLO (ultralytics), and face\-analysis models. • praat\-parselmouth prosody analysis and speech\-feature engineering. • Responsible\-AI practices: calibration, bias mitigation, explainability; awareness of EU AI Act / NYC LL144\. • Basic React / TypeScript for demo frontends; Streamlit or Gradio for internal tools. • Kafka / RabbitMQ / Celery / Redis / Kubernetes. • AWS / Azure / GCP.
 



  





 Why Sharedpro • In\-house GPU infrastructure — train, serve, and optimize your own models. • Real\-world AI problems: voice agents, emotion recognition, speech scoring, and proctoring — not toy projects. • Small team with high ownership; ship real products every week. • End\-to\-end responsibility from data to model to production service. • Modern stack: PyTorch, Whisper, LLMs, Qdrant, Triton, FastAPI. • Freedom to make meaningful technical decisions in a fast\-moving startup environment.

description:
**👩 💻 The role** 




 We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.
 



  





 Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply\-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.
 



  





 This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.
 



  





 If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.
 



  





**🤩 What makes this role special?** 



* **Real problems, not busywork** 
 : Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real\-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
* **Breadth of exposure** 
 : You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
* **Learn fast by doing** 
 : You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
* **A team that gives a damn** 
 : We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
* **A product you can care about** 
 : Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.



  





**💝 What skills \& experience do you need?** 



* 1 \- 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
* Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand\-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.

 You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining BI solutions that help our organisation make data\-driven decisions. * Schedule and run regular workshops with business counterparties: Validating analytics, proactively gathering the needs of the business and keeping a close loop of feedback going

title: Analytics Solutions Analyst - KYC Operations
description:
**Job Description**
 Join a high\-impact analytics role that turns KYC operational data into clear, decision\-ready insights. Help leaders improve productivity, reduce backlog, and strengthen controls through trusted reporting and root\-cause analysis. Build scalable dashboards and automated metrics that enable faster, smarter execution across KYC operations.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Know Your Customer (KYC) Management Information Systems (MIS) \& Analytics Analyst within Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) KYC Operations, you transform operational data into accurate management information, dashboards, and actionable insights. You define and govern key performance indicator (KPI) and key risk indicator (KRI) logic, validate data integrity, and clearly explain performance trends and movements with a strong controls mindset. You collaborate with Operations, Quality Assurance, Controls, Compliance/Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), and Technology teams to enhance transparency, promote remediation initiatives, and enable data\-promoten decision\-making across the organization.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Produce daily/weekly/monthly MIS packs covering volumes, productivity, TAT/SLA, aging, backlog, and exceptions.
* Build dashboards for onboarding/refresh/remediation performance with drilldowns by segment, region, team, and risk tier.
* Automate recurring reporting to reduce manual effort and improve timeliness and consistency.
* Define KPI/KRI definitions, calculation logic, thresholds, and ownership through a governed metric catalog/data dictionary.
* Track operational risk and control indicators (e.g., overdue reviews, policy breaches, repeat defects, rework rates).
* Extract data from source systems (workflow/case tools, screening tools, CRM, document repositories) for reporting and analysis.
* Reconcile outputs end\-to\-end and clearly articulate “why the number moved” using sound control checks.
* Implement data quality checks (completeness, duplicates, outliers, trend breaks) and document limitations.
* Perform root\-cause analysis on SLA misses, backlog spikes, and quality defects; recommend corrective actions.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate questions into structured analyses and crisp narratives for senior updates.
* Support change delivery via UAT, version control, documentation, and periodic risk assessments of dashboards/tools.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Demonstrate strong MIS/reporting/analytics experience in KYC, AML, onboarding, or operations environments.
* Use advanced Excel to build scalable packs, controls, and analysis outputs.
* Apply at least one of SQL, Alteryx, Python, Power BI, or Tableau to automate and/or visualize operational metrics.
* Build operational metrics (TAT/SLA, aging, throughput, productivity, quality/error rates) with clear definitions.
* Reconcile data across sources and maintain a strong control mindset with auditability and lineage.
* Communicate insights succinctly in written narratives and verbal updates for senior stakeholders.
* Analyze multi\-driver performance trends using descriptive and diagnostic techniques to identify levers and actions.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Leverage workflow/case management tools to extract operational data efficiently.
* Apply control reporting concepts, QA defect taxonomies, or regulatory remediation tracking approaches.
* Design automation approaches (ETL pipelines, scheduled refresh, standardized semantic layers) for repeatable reporting.
* Understand KYC lifecycle stages, periodic reviews, trigger events, and remediation programs.
* Interpret risk segmentation concepts (risk rating, EDD drivers) to enable meaningful slicing of metrics.
* Ensure control expectations such as audit trails, evidence retention, and consistent definitions across reporting.

title: QA Engineer — Mobile Apps
description:
**What you will do** 



* Run manual functional and regression testing on Android apps (React/Capacitor\-based) before every release, across a matrix of real devices and OS versions.
* Test the full ad lifecycle on each app — banner, interstitial, rewarded and app\-open — checking that ads load, display correctly, and reward only when they should (no reward\-on\-failure, no double\-grants, no obstructed placements).
* Verify the points and rewards economy end to end: caps and cooldowns are respected, milestones fire once, streaks and daily rewards match what is advertised on screen, and wallet balances match the underlying ledger.
* Write and maintain test cases and smoke\-test checklists per app, and validate new features against acceptance criteria before sign\-off.
* Log clear, reproducible bug reports — steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behaviour, screenshots or screen recordings, device/OS, and a severity/priority call.
* Perform release\-candidate sign\-off before a Play Store rollout, and spot\-check Play Console vitals (crashes, ANRs, staged rollout health) after release.
* Regression\-test after every hotfix and keep the smoke\-test checklist for each app current as features change.
* Work directly with the app team to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and close the loop — re\-testing rather than just filing and forgetting.
* Where relevant, sanity\-check onboarding, redemption and (for FinPro) financial\-literacy flows for correctness and clarity, not just crashes.



**What we are looking for** 



* 1–4 years of hands\-on manual QA / testing experience on Android mobile apps — games or consumer apps preferred.
* Comfortable with both structured, test\-case\-driven testing and open\-ended exploratory testing.
* Writes bug reports a developer can act on without asking follow\-up questions — precise repro steps, not “it doesn’t work.”
* Some familiarity with how mobile ad networks behave (rewarded / interstitial / banner) is a strong plus, since every app in the portfolio is ad\-monetised.
* Basic familiarity with Google Play Console (release tracks, staged rollout, vitals) is a plus, not a requirement.
* Methodical and detail\-oriented — comfortable running the same regression pass carefully, release after release.
* Based in Indore or willing to relocate; this is an on\-site role.



**Nice to have** 



* Experience testing freemium or ad\-supported mobile games specifically.
* Exposure to a bug tracker (Jira, Trello, or even a well\-run spreadsheet) and to basic SQL (able to read a database table to confirm what really happened).
* Exposure to automated mobile testing tools (Appium, Detox) — not required, a plus if you have played with one.



**Hiring process** 



1. A short take\-home assignment (2–3 hours), done on your own time before the interview.
2. An in\-person interview at our Indore office, which includes a live testing exercise.
3. Offer, for candidates who clear both.


- 


  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science
* 1\+ years relevant testing experience
* Technical skills in OOP
* Team player

title: Product Quality Analyst
description:
The Product Quality Analyst owns business\-side test validation — designing and running UAT and beta test cycles, and conducting exploratory testing from a real\-user and real\-workflow perspective — while also writing the acceptance criteria and requirements those tests are built against. This role validates that what gets built and tested actually matches business intent, working closely with the Product Owner to shape requirements up front and with Development to make sure those requirements are technically clear before a single line of code is written.
 



 Working closely with QA, Product, and Development, this role is the business\-facing check across the full delivery cycle — from shaping what gets built, to confirming it works for real users doing real work, not just that it passes scripted test cases.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. UAT, Beta \& Exploratory Testing** 




*(primary focus)* 



* **Design \& Run UAT:** 
 Build and execute UAT scenarios directly, based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* **Coordinate Beta Cycles:** 
 Run structured beta testing with real users on new features and releases, collecting and triaging feedback before general rollout.
* **Exploratory Testing:** 
 Conduct unscripted testing from a business\-fit angle — usability, workflow gaps, and edge cases that scripted QA test cases don't target.
* **Validate Business Fit:** 
 Confirm AI/ML output and Web UI behavior make sense from a real\-user, real\-workflow perspective.



**2\. Requirement Refinement \& Functional Analysis** 




*(partnering with Product Owner \& Development)* 



* **Shape Requirements Early:** 
 Work directly with the Product Owner to break down new features, surfacing edge cases and gaps before they reach development — not just testing after the fact.
* **Write Acceptance Criteria:** 
 Convert business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria that both development and testing can build against.
* **Align with Development:** 
 Partner with Development to confirm requirements are technically feasible and scoped correctly before sprint commitment.
* **Bridge Build and Validation:** 
 Sit in refinement and planning sessions so testing isn't a downstream afterthought — it's built into how features are scoped from day one.



**3\. Cross\-Functional Support \& Sign\-Off** 



* Triage support tickets into confirmed bugs vs. user error, feeding real usage patterns back to the Product Owner.
* Give final business sign\-off on releases, based on UAT/beta/exploratory results.



**KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES AND EXPERIENCE** 




**Essential:** 



* UAT Design \& Execution: Hands\-on experience designing and running UAT test cycles.
* Beta Testing Management: Experience coordinating structured beta programs with real users.
* Exploratory Testing: Strong exploratory testing skills from a business/usability angle.
* Requirements Partnership: Experience working directly with Product and Development to shape and refine requirements pre\-build, not just validate post\-build.
* AI/ML Output Validation: Experience validating AI\-generated output for business relevance and accuracy.
* Attention to Detail: Able to spot subtle inconsistencies in behavior or output.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Comfortable operating across Product, Development, and QA with a clear view of where each role's ownership begins and ends.



**Desirable:** 



* Familiarity with Product and Test management tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Understanding of release governance and deployment cycles.
* Experience in SaaS or pharma\-tech environments.



**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)** 



* UAT defect detection rate.
* Beta program coverage and feedback turnaround.
* Exploratory testing coverage from a business/usability lens.
* Production defect leakage tied to gaps in business\-side testing.
* % of features refined with Product/Dev input before sprint start.
* On\-time business sign\-off against release schedule.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 A successful Product Quality Analyst brings a real\-user, real\-workflow lens across the full delivery cycle — shaping requirements with the Product Owner before a feature is built, aligning scope with Development so nothing gets lost in translation, and then catching usability friction and edge cases before customers ever see them. They give the business genuine confidence that a release actually fits how people use the product, turning scattered UAT, beta, and exploratory feedback into clear, actionable insight so the team ships with certainty rather than guesswork.

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 



**About the Role**

  
 





 You will join our Delivery team
 

  as
 **Test Automation Engineer** 


**.** 
  
 

 In this role, you will be a technical contributor and trusted advisor, responsible for end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of robust RPA and Test Automation solutions using the UiPath Test Suite. You will work alongside cross\-functional teams, shape automation best practices, and help our clients accelerate quality at scale.
 

  
 





 This is a hands\-on engineering role that also demands a strategic mindset. 
 

  
 




**Key Responsibilities**

  
 



* Design, develop, test, and deploy end\-to\-end RPA and Test Automation workflows using UiPath Test Suite (Test Manager, Test Automation, Studio).


* Build and maintain reusable, scalable automation frameworks, libraries, and components following best practices (REFramework, Modular Design).


* Define and implement test strategies, test plans, and test cases for both automated and regression testing across multiple client environments.


* Collaborate closely with business analysts, developers, and QA stakeholders to translate requirements into robust automation solutions.


* Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and drive continuous improvement across the delivery team.


* Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar) to enable continuous testing.


* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex automation defects and performance bottlenecks.


* Maintain comprehensive documentation including design specifications, test reports, and runbooks.




  
 




**Must\-have**

  
 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, developing, and deploying automation solutions with UiPath (Studio, Orchestrator, Test Suite).


* Proven expertise in UiPath Test Suite, including Test Manager, Test Automation activities, and integration with third\-party testing tools.


* Strong command of RPA fundamentals: REFramework, exception handling, queues, assets, and credential management.


* Experience integrating UiPath workflows with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI) for continuous testing.


* Solid understanding of software testing methodologies: unit, integration, regression, UAT, and performance testing.


* Ability to write clear, structured test plans, test cases, and automation documentation.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proven ability to debug complex automation failures.


* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery teams.




  
 




**Nice\-to\-have**

  
 



* Experience with UiPath Process Mining, Task Mining, or Document Understanding.


* UiPath Certified Professional — Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD) or equivalent certification.


* Familiarity with AI/ML\-augmented automation and Agentic Automation concepts.


* Knowledge of Selenium, Playwright, or other UI testing frameworks.


* Experience with performance/load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).


* Background in SAP, Salesforce, or other enterprise application automation.


* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and containerized environments.


* Prior experience in a consulting or managed services environment.




  
 




**What we offer:**

  
 



* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge automation and AI programs across global enterprises


* A highly collaborative environment with strong engineering and consulting teams


* Continuous learning, certifications, and technical enablement


* Growth opportunities into solution architecture, tech leadership, or practice leadership roles




  
 




 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Engineer, Software Test Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
* Must have Master's Level Degree in CS or related fields
* Must have excellent communication, analytical and interpersonal skill. Must also be self\-driven, yet a strong team player
* Background in IC processing/Semiconductor equipment is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with automation tools is a plus
* Must be desiring to travel and enjoy working in other cultures.


**Software Quality Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**
 The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world\-class software team to plan, manage, execute, and report results for all qualification activities for the team. He/She will be an effective team player and leader that will be responsible for the quality of all released products. He/She will be a strong process advocate with an acute attention to detail and desire to continually improve the Qualification process. He/She must be able to partner with other functional teams to resolve quality issues quickly.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
 The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world\-class software team to architect, implement, and scale test automation solutions that drive quality across KLA products. They will be a technically strong individual contributor and leader, responsible for building AI\-augmented automation frameworks that ensure the reliability of all released products. They will champion modern testing practices with a sharp focus on automation coverage, infrastructure excellence, and continuous improvement of the qualification process. They must be able to partner with cross\-functional teams globally to resolve quality issues quickly.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include:**
* Identify, evaluate, and implement test automation frameworks and tools that deliver measurable value across the qualification lifecycle — including functional, regression, performance, and reliability testing.
* Own and drive automated test coverage for both UI and API layers across KLA products, designing robust test suites and publishing results, recommendations, and best known methods.
* Integrate AI capabilities into the test automation framework — including self\-healing locators, intelligent test generation, and autonomous test execution — to improve test resilience and reduce maintenance overhead.
* Leverage deep knowledge of software systems and application architecture to design scalable infrastructure solutions that empower the test automation team.
* Assess automation feasibility of test cases and script them for automatic execution across new and existing product features.
* Technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, and Customer Support teams across global locations for various requirements.
* Participate in all stages of software development including deployment and troubleshooting at customer sites. Represent the SQE team in product lifecycle and key program meetings.
* Travel to customer fabrication facilities to understand customer use cases, deploy software, and troubleshoot.


 KLA Corporation, a leading provider of process control and yield management solutions, partners with customers around the world to develop state\-of\-the\-art inspection and metrology technologies. These technologies serve the semiconductor, data storage, LED, and other related nanoelectronics industries. With a portfolio of industry\-standard products and a team of world\-class engineers and scientists, the company has created superior solutions for its customers for 50 years. Headquartered in Milpitas, California., KLA has dedicated customer operations and service centers around the world. Additional information may be found at www.kla.com
   

  

   Software Quality Engineering (SQE) is a functional organization in KLA’s Central engineering group which serves all wafer inspection products in qualifying the products and qualifying to release the differentiated products to help our customers.
   

  

 SQE is seeking Product qualification engineers in our Chennai, India campus to enhance our Quality team.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Strong communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills; self\-driven with the ability to work effectively as part of a team
* Background in IC processing or semiconductor equipment is a plus
* Hands\-on experience with automation tools is a plus
* Willingness to travel and ability to work in diverse cultural environments

title: AI QA Engineer
description:
**Job Post \- AI QA Engineer** 




**Experience \- 2\+ years** 




**Location \- Ahmedabad (work from office)** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We're looking for an AI QA Engineer to own quality across our growing portfolio of AI\-powered products custom dashboards, AI CRMs, RFP platforms, lead\-gen systems, agentic workflows, and automations delivered to agency clients across the US, UK, and AU. This role spans both the AI layer (prompts, agents, RAG, model outputs) and the full application stack around it (web app UI, APIs, databases, integrations, multi\-tenant access). You'll catch issues that traditional QA misses
 *and* 
 the ones that pure ML evaluation misses the messy middle where a working model still ships a broken product.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*AI \& LLM Quality* 



* Design test strategies for LLM\-powered features, agents, RAG systems, and workflow automations (n8n, custom pipelines, MCP\-based systems)
* Build and maintain golden datasets, evaluation suites, and prompt regression tests so model or prompt changes don't silently break production
* Validate output quality across factual accuracy, format adherence, tone, hallucination rate, instruction\-following, and refusal behavior
* Test agentic and multi\-step workflows end\-to\-end tool calls, handoffs, error recovery, loop detection, cost and latency under load
* Stress\-test RAG pipelines: retrieval accuracy, chunking quality, context relevance, citation correctness
* Run adversarial testing prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, malformed inputs, edge\-case client data



  





*Custom App \& Platform Quality* 



* Own end\-to\-end QA for custom\-built applications: dashboards, AI CRMs, client portals, and internal tools
* Functional, regression, cross\-browser, and responsive testing across web UIs (Next.js, React, similar stacks)
* API testing for REST endpoints, webhooks, and third\-party integrations (CRMs, email, calendars, payment, file storage)
* Database and data\-integrity testing especially for multi\-tenant architectures where one client's data must never leak to another
* Auth and access\-control testing: SSO, OAuth, role\-based permissions, session handling
* Performance, load, and stability testing on production\-bound features
* File upload, processing, and storage flows a recurring failure point in AI products



  





*Cross\-Cutting* 



* Monitor production systems for drift, degradation, errors, and cost/token anomalies; set up observability and alerting
* Collaborate with AI engineers, full\-stack developers, prompt designers, and delivery leads to catch issues before they hit clients
* Automate testing in Python and/or JavaScript; integrate into CI/CD pipelines
* Document findings, build QA dashboards, and contribute to company's internal AI QA playbook



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field
* 2\+ years QA experience covering both web applications and AI\-enabled products, with at least 1 year hands\-on testing LLM\-powered features, AI workflows, or agent systems
* Strong Python skills for evaluation harnesses and automation; working JavaScript/TypeScript familiarity for web app testing
* Hands\-on experience with at least one LLM evaluation framework: Promptfoo, DeepEval, RAGAs, LangSmith, Braintrust, or similar
* Web app testing experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium
* API testing with Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent
* Solid understanding of prompt engineering, prompt regression testing, and golden\-dataset design
* Database fundamentals (SQL, basic schema reasoning) enough to verify data flows and spot multi\-tenancy bugs
* Familiarity with LLM observability tools (Langfuse, Helicone, LangSmith) and token/cost/latency monitoring
* Git, CI/CD principles, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Working knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and how RAG systems fail



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS platforms or client\-facing custom apps
* Workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier) or agent frameworks
* Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or tool\-calling architectures
* Familiarity with Supabase, Postgres, or similar backends commonly used in our stack
* Experience with Claude, OpenAI, or open\-source LLM APIs in production
* Agency or client\-services background you understand what "client\-ready" means
* Prompt injection / red\-teaming experience
* SOC 2 or compliance\-testing exposure



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Sharp critical eye you assume AI output (and the app around it) is broken until you've verified it
* Comfortable working in ambiguity; AI QA doesn't have settled playbooks yet
* Clear written communication bug reports for AI failures need precise reproduction steps
* Collaborative across AI engineers, full\-stack devs, delivery managers, and account leads
* Proactive about catching issues before they reach the client demo



  





 Required Skills
 



 Python, Generative, AI QA

 Join us as a Software QA Engineer, where you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of next\-generation optical networking solutions. **Job Description**
**Cloud Operations (CloudOps) Engineering Intern**
 Hybrid/Remote
   

  

**About Chegg**
 We put students first. Our mission is to help every student achieve their best, in school and beyond. We strive to improve the overall return on investment in education by helping students learn more in less time and at a lower cost. Chegg is a publicly\-held company based in California, USA and trades on the NYSE under the symbol CHGG.
   

  

 As Chegg evolves into an AI\-native company, our CloudOps team builds and operates the cloud infrastructure that keeps every product reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient for millions of students worldwide.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This is not your typical internship. On Chegg's CloudOps team, you'll work with a modern cloud infrastructure stack — Infrastructure\-as\-Code, container orchestration, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines — using AI\-powered development tools like Claude as part of your everyday workflow.
   

  

 You'll join a small, high\-leverage team of SREs and cloud automation engineers who keep production infrastructure running for every other engineering team at Chegg. Your changes will ship to production and directly support systems that reach millions of students.
   

  

 You will be surrounded by experienced infrastructure and reliability engineers who will challenge your thinking, accelerate your growth, and help you become a stronger engineer.
   

  

 If you're looking for an internship where you write real infrastructure code, automate real operational workflows, and make a real impact at a company whose mission is to help every student succeed, this is it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Infrastructure \& Automation
   

  

* Contribute to Infrastructure\-as\-Code used to provision and manage cloud resources across multiple environments.
* Write automation scripts and tooling that support cloud operations — access provisioning, cost optimization, and resource lifecycle management.
* Help maintain configuration\-management tooling and containerized/orchestrated workloads.


 Reliability \& Operations
   

  

* Support day\-to\-day cloud operations: access requests, monitoring and alerting hygiene, and routine maintenance across cloud accounts.
* Learn observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerting — and help improve signal\-to\-noise in production monitoring.
* Participate in cost\-optimization and security/compliance initiatives, such as resource tagging, rightsizing, and access reviews.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Ship infrastructure changes safely through CI/CD pipelines, with code review and automated checks.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across the company who depend on CloudOps for infrastructure support.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and technical discussions to build engineering judgment.


**Required Qualifications**
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   

  

* Solid foundation in at least one general\-purpose programming language (Python, Go, etc.) and basic scripting.
* Understanding of fundamental data structures, algorithms, and networking concepts.
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows.
* Eagerness to learn cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices from the ground up.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative, feedback\-driven mindset.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (such as Claude) and able to leverage them to speed up development.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Exposure to Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Familiarity with a public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Exposure to containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with configuration\-management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet).
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Interest in observability/monitoring tools (metrics, logging, alerting).


**What We Offer**
* Competitive intern compensation, mentorship from senior SREs and cloud engineers, and dedicated 1:1 coaching.
* Meaningful project ownership — your infrastructure and automation changes ship to production and support systems reaching millions of students.
* Opportunity to work across a broad cloud technology stack with hands\-on exposure to real production operations. A supportive, inclusive culture that values curiosity, growth, and impact.


*Chegg is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and interns.*
 Why do we exist?
   

  

 Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: TV Operations Engineer
description:
Context:
 



 TV Operations is responsible for running and supporting the production platforms that deliver TV services to customers. The organization operates across the complete TV delivery chain, from content ingestion and processing to service delivery and customer\-facing backend systems.
 



  





 The operational landscape is structured around three main technology domains:
 



  





 • VHE (Video Head End): Manages the acquisition, processing, and distribution of TV content across the operator network. This includes the delivery of encrypted multicast streams used for large\-scale linear TV broadcasting.
 



  





 • Streaming: Manages the OTT and on\-demand streaming platforms, including content recording, transcoding, packaging, DRM encryption, quality optimization, and delivery of unicast streams to customer devices.
 



  





 • Entertainment: Manages the backend applications, middleware platforms, and service components that enable the TV customer experience, including content management, service orchestration, metadata, and platform integrations.
 



  





 The TV ecosystem relies on close collaboration between TV Operations teams, product and client development teams, DevOps organizations, and strategic technology partners. Together they support a complex set of interconnected systems, ranging from application platforms and middleware to shared infrastructure services such as OpenStack/OpenShift, networking, provisioning, transmission, authentication, reporting and monitoring.
 



  





 In practice, TV Operations acts as the operational bridge between the TV platforms, the underlying infrastructure, and the various engineering teams, ensuring service availability, performance, resilience, and continuous evolution of the TV ecosystem.
 



  





  





  





 Your role:
 



 This role sits within the team responsible for the day\-to\-day operation of Proximus' television platform and the associated backend services that deliver TV content to customers.
 



 Although the platform is built on the Accenture Video Solutions (AVS) technology stack, the position goes beyond supporting a specific application. The primary focus is ensuring the end\-to\-end availability, stability, and performance of the TV service experienced by customers.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 



 · Monitoring and operating critical TV backend systems on a daily basis.
 



 · Participating in an on\-call (guard duty) rotation to ensure service continuity and rapid incident response.
 



 · Performing preventive maintenance activities, software updates, and platform health checks.
 



 · Troubleshooting and coordinating the resolution of incidents across multiple technology domains.
 



 · Driving continuous improvements in operational processes, automation, monitoring, and service reliability.
 



 · Working closely with vendors, engineering teams, and operational stakeholders to maintain agreed service levels and KPIs.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong operational and troubleshooting skills with a service\-oriented mindset. They are comfortable working in a complex technical ecosystem, taking ownership of issues, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and continuously looking for ways to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
 



 The team culture is based on collaboration, accountability, agile ways of working, and continuous improvement.
 



 In one sentence
 



 A hands\-on operational role focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of a large\-scale IPTV/streaming platform, combining service operations, incident management, maintenance, and continuous service improvement.
 



  





 Your Profile:
 



 For this type of role, we are looking less for a pure video\-platform specialist and more for someone with the right operational mindset and technical foundation.
 



  





 1\. Strong Operational Ownership
 



 · Takes responsibility for incidents until resolution.
 



 · Proactively identifies risks before customers are impacted.
 



 · Comfortable working in an environment where service availability is the top priority.
 



 · Understands the impact of technical issues on the customer experience.
 



  





 2\. End\-to\-End Troubleshooting Skills
 



 · Able to investigate issues across multiple technology domains rather than focusing on a single component.
 



 · Naturally curious and analytical.
 



 · Can coordinate between infrastructure, application, network, cloud, vendor, and operations teams.
 



 · Structured approach to problem solving and root cause analysis.
 



  





 3\. Technical Breadth
 



 The ideal candidate does not need to be an expert in all areas, but should be comfortable with:
 



 · Linux/Unix environments
 



 · Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls)
 



 · Application support and monitoring
 



 · APIs and web services
 



 · Log analysis and troubleshooting tools
 



 · Cloud and virtualization technologies
 



 · Automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash) as a plus
 



  





 4\. Reliability Engineering Mindset
 



 · Interested in preventing incidents rather than only resolving them.
 



 · Looks for opportunities to automate repetitive tasks.
 



 · Focuses on monitoring, alerting, process improvement and operational excellence.
 



 · Drives continuous improvement initiatives.
 



  





 5\. Ability to Work Under Pressure
 



 · Remains calm during major incidents and service outages.
 



 · Can prioritize effectively during high\-impact situations.
 



 · Makes data\-driven decisions during crisis management.
 



 · Comfortable participating in on\-call/guard duty rotations.
 



  





 6\. Collaboration and Communication
 



 · Strong team player.
 



 · Can communicate technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

 · Shares knowledge openly and supports colleagues.
 



  





 7\. Agile and Continuous Learning Attitude
