title: Product Manager [T500-28811]
description:
**About Inspire Brands:** 




 Inspire Brands is disrupting the restaurant industry through digital transformation and operational efficiencies. The company’s technology hub, Inspire Brands Hyderabad Support Center, India, will lead technology innovation and product development for the organization and its portfolio of distinct brands. The Inspire Brands Hyderabad Support Center will focus on developing new capabilities in data science, data analytics, eCommerce, automation, cloud computing, and information security to accelerate the company’s business strategy. Inspire Brands Hyderabad Support Center will also host an innovation lab and collaborate with start\-ups to develop solutions for productivity optimization, workforce management, loyalty management, payments systems, and more.
 



  





**About Inspire Brands Product Management Group:** 




**The product management group spans three verticals that collectively represent the core pillars of Inspire's product org:** 




**Guest Product \- Serving and delighting customers:** 




 This team is responsible for the digital experiences that shape how guests discover, engage with, and transact with the Inspire Brands portfolio of restaurants. The portfolio spans customer\-facing experiences across the web, mobile, and On\-prem in digital ordering, loyalty, personalization, offers, payments, and post\-purchase engagement. This team directly influences guest acquisition, frequency, retention, satisfaction, and digital revenue growth. Product Managers in this team operate at the intersection of customer experience, business growth, data insights, and technology innovation—identifying opportunities to simplify guest journeys, remove friction, drive engagement, and create differentiated experiences that strengthen brand loyalty.
 



  





**Data Product \- Powering intelligence and decision\-making:** 




 The Data Product organization builds the foundational data capabilities that power decision\-making, intelligence, automation, and AI across Inspire Brands. The portfolio spans enterprise data platforms, data domains, analytics products, self\-service data experiences, AI/ML enablement, and governance capabilities that transform data into strategic business assets. This team impacts almost every business function, from marketing to operations to leadership. Product Managers in this team focus on translating complex business problems into scalable data products, enabling trusted insights, accelerating decision\-making, and creating the data foundation required for advanced analytics, AI, and enterprise\-wide transformation.
 



  





**Restaurant \& Team Member Product \- Enabling the team running the business:** 




 The Team Member Product Vertical owns the digital products that help restaurant operators, managers, team members, and corporate users run the business effectively. Its portfolio spans workforce experience, restaurant operations, revenue management, back\-of\-house systems, and other core capabilities that support daily execution across the restaurant network. This team plays a direct role in improving operational excellence, team member experience, restaurant efficiency, and business performance at scale. Product Managers in this vertical partner with operators, functional leaders, and technology teams to simplify workflows, reduce friction, improve productivity, and reimagine work through AI\-enabled digital experiences.
 



  





**Product Management:** 




 At Inspire Brands, we believe the future of product management is AI\-first. We build digital experiences that serve guests to discover, engage, order, and stay loyal across thousands of restaurant locations. The next generation of these products is transforming our guest experience through AI\-enabled personalization, intelligent recommendations, and frictionless digital journeys. As a Product Manager, you will be entrusted with owning meaningful product areas \- whether that's a portion of mobile ordering, loyalty, kiosk experiences, delivery, on\-premise digital, or payments. You will be driving prioritization decisions, influencing cross\-functional partners, and ensuring that product outcomes create measurable business value. You demonstrate a strong understanding of the product lifecycle from discovery through delivery, governance, and validation. You create alignment across business and technology stakeholders, navigate competing priorities with sound judgment, and bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces. You approach AI\-enabled products with both curiosity and pragmatism, recognizing not only their transformative potential along with the importance of human oversight. Other expectations from you are as follows \-
 



  





**You demonstrate AI\-Native product thinking:** 




 The strongest product managers of the next decade will be those who understand how to combine human judgment, business context, and AI\-enabled ways of working to deliver better outcomes. This role will expect that you view environments blending Agile practices with AI\-enabled product development approaches as an opportunity rather than a disruption. We are looking for candidates who:
 


* Embrace AI as a force multiplier across discovery, planning, prioritization, execution, governance, and validation
* Demonstrate curiosity about how AI is changing user experiences, business operations, \& product management itself
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated recommendations and outputs rather than accepting them at face value
* Drive adoption of modern product development approaches that blend human expertise with AI\-enabled execution
* Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to create business value responsibly.



  





**You identify \& solve meaningful business problems:** 




 Great product managers start with problems, not solutions—this is an implicit behavior for this role. You will work with brand teams, business leaders, engineers, designers, architects, analysts, and other product teams to identify opportunities, uncover root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and drive alignment on the highest\-value outcomes. You are expected to independently navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and help stakeholders focus on outcomes rather than outputs. We value first\-principles thinking over quantum of feature delivery.
 



  





**You drive high\-quality product execution:** 




 You are accountable for ensuring that ideas are translated into well\-defined, actionable product work that moves efficiently through the lifecycle. You own the activities spanning from Discovery to Delivery to Validation. You consistently
 


* Create clarity from ambiguity and define clear priority while making thoughtful trade\-off decisions
* Produce product artifacts that enable teams to move faster with confidence
* Drive accountability across stakeholders by identifying risks and dependencies before they become blockers
* Take ownership for outcomes, not simply deliverables
* Leverage modern tools and AI\-assisted workflows to improve execution quality and speed.



  





**You influence through stakeholder leadership:** 




 Product management is fundamentally a discipline of influence. You build trusted relationships across business, operations, engineering, design, architecture, analytics, and leadership teams. You align stakeholders around shared outcomes and navigate competing priorities using evidence, judgment, and business context. We value people who can move discussions forward through ambiguity, disagreement, or organizational complexity while maintaining strong partnerships across teams.
 



  





**Role Fitment:** 




**Experience \& Education:** 




 You have a bachelor's degree (or higher) in either Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields. You have worked for 6\+ years with at least 3 years in Product Management. Experience in a B2C digital product (mobile ordering, loyalty, ecommerce, or consumer apps) spanning multiple geographies or brands is strongly preferred. Background in QSR, retail, or hospitality digital is a differentiator.
 



  





**Experience with AI \& Other PM Tools:** 



* Built AI\-assisted workflows, automations, copilots, agents, or reusable prompting frameworks that improved product management effectiveness (Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude etc.)
* Leveraged AI powered workflows for tasks such as backlog generation and discovery diligence
* Used GenAI tools to accelerate requirements creation and research synthesis or customer insight discovery
* Experience with modern product management, experimentation, analytics, design collaboration, and AI\-assistance tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Quantum Metrics, Figma, Miro, Aha, Product Board or other equivalent tools.



  





**Equal Employment Opportunity Policy:** 




 It is the policy of Inspire Brands Inc.™ (“IRB” or the “Company”) to treat all employees and applicants for employment fairly and to provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national original or ancestry, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship, military service or veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all employment practices including recruiting, hiring, placement, pay, promotions, transfers, training, leaves of absence, and termination.

title: Founders’ Office ( Early Stage Startup )
description:
**Founder's Office \| Growth Valley Community** 




 Gurugram (in\-office) \| Full\-time \| 1\-5 years experience \| Reports directly to the Founder
 



  





 Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred.
 



  





**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.** 




  





**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.** 




  





**About GVC.** 




  





 Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000\+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.
 



  





 Product\-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.
 



  





**The role.** 




  





 You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.
 



  





 This is the highest\-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.
 



  





**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:** 




  




* **Enrollment engine.** 
 Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.



  




* **Admissions product.** 
 We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.



  




* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1\.** 
 A new one\-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.



  




* **Partnerships.** 
 Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.



  




* **The numbers.** 
 Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.



  





**How we will measure you.** 




 Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.
 



  





**Who fits.** 



* Tier\-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1\-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.



  





**Who should not apply.** 




  





 If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.
 



  





**Compensation.** 




  





 fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG\-level.
 



  





**Growth path.** 




  





 This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.
 



  





**How to apply.** 




  





 Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com
 


1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.



 Subject line: FO \| Your Name \| College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

 bist du Teil eines eingespielten Projektteams und wächst Schritt für Schritt in die Steuerung unserer Salesforce\-Projekte hinein. Gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen hilfst du unseren Kunden dabei, ihre Geschäftsprozesse auf ein neues Level zu heben.

Wir sind darauf spezialisiert, die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden vom Mittelstand bis hin zu Großkonzernen aktiv zu gestalten und dabei Kernprozesse wie Sales, Service und Marketing auf Basis innovativer Salesforce\-, Analytics\- und KI\-Lösungen zu optimieren.

Parallel baust du dein Salesforce\-Know\-how auf – unter anderem durch relevante Zertifizierungen.

 Dein Profil

* Hohe Kunden\- und Lösungsorientierung, Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und ein souveränes Auftreten
* Starkes Interesse an Salesforce und agilen Projektmanagementmethoden sowie ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, dir das entsprechende Know\-how anzueignen
* Ausgeprägter Teamgeist, Freude an der Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe und die Fähigkeit, eine motivierende Atmosphäre zu schaffen
* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
* Verhandlungssichere Deutsch\- und fließende Englischkenntnisse.


 Deine Benefits
   

  

* Sicherheit \& Gehalt: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, attraktives Grundgehalt plus variable Vergütung sowie 30 Tage Urlaub.
* Work from anywhere: Arbeite remote oder in einem unserer Offices in Eschborn, Köln oder Hamburg.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
   

 ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
   

 As a Technical Program Manager in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
   

  

 Job Purpose
   

 The Technical Program Manager is an individual contributor responsible for implementing portfolio management processes, configuring work management systems, and delivering data analytics that support portfolio visibility, execution, and decision\-making.
   

 This role translates strategic portfolio objectives into operational execution through hands\-on process design, workflow engineering, Agile planning, reporting, and metrics development. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Agile, and leadership teams to improve delivery predictability, governance, and business outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Portfolio \& Process Management
   

 \- Design and implement standardized intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance processes, and portfolio operating models.
   

 \- Establish quarterly planning practices, including PI Planning, capacity planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement routines.
   

 \- Create and maintain documentation such as RACI matrices, SOPs, workflow diagrams, process guides, and training materials.
   

 \- Drive process adoption through change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and self\-service knowledge resources.
   

 \- Conduct process reviews, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective actions.
   

 \- Partner with Agile coaches and delivery teams to align portfolio processes with team\-level ceremonies.
   

  

 Workflow Tool Engineering
   

 \- Configure and optimize work management tools including Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
   

 \- Build boards, queries, dashboards, work item hierarchies, automation rules, and reporting structures.
   

 \- Create stakeholder\-specific dashboards and reports to support delivery visibility and portfolio governance.
   

 \- Provide advanced user support for complex tool, workflow, reporting, and configuration issues.
   

 \- Develop user guides, FAQs, training materials, and platform enablement resources.
   

  

 Data Analytics \& Business Intelligence
   

 \- Design and deliver dashboards for executives, program managers, and delivery teams.
   

 \- Track portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, budget, and delivery performance.
   

 \- Implement and report on DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
   

 \- Establish Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, and flow efficiency.
   

 \- Create executive\-level reporting that converts complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
   

 \- Support forecasting, variance analysis, burn\-rate tracking, and data quality improvements.
   

  

 Portfolio Coordination \& Delivery Support
   

 \- Coordinate quarterly planning events, governance meetings, and cross\-functional working sessions.
   

 \- Track actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and schedule conflicts.
   

 \- Support software initiatives from concept through delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business outcomes.
   

 \- Oversee SDLC execution across requirements, development, testing, release, and post\-launch activities.
   

 \- Lead continuous improvement initiatives for the Biller Portfolio.
   

  

 Required Qualifications
   

 Education
   

 \- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
   

 \- Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
   

 Experience
   

 \- 2 to 5 years of experience in program management, portfolio operations, PMO, Agile delivery, or related functions.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience administering Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
   

 \- Experience configuring workflows, dashboards, reports, and process templates.
   

 \- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
   

 \- Experience supporting Agile teams using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
   

 \- Experience implementing or improving portfolio management processes.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

 \- Strong proficiency in Azure DevOps including boards, queries, dashboards, and process templates.
   

 \- Strong proficiency in Jira/Jira Cloud including JQL, workflows, automation, and portfolio views.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Smartsheet, APIs, webhooks, or workflow integrations.
   

 \- Proficiency in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, and visualization.
   

 \- Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, and reporting.
   

 \- SQL knowledge for querying and analyzing data.
   

 \- Understanding of data quality, validation, and reporting governance.
   

 \- Ability to use AI tools for analytics, documentation, analysis, and content preparation.
   

  

 Methodology \& Metrics Knowledge
   

 \- Portfolio management, prioritization, governance, and capacity management.
   

 \- Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
   

 \- DevOps practices and engineering productivity measurement.
   

 \- ITIL/ITSM and PMI/PMBOK principles preferred.
   

 \- Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, and WIP.
   

 \- DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
   

 \- Financial and portfolio metrics including burn rate, variance analysis, ROI, and resource loading.
   

  

 Professional Skills
   

 \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \- Excellent written and verbal communication.
   

 \- Ability to adapt communication style for technical, business, and executive audiences.
   

 \- Strong facilitation skills for planning sessions and working groups.
   

 \- High attention to detail in tool configuration, documentation, and reporting.
   

 \- Customer\-service mindset with the ability to support and enable users.
   

 \- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
   

 \- Strong collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

 \- PMP, CAPM, PMI\-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or similar Agile/program management certification.
   

 \- Atlassian, Microsoft, Power BI, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma certification.
   

 \- Experience in payments, financial services, SaaS, or regulated industries.
   

 \- Experience implementing DORA or Flow Metrics programs.
   

 \- Experience with enterprise portfolio management tools such as Planview or ServiceNow PPM.
   

 \- Scripting or automation exposure using Python, PowerShell, Groovy, or similar technologies.
   

 \- Intermediate SQL skills.
   

  

 Work Environment
   

 \- Standard office environment with frequent computer\-based work.
   

 \- Hybrid work model with regular in\-office presence as required.
   

 \- Collaboration with global teams across Engineering, Product, Agile, and business functions.
   

 \- Minimal travel may be required for planning sessions, workshops, or business meetings.
   

  

 In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
   

  

 Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com

title: Program Associate
description:
**Job Description: Program Associate** 




**About the Organization** 




**(Supporting Municipal Corporations in NCR)** 




  





 Air Pollution Action Group (A\-PAG) was set up in 2019 by Ashish Dhawan (Founder and Chairperson, Ashoka University and Central Square Foundation), Vijay Chadda (previously CEO of Bharti Foundation) and Mohit Beotra (previously Chief Brand Officer of Airtel). A\-PAG is a past member of the Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and adjoining regions.
 



 A\-PAG is focused on strategic implementation of solutions to combat air pollution and has created a niche for itself within the broader ecosystem in the last 2 years. A\-PAG works with the Government on a pro\-bono basis; we have made significant progress with programs at the National as well as State level. Some of our projects are as follows:
 



 1\. In Delhi, we are engaged with the Municipal Corporation on a massive program aimed at dispersed sources. This covers all \~250 wards across the city.
 



 2\. In Uttar Pradesh (UP) we have programs running in 11 cities across the state.
 



 3\. As part of our program with Bihar State Pollution Control Board (BPSCB), we are active in Patna, Muzaffarpur, Gayaji \& Biharsharif.
 



 4\. In Haryana, we work in Gurgaon \& Faridabad in partnership with the Municipal Corporation.
 



 5\. We have recently launched programs in AP and Odisha.
 



 6\. We have a PMU based at the Central Pollution Control Board, which is helping drive the effectiveness of the National Clean Air Program (NCAP). We are currently 49 people strong with teams in 20 cities.
 



  





 A\-PAG is an FCRA registered organisation with the ability to receive both domestic and foreign funding. This enables us to work with a diverse set of partners and mobilise resources to scale high\-impact programmes across India.
 



  





**About the role** 
 A\-PAG's project in Delhi aims at improving air quality by tackling issues which contribute to air pollution. Based on our pilot work with the Municipal Corporation Delhi the project will now be rolled out in the city of Ghaziabad, Noida, Gurugram and Faridabad.
 



 As a Program Associate, you will work closely with Municipal Corporations and other government stakeholders to drive the implementation of A\-PAG's dispersed\-source programme. The role involves managing on\-ground implementation, stakeholder engagement, monitoring and problem\-solving, while also identifying opportunities to pilot scalable solutions to address air pollution.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 The critical functions to manage your area successfully will include the following:
 



  





 1\.
 **Program Strategy and Implementation:** 
 Working with ULBs in your district, you would need to ensure all processes are put into place and all planned actions are carried out in a time\-bound manner. This involves planning for an on\-ground survey, creating route maps, ensuring IT systems are ready, etc.
 



**2\. Stakeholder Management:** 
 You will be expected to build relationships with officials ranging from the operational levels of these organizations (Ex. Junior Engineers, Sanitary Inspectors) to the leadership (Ex. District Magistrate, Municipal Commissioners) and drive these engagements to ensure success. You will also support the ULBs in coordinating with each other. This is a key deliverable for ensuring the program's success.
 



**3\. Monitoring and Review:** 
 Putting in place a robust monitoring and review process will be a key priority. You will be responsible to ensure structured reviews are held in your area in order to make progress toward resolving the issues identified on the ground.
 



**4\. Vendor Management:** 
 The project is supported by third parties at multiple levels. You will be responsible to guide and oversee the functioning of these third\-party vendors. These include survey agencies, IT vendors, etc.
 



 5\.
 **Process Improvement:** 
 While engaging with officials across multiple organizations you would be in a key position with visibility to understand problem areas and develop insights and solutions for them. You would be expected to translate these insights into action in
 



 order to improve the processes undertaken throughout the program.
 



  





**Eligibility** 




 1\. Master's degree from a tier\-1 institute with a strong track record of outstanding academic performance
 



 2\. 2–4 years of experience in a client\-facing, project\-based or programme implementation role with significant analytical responsibilities.
 



 3\. Experience in environment, solid waste management, programme implementation or technology/IT dashboards is preferred but not essential.
 



 4\. Demonstrated ability to take initiative, think independently and solve problems in dynamic environments.
 



 5\. Passion for addressing India's air pollution challenge.
 



  





**Skill Sets Required** 




 1\. Analytical bent of mind is key – you will need to think through problems and help the team arrive at an accurate assessment of the key issues to be addressed.
 



 2\. Entrepreneurial nature – success in this role depends heavily on your ability to make things happen on the ground.
 



 3\. Ability to work alongside senior Government officials, while being able to convince them to accept our recommendations.
 



 4\. Program management skills are needed to ensure programs are delivered against agreed timelines with requisite quality.
 



 5\. Ability to learn quickly – air pollution is a relatively nascent space and new knowledge is constantly emerging which we need to understand \& utilize to our benefit.
 



  





**Location** 
 Delhi\-NCR

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About This Job**
**Saras Analytics**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 IT Services and IT Consulting,Data Infrastructure and Analytics,Software Development
   

  

**Job Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 Saras Analytics is looking for a Technical Project Manager to drive delivery governance across its
   

  

 Consulting team. This role sits at the intersection of client engagement management and technical
   

  

 execution — coordinating with Engagement Leads, Data Engineering pods, and cross\-functional teams
   

  

 to ensure every client use case is delivered on time, with full visibility into risks and blockers.
   

  

 The TPM will not just manage process — they will own delivery outcomes. That means understanding
   

  

 what the client is trying to achieve (e.g., average order value trends, sales performance dashboards),
   

  

 translating those into realistic project plans, and proactively flagging when timelines need adjustment
   

  

 before commitments are broken.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 Project Planning \& Sprint Management
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end project plans for consulting engagements — from client onboarding and


 charter creation through milestone tracking to final delivery.
   

  

* Build and maintain sprint cycles (typically 2\-week cadence) with clear goals, backlogs, and


 acceptance criteria for each sprint.
   

  

* Run sprint planning, sprint review, and retrospective calls with Engagement Leads and relevant


 team leads.
   

  

* Maintain project workspaces in ClickUp (or equivalent tools) with consistent structure, fields,


 and governance — ensuring cross\-team visibility without redundant or conflicting data.
   

  

 Delivery Ownership \& Risk Management
   

  

* Track progress across all active consulting engagements and flag delays before they surface as


 client escalations.
   

  

* Engage with Engagement Leads to validate timeline estimates — push back when scopes are


 underestimated, and get commitments adjusted proactively.
   

  

* Coordinate dependencies across consulting, data engineering, and engineering/infrastructure


 teams to unblock execution.
   

  

* Maintain a clear view of what each client is at, what stage their delivery is in, and what the next


 sprint goal is at any point in time.
   

  

 Stakeholder Communication
   

  

* Serve as the central coordination point between Engagement Leads and Data Engineering pods


 — translate consulting asks into actionable technical tickets with proper acceptance criteria.
   

  

* Present bi\-weekly delivery status updates to internal stakeholders; communicate sprint goals


 and upcoming milestones clearly.
   

  

* Over time, participate in client\-facing demos and delivery reviews (bi\-weekly cadence),


 representing project status and next sprint goals.
   

  

 Process Governance \& Adoption
   

  

* Drive adoption of standardised project management processes across consulting pods —


 including ticket templates, milestone definitions, and sprint hygiene.
   

  

* Create and maintain process documentation for delivery workflows, escalation paths, and


 onboarding playbooks for new team members.
   

  

* Conduct onboarding sessions for new joiners covering e\-commerce domain basics, connector


 landscape, and cross\-team workflows.
   

  

 What We Are Looking For
   

  

 Must\-Have
   

  

* 3–6 years of experience in project/program management, preferably in a data, analytics, or


 tech services environment.
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to run Agile/Scrum workflows — sprint planning, backlog management,


 retrospectives — with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

* Strong coordination skills across multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders with competing


 priorities.
   

  

* Experience working with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and the


 discipline to enforce governance without losing team buy\-in.
   

  

* Enough domain fluency to understand what a client ask involves technically — you don't need


 to build dashboards, but you should understand what makes an average\-order\-value analysis
   

  

 more or less complex.
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

* Familiarity with e\-commerce and retail analytics concepts — connectors (Shopify, Amazon,


 etc.), BI layers, data pipelines.
   

  

* Experience managing delivery in a consulting or client\-services environment where expectations


 are set externally.
   

  

* Comfort with client\-facing communication — status updates, demos, expectation management.
* Understanding of data engineering workflows: connectors, data modelling, QA/certification,


 and dashboard/presentation layers.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* No client commitment is broken because a timeline risk wasn't caught early enough.
* Engagement Leads spend less time chasing cross\-team dependencies and more time on delivery


 quality.
   

  

* Sprint velocity and milestone adherence are trackable, visible, and consistently improving.
* New hires on the consulting team understand how delivery works within the first two weeks.
* ClickUp (or equivalent) is a single source of truth — not a contested, noisy system that people


 work around.

title: Product Designer Intern
description:
About PlaySuper
 
 PlaySuper is rebuilding how mobile games monetise. We sit between studios and brands, turning in\-game engagement into real\-world rewards for players, better LTVs for studios, higher retention for players, measurable performance for brands. We are venture\-backed, closing our pre\-Series A, and have early traction across India and global markets. We're now building the in\-game store that hundreds of studios will run on, and this is the design seat that will shape how it looks and feels.
 


 The Role
 
 You will own the design of PlaySuper's in\-game store end\-to\-end, from playing the game and mapping the player journey, to designing the touchpoint, to shipping it and reading the conversion data that tells you whether it worked. You'll work directly with our lead designer, Head of Product, and CTO, and sit alongside engineering, research, and brand to architect a store that thousands of players actually move through.
 



 This is not a portfolio\-building internship where you polish one project for three months. You'll ship real work across 20\+ live games before you're done, on a repeatable design process, against real conversion numbers.
 


 What You'll Own
 * Play assigned games — yes, that's the job — and map the player journey to find where a store touchpoint belongs.
* Design touchpoint variants per placement that feel native to each game, not bolted on.
* Build toward a flexible design system and component library that lets diverse studios configure store branding, content, and layout without an engineer.
* Take feedback from the lead designer and iterate fast — multiple fidelities, tight loops, no precious first drafts.
* Set the UX and conversion metrics for the touchpoints you ship, then optimize them post\-launch on the data.


 Who You Are
 * 0–1 years designing consumer products. You have a portfolio of high\-quality, thoughtful visual and interaction work — clean mobile UI, real screens, real decisions.
* Native, not forced. You instinctively know when a store touchpoint belongs in a game and when it breaks the experience.
* Fluent in Figma, with a sharp eye for clean mobile UI and the patience for pixel\-level polish.
* A player, not a studier. You play mobile games and understand how they feel to use — not just what the case studies say.
* High output without losing care. You can move fast across many games and still sweat the details that make a touchpoint convert.
* Comfortable with systems thinking — you design the reusable pattern, not just the one\-off screen.


 Bonus Points
 * Prior work on game UI, app UI, or e\-commerce / store flows.
* You can write tight microcopy, or you're hungry to learn it fast.
* A background in motion, illustration, or copywriting that you bring into your design work.
* Genuine fluency in the mobile\-gaming community, you know the games studios are shipping and why they feel the way they do.


 What We Offer
 * A real seat on a small, mission\-led team where design is central, your touchpoints ship to live games, not a deck.
* Direct mentorship from our lead designer, Head of Product, and CTO, experienced operators you'll work next to, not under three layers of approval.
* A clear path to convert to full\-time after an exceed\-expectations stint, with Health Insurance from Onsurity on conversion.
* Flexible working arrangements, and the chance to see your work in the hands of players, fast.

title: Website Designer
description:
**What This Role Actually Is** 




 We're a B2B marketing agency. Our clients' websites and campaign assets aren't portfolio pieces; they're live sales tools that generate pipelines. When a design can't be built the way it was drawn, it costs us days of developer time. When an interface isn't accessible, it costs the client credibility and exposes them to risk. When a Figma file is a mess of ungrouped layers and magic numbers, a two\-day build becomes two weeks.
 



 We need one person who owns all of that. Not someone who designs screens and hands them off. Someone who designs them right, builds them into a system, and stays accountable for how they survive the build and the real world.
 



 If your definition of 'done' is exporting a pretty JPG, this isn't the right role.
 



 ‍
 



**About Pangolin Marketing** 




 We're a fully remote B2B marketing agency working with SaaS, climate tech, and enterprise software clients. We run websites, campaigns, content, and brand work for companies that want to own their category. Our design work spans homepages, landing pages, campaign pages, design systems, and brand direction across multiple client accounts.
 



 ‍
 



**You'll Fail Here If:** 




 • Your involvement ends at the mock\-up — you've never seen your own design through to a shipped build
 



 • You've never built or extended a real design system — tokens, components, states, not just a page of nice screens
 



 • You design in isolation from constraints — you've never had a developer tell you what's actually buildable
 



 • You've never opened a contrast checker or thought about focus states, keyboard navigation, or heading hierarchy
 



 • You need a pixel\-perfect brief to start — real projects always have gaps and you're expected to make the call
 



 • You treat responsive as 'shrink the desktop' — you've never designed mobile and tablet as first\-class layouts
 



 • 'The developer ruined my design' has ever been your explanation for a bad build
 



 • You've never used Auto Layout, Components, or Variants — your files are hand\-placed, hand\-aligned frames
 



 • You can't defend a design decision beyond 'it looked better'
 



 • Your idea of handoff is sending the Figma link with no specs, no tokens, and no notes
 



 ‍
 



**What You'll Own** 




**‍** 




**Design (60%)** 



* Design considered, responsive homepages, landing pages, and campaign pages from brand systems — across desktop, tablet, and mobile
* Build and extend design systems from scratch — tokens, components, variants, spacing and grid rules, not just a swatch page
* Turn incomplete brand concepts into production\-ready systems a team can actually build from
* Design for accessibility from the first frame — WCAG 2\.1 AA contrast, focus states, semantic hierarchy
* Build interactive prototypes that communicate intent and state, not just static frames
* Work across multiple client brands at speed — one considered landing page design per day is the baseline, not the ceiling
* Make the call when a brief is ambiguous — our references are thorough but real work always has gaps



**‍** 




**Systems \& Handoff (40%)** 



* Own the design system: keep components, variants, and tokens consistent so one brand change doesn't mean forty manual edits
* Produce dev handoff a developer can build from cold — specs, tokens, states, interaction notes, export settings, no 45\-minute walkthrough call
* Keep Figma file hygiene: named layers, Auto Layout throughout, logical page structure, no orphaned frames
* QA the build against the design — you don't disappear after handoff, you check the result and flag the gaps
* Collaborate with developers directly — you understand enough about how things get built to design things that can be built
* Maintain accessibility standards across everything that ships — contrast, focus, hierarchy, alt text
* Set and document the responsive rules — breakpoints, reflow behaviour, touch targets — so the build is predictable



**Craft Requirements** 




 ‍
 



**Must\-Have** 




 • Figma mastery: Auto Layout, Components, Variants, Variables/tokens, constraints — not just frames and rectangles
 



 • Design systems: build and maintain tokens, component libraries, states, spacing and grid rules
 



 • Responsive design: desktop, tablet, and mobile as first\-class layouts, not a shrunk desktop
 



 • Webflow or comparable design\-to\-web tool — build as well as design
 



 • Accessibility: WCAG 2\.1 AA — contrast ratios, focus states, semantic hierarchy, alt text
 



 • Dev handoff: specs, redlines, tokens, and interaction notes an engineer can build from without asking
 



 • Typography \& layout: hierarchy, spacing systems, grid, rhythm — not just picking a nice font
 



 • Prototyping: interactive flows that communicate intent and state
 



 • Visual craft: consistency, restraint, and taste across an entire system, not one hero screen
 



 ‍
 



**Strong Advantage** 




 • Motion / interaction design: micro\-interactions, transitions, and knowing when animation helps vs hurts
 



 • HTML/CSS literacy: enough to know what's cheap vs expensive to build
 



 • Design ops: documentation, file governance, naming conventions across a team
 



 • Brand and visual identity work: extending a concept, not just applying it
 



 • User research basics: usability testing, heuristic evaluation, reading real behaviour
 



 • B2B marketing or agency experience: designing for long sales cycles and considered purchases
 



 • FigJam, Maze, or analytics to back design decisions with evidence
 



 ‍
 



**What You Get** 




 • Variety: no two client brands are the same — SaaS, climate tech, enterprise software, each with its own system and constraints
 



 • Ownership: you're not a pixel\-pusher taking tickets. You make the design calls.
 



 • Remote, async\-first: your output matters more than when you're online
 



 • Speed over bureaucracy: decisions get made fast, you won't wait two weeks for approval to fix something
 



 • Work that actually ships: no designs that die in an endless review deck
 



 ‍
 



**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume, a link to your portfolio with 2–3 shipped projects (not just concepts — work that made it into a real website or campaign, with the case study behind it), and a one\-paragraph answer to this question: 'Describe the last time a design you shipped didn't survive contact with development or real users. What broke, why did it break, and what did you change about how you design because of it?' to drishti@pangolinmarketing.com
 



 No moodboard\-only portfolios. Show us process and shipped work, not just final screens. If a project you designed is no longer live, describe it and explain why.

title: Product Designer - 2
description:
**About Us**
 ACKO is the protection destination for over 200 million tech\-savvy families across India, protecting their families, assets and money. Launched in 2016, ACKO started by reimagining insurance, making it simple, hassle\-free and customer\-first. Today, our mission goes beyond that: we aim to touch the lives of 1 million users, building products that solve real\-world problems with technology at the core.
   

  

 We are not just another insurance company, our DNA is product\-tech, and our approach is bold, innovative, and digital\-first. From zero commission, zero paperwork, and instant renewals to same\-day claims settlements and app\-based tracking, ACKO is a Welcome Change from traditional insurers.
   

  

 But what truly sets us apart? Our people. At ACKO, every Acker’s voice and ideas matter. We’re a vibrant, inclusive team of creators, thinkers, and doers, building products that redefine protection while ensuring each Acker grows, thrives and does meaningful work.
   

  

 Join us at ACKO, where bold ideas, real impact and tech\-driven innovation redefine protection and peace of mind \- and where YOU can make a real difference in people's lives. ACKO is a product\-tech company, launched in 2016, solving real\-world problems for customers, starting with insurance. And as a customer\-first organization serving the digitally\-savvy, ACKO’s value proposition of ‘Welcome Change’ focuses on offerings that make insurance simple and hassle\-free! With features such as zero commission, zero paperwork, instant renewal, same\-day claim settlements, and app\-based updates on claims, ACKO is a 'Welcome Change' from traditional insurers.
   

  

 Having said that, we are not just another conventional insurance firm, or the people consulted solely for "claims”! Anchored in a tech\-centric philosophy, ACKO’s approach fuels innovation, empowering us to develop comprehensive products that cater to every aspect of our customers' insurance requirements. And while we are at it, we put our Ackers at the heart of everything we do. We're not your typical 9\-to\-5 workplace; we're a vibrant and inclusive bunch of innovators and creators making sure every Acker’s idea matters, their voice is heard, and their growth is part of our mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Product Designer (PD2\) to own end\-to\-end design for one of our core product areas (Auto, Health, Life, or Growth) depending on where the fit is strongest. This is not a pixel\-pushing role. You’ll be expected to think structurally about problems, make sharp decisions about user experience, and ship work that moves business metrics.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, data analysts, and the design leadership team. The problems you’ll solve are messy and contextual: How do you personalise an experience for a first\-time buyer in Pune vs. a returning customer in Mumbai? How do you design an engagement loop that builds trust, not fatigue? How do you make insurance, a product nobody wants to think about, feel like something that’s on your side?
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own design for a product area from problem framing through to shipped experience, including research synthesis, flows, interaction design, visual design, and post\-launch iteration.
* Collaborate deeply with Product and Engineering. You’ll be in the room when decisions are made, not downstream of them. We expect you to have opinions about scope, priorities, and trade\-offs, not just layouts.
* Work on structural UX problems: information architecture, personalisation logic, segmentation\-driven interfaces, onboarding funnels, and retention mechanics.
* Contribute to the ACKO design system and help evolve shared patterns across product areas.
* Engage in regular design critiques, share your reasoning openly, and help raise the craft bar for the team.
* Communicate design rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders, not as a pitch, but as a shared problem\-solving exercise.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 4\-6 years of product design experience, with at least 2 years of sustained ownership of a product area (not just feature\-level work across many projects).
* Strong systems thinking. You see the flow, not just the screen. You can reason about how five different user segments experience the same surface differently.
* Contextual judgment over borrowed frameworks. We care less about whether you know the Double Diamond and more about whether you can explain why a pattern that works for Revolut won’t work for an insurance buyer in India.
* Comfort with ambiguity. The brief isn’t always clear. The backend might not support the ideal UX. You find a path that holds the line on user value without pretending constraints don’t exist.
* Fluency in interaction and visual design. You don’t need to be an illustrator, but your shipped work should feel considered, not templated.
* Clear communication. You can walk a room through your thinking: what you tried, what you discarded, and why.
* Familiarity with Figma as your primary design tool.
* Comfort using AI tools across your design workflow. You don’t need to be building custom agents, but you should be actively using AI for research synthesis, ideation, copywriting, prototyping, or similar. We’re looking for someone who treats these tools as a natural part of how they work, not something they’re planning to explore someday.


**Bonus, Not Required**
* Experience in insurance, fintech, or other trust\-sensitive, regulation\-heavy domains.
* Exposure to growth design: onboarding, activation, retention, or conversion\-focused work.
* Experience working with data teams to define and validate design hypotheses.
* Comfort with prototyping tools or light front\-end code for testing ideas.


**How We Evaluate**
 Our hiring process is designed to simulate the kind of work you’d actually do here. Expect:
   

  

* A portfolio walkthrough focused on depth, not breadth. We’ll want to understand your process on one or two projects: the decisions you made, the trade\-offs you navigated, and what you’d do differently.
* A live whiteboarding session where we’ll work through a real, contextual problem together. We’re evaluating how you think, not how fast you can produce polished output.
* Conversations with your potential collaborators in Product and Engineering to assess mutual fit.


**Why ACKO**
* Design has a seat at the table. Your work shapes product strategy, not just product surfaces.
* You’ll work on problems with real impact. Insurance touches health, financial security, and peace of mind for millions of families.
* Small team, high ownership. No waiting months for your work to ship.
* A leadership team that values directness, craft, and original thinking over process theatre.

title: Product Associate
description:
About the Company
 



 PlaySuper is India's first Gaming Commerce company, pioneering a new way for 500M\+ gamers, an audience growing at 19\.6% YoY, to shop inside games.
 



 It is a white\-label SaaS plugin that integrates into casual and hyper\-casual games, transforming in\-game coins into real\-world value. Players can redeem them for brand coupons, digital services, or even physical products inside fully customizable in\-game stores.
 



 For gaming studios, PlaySuper directly solves the industry's toughest challenge, low retention, while also boosting monetisation. For brands, it unlocks a massive high\-attention audience that already spends billions on in\-game experiences, enabling targeted engagement with measurable ROI. Unlike traditional ads, PlaySuper embeds commerce into gameplay itself, improving recall, conversion, and loyalty.
 



 In under two years, PlaySuper has onboarded 20\+ studios, 3,000\+ brands, and reached 6M\+ DAUs through its partners, backed by $1\.6M funding from Jungle Ventures (Chimera), Audacity VC, IAN Capital Fund, 100x.VC, and leaders from Meta, Tata, Dyson, and Amazon.
 



 playsuper.ai
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **Product Associate** 
 who thinks in
 **funnels, user behaviour, and data** 
 . You will work directly with the founding and product team on PlaySuper's live commerce surfaces across partner games.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who:
 


* Is obsessed with why users drop off and what makes them convert
* Can pull their own data instead of waiting for someone else to
* Ships fast, writes clearly, and is comfortable with ambiguity
* Uses AI tools aggressively to move faster



 You will not be writing specs in isolation. You will own surfaces that millions of players see.
 



 The role starts as a
 **3\-month full\-time internship** 
 in Gurgaon and converts to a
 **permanent Product Associate** 
 position on performance.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 


* Own specific surfaces of the in\-game store: homepage, category pages, product pages, cart, checkout
* Write PRDs, event taxonomies, and analytics specs that engineering can build from directly
* Run your own analysis on funnels, retention, and conversion to find where users leak
* Design and run A/B tests, then defend the results with data
* Work with design to build store experiences that feel native to the game, not bolted on
* Support partner studios with launch readiness, integration checks, and performance reviews
* Build proposals and merchandising strategies for partner games
* Turn open\-ended problems into prototypes quickly, using AI and vibe\-coding tools



 What We're Looking For
 


* Strong analytical ability, comfortable with SQL and dashboarding tools
* Clear, structured written communication, no fluff
* Genuine interest in gaming, commerce, or rewards\-led products
* Ability to prototype ideas independently using AI tools
* High ownership, low ego, fast iteration



 Strong Plus (Nice to Have)
 


* Prior product internship experience at a startup or product\-led company
* Experience at a consumer internet, e\-commerce, gaming, or fintech startup
* Familiarity with event\-based analytics stacks such as ClickHouse, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Metabase
* Prior exposure to loyalty, cashback, rewards, or in\-app purchase systems
* Shipped side projects, prototypes, or products of your own



 Structure and Location
 


* **First 3 months:** 
 Full\-time paid internship. You will own a live surface from day one, not shadow someone else's work.
* **Post 3 months:** 
 Conversion to a permanent Product Associate role, based on performance.
* Full\-time, in\-office, Gurgaon.



**Assignment** 




 To apply, complete the assignment below and share it along with your resume.
 



 Vibe Code an In\-Game Commerce Store
 



 A product thinking and rapid prototyping exercise.
 



 Build a store inside a mobile game where players can use a combination of in\-game currency and real money to purchase real\-world products.
 



**The Challenge** 




 Imagine a mobile game where users earn in\-game currency by playing. PlaySuper wants to introduce a commerce experience within the game where that currency can be used alongside real money to buy real\-world products.
 



**Your Task** 




 Vibe code the store experience. Think through the journey from discovering the store inside the game to completing a purchase.
 



 You are free to make your own assumptions about the game, users, currency mechanics, merchandising, checkout and overall experience. We are intentionally leaving the problem open\-ended.
 



**Core Product Question** 




  





 How should an in\-game commerce store be different from a traditional e\-commerce store?
 



 Think beyond UI. Consider the relationship between gameplay, rewards, user behaviour, commerce and the game economy.
 



**Deliverables** 



1. A working prototype or shareable link
2. A short note explaining your key product decisions and assumptions
3. The AI / vibe\-coding tools you used



**What We Are Evaluating** 




 Product thinking \| Creativity \| User experience \| Ability to turn ambiguity into a working product
 



 There is no single correct solution. We are more interested in the decisions you make, the questions you ask and how clearly your prototype communicates your thinking.
 



 Reach out to us at
 **khushboobhatia@playsuper.ai**

title: Entry Level Technical Report Writer – Environmental Remediation Projects
description:
**Entry\-Level Technical Report Writer – Environmental Remediation** 




**Job Summary:** 
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly organized
 **Junior Technical Report Writer** 
 to join our environmental consulting team. This entry\-level role is ideal for a recent graduate in environmental science, geology, engineering, or technical writing who possesses strong written communication skills and a sharp eye for detail. You will collaborate with project managers and field teams to turn field data, soil/groundwater sampling results, and regulatory guidelines into clear, accurate technical reports.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Drafting Remediation Reports:** 
 Learn and assist in drafting technical deliverables across various project stages, including:
* **Site Investigation (SI) Reports:** 
 Summarizing site histories, field activities, and soil/groundwater sampling findings.
* **UST Closure Reports:** 
 Documenting underground storage tank removals, post\-excavation soil sampling, and waste disposal.
* **Remedial Investigation (RI) Reports:** 
 Assisting with contaminant delineation narratives, groundwater flow summaries, and data tabulations.
* **Remedial Action (RA) Deliverables:** 
 Compiling cleanup documentation, post\-remediation monitoring data, and regulatory compliance filings.
* **Data Organization \& Formatting:** 
 Convert raw laboratory data (EDDs), field logs, boring logs, and well construction details into standardized tables, charts, and appendices.
* **Proofreading \& QA/QC:** 
 Review report drafts for grammatical accuracy, proper formatting, mathematical consistency, and alignment with figure callouts and maps.
* **Project Support:** 
 Coordinate with GIS/CAD staff and project managers to gather necessary report attachments, figures, and historical documents.



**Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Environmental Engineering, Technical Writing, English, or a related field.
* **Writing Proficiency:** 
 Exceptional written English skills, including strong technical grammar, structural organization, and precise vocabulary. (A writing sample may be requested)
* **Technical Aptitude:** 
 Ability to read, interpret, and organize quantitative data (e.g., scientific units, concentration tables, laboratory results).
* **Software Skills:** 
 High proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel (formatting tables, styling headers, managing references) and Adobe Acrobat.
* **Detail\-Oriented:** 
 High level of accuracy when proofreading numbers, dates, sample IDs, and regulatory standards.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Basic exposure to environmental field sampling protocols (soil, groundwater, or vapor intrusion) through internships or coursework.
* Familiarity with reading basic environmental maps, geological cross\-sections, or boring logs.
* Prior coursework or certification in technical or scientific writing.
